chapters.title: Chapter 901: Trouble In Netherworld Realm
paragraphs: Lei Huoting was surprised when Huo Diqiu came out of Zhang Fei [5]'s body. "Master, the golden crow flame is a special flame. This woman is a mixed breed, so I'm not sure if she will succeed in refining her flame to perfection. However, there is one method you might try to help her, but I'm not sure that it will work."
"What is that method?"
"Give her a fragment of the Sun Flame, but it does not exist in the three mortal realms. The golden crow flame and the sun flame are almost similar, so I'm sure it can perfect her flame."
"The Sun Flame, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself. "The flame only exists in the Paradise Realm, and I don't have the ability to go to that realm yet."
Huo Diqiu nodded at him. "Instead of that, focus on breaking into the Seven Divine Realms, which is the most realistic goal for you."
"What is the Sun Flame and the Paradise Realm?" Lei Huoting suddenly asked.

Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh and explained to Lei Huoting about the Sun Flame and the Paradise Realm, which amazed and shocked her. "There are a total of ten heavenly flames, and I have already obtained four of them. I already know the location of the Sky Flame, but I can't take it now. Unfortunately, I don't know the location of the Blood Flame, and I don't have any clues to its whereabouts. I won't be able to perfect my technique without it, so I have to find it before I go to the Paradise Realm."
"I think I know something about the Blood Flame."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei [5] was shocked. "Do you know the location of the Blood Flame?"
"I don't know the exact location of the blood flame, but I have heard of the phenomenon that marks its appearance."
"What kind of phenomenon is that?"

"The red moon, or what is often referred to as the Blood Moon." Zhang Fei [5] stared at Lei Huoting in stupefaction. "According to legend, the first appearance of the Blood Moon will cause all living beings to go berserk, be they human, demon, beast, or even natural races. When the phenomenon reaches its peak, all living beings affected by it will die, and the moon will absorb their blood dry. The Blood Flame will emerge at that moment, but it will only last for a few hours. If no one takes the flame, it will vanish and reappear at the next phenomenon, which occurs once every thousand years in random realms."
"Are you sure about that?"
Lei Huoting shook her head. "I have never seen that phenomenon or the Blood Flame in person, and I only learned about it from my great-grandfather's stories."

"Actually, the phenomenon has occurred in the Demon Purgatory Realm, and almost all the demons in that realm have become berserk since its appearance, except for the undead demons." Zhang Fei [5]'s reply shocked Lei Huoting. "One of my clones is in seclusion in that realm, but my acquaintances there do not know the origin of that phenomenon. If your story is true and it is related to the birth of the Blood Flame, I must closely monitor changes in that realm, or it will be troublesome if I fail to obtain the Blood Flame this time."
"One of your clones?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "This body is also one of my clones, and my real body is focused on seclusion."
Lei Huoting narrowed her eyes and seriously observed Zhang Fei [5], but she felt that he was a real person and not a clone. "How can you create such a realistic clone?"
"It's my demon ability." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer made Lei Huoting furrow her brows, and he showed his lust demon form to her for a few moments before transforming into his complete fox form.
Lei Huoting nodded her head slightly. "You are the heir of the ten-tailed fox."

"Everyone says so, but I'm not sure about it yet." Zhang Fei [5] then returned to his human form. "Hey, I can't help you perfect your golden flame now, but I have many resources that can help you become stronger. I know you don't like crowds, but you can't go on like this, so I want to take you to a place to cultivate better. Additionally, the place is inhabited by beasts, mostly female ones, which should make you feel more at ease."
Lei Huoting looked distrustful of Zhang Fei [5]. Although he was the heir of the ten-tailed fox, she had never met him before.

Since Lei Huoting did not believe him, Zhang Fei [5] decided to take another approach to convince her. "What if I take you there first? After you see the situation there, you can decide whether to accept my offer or not, and I won't force you."
"All right."
Lei Huoting was amazed as soon as they entered the beast space, and she saw many familiar faces there, some of whom were her rivals, such as Yan Chengxin and Yuwen Xingyuan.

"Feng Qingmeng, Zhu Lingyao, and Huli Haohao also joined me." Lei Huoting turned to Zhang Fei [5] in confusion, especially since he didn't see the three women there. "They are training somewhere else, but I won't take you there, especially since that place is for my wife."

Although Zhang Fei [5] did not say it clearly, Lei Huoting immediately understood it. However, she didn't expect that Feng Qingmeng, Zhu Lingyao, and Huli Haohao would become romantically involved with him.
"What is your decision? Do you want to cultivate here with them?"
Lei Huoting looked at all the beasts before nodding. "I accept your offer to cultivate here."
"That's good." Zhang Fei [5] then grabbed Lei Huoting's hand and placed two pill bottles in her palm. "You can swallow them now, and I will meet your family to inform them of your departure."
"Yeah. Lei Huoting then looked for the quietest area, away from the other beasts, especially Lei Qiu, Tianguo, and Xue Bao.

At the Qilin clan, Zhang Fei [5] spoke to Lei Qiling and the others, informing them about Lei Huoting. Although they were surprised by her decision, they were also pleased that she was willing to leave her cave and gather with the other beasts.
"Does the situation in the Dragon Clan have anything to do with you?" Lei Qilin suddenly asked.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled and responded with a question. "Isn't that obvious, Senior? You don't need to think about the Dragon Clan; just focus on your cultivation here. If there are any changes in the situation, I will contact you again, and I hope you are willing to help me fight Xereth."
"As long as it is for the good of this universe and its inhabitants, we will definitely help you." Yan Feng and Lei Huolin nodded in agreement with their father.
Zhang Fei [5] was relieved by that. "In that case, I will leave now; I still have to take care of many things in other realms."

Lei Qilin also left the place after that, leaving Yan Feng and Lei Huolin smiling to themselves as they looked at their daughter's cave. "I hope that from today on, our daughter will start to change for the better, husband."

"I hope the same as you." Yan Feng hugged her waist and led her away. "I'm curious about Zhang Fei [5]'s secret place, and I'm sure it's a unique place for beasts like us. Otherwise, our daughter wouldn't have decided so quickly, especially since she doesn't know him yet."

"Rather than that place, I'm more curious about Zhang Fei's [5] intentions toward our daughter." Yan Feng turned to Lei Huolin with raised eyebrows. "That kid is a playboy, and our daughter is such a peerless beauty, so I'm sure he'll be interested in her. Unfortunately, he already has too many women, so I hope our daughter won't be tempted by him."
Yan Feng nodded in agreement. "I also hope our daughter won't fall for Zhang Fei [5], but we don't know what fate holds, so let's see the results when she comes back."
"Yeah."

After Zhang Fei [5] left the Qilin clan, he immediately went to Earth to pick up items there, and he also had to increase the supply for his three shops there. He also met all his slaves who lived there, and the situation there was much calmer because people from the Diyu and Tian Realms never came down to the human realm again.

After he settled matters on Earth, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Sky Jade Realm. As usual, he handed over earth items to people from the Chu Clan and the Shen Clan for his two shops in the Western and Southern Regions. He also met Feng Jinqiu and his two slaves, Chao Mojie and Long Jiutian, whom he placed there to ambush Fa Ling as soon as he arrived at the lower realms.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Nine Stars Realm to check the progress of the plan, but the small island had not yet been built, and the people there still needed some time to complete everything.

After he chatted with Yun Aoxian and the others, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Divine Flame Realm to meet Jiang Shen and take care of his stock there. He also went to the Alchemy Union to check on the progress of the True Foundation Pill, but Huoyun Zhiyan and the others still needed four to five months to finish concocting it.

Then, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, especially since Da Xiongmao sent him a voice transmission that the building was ready. He then filled the building with many items, including earth goods, alchemy-related items, and many others. He ordered the giant to run the shop instead of doing it himself.

Zhang Fei [5] also went to the Red Sun Realm to meet Huo Jiguang, especially since he wanted to help him sell his alchemy items. However, he hasn't seen him since their last meeting, mainly because he's been busy with many things. He decided to meet Mai Xiaomeng at the Zhang Clan; he sent her and several members of the Lunar Shadow Cat into his beast space.

After everything was settled, Zhang Fei [5] decided to go to the Starry Sky Realm, and the demon extermination sword led him to the ruins of the Jian Clan's residence. He honored the families of Jian Hei'an and Jian Guang'an, whom Xereth had slaughtered in the past, by pouring several jugs of wine there. He also decided to stay and cultivate there for a while so the two sword spirits could vent their longing.

In the Demon Purgatory Realm, Zhang [1] and Wang Yin stood side by side on a balcony. He explained to the female undead demon the information he got from Lei Huoting regarding the blood moon, causing her expression to become serious.
"Is it true that they will die when this blood moon phenomenon reaches its peak?"

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head in response. "Lei Huoting only heard about it from her great-grandparents, and she has never witnessed the truth herself. Therefore, we have no choice but to wait for this phenomenon to reach its peak, and we will get the truth then."
"Phew." Wang Yin let out a long sigh as she stared at the blood moon. "If all of them really died because of this phenomenon, this realm would be completely empty."
"Are you thinking about moving to another realm?"

Wang Yin shook her head in reply. "Even though this realm will become like a dead one, I will not move from here, and I will continue to wait here until that mysterious person comes again. Once I get an answer to that person's purpose in turning me into an undead, I will ask him to reverse this curse so that I can rest in peace forever."

Zhang Fei [1] chose not to comment on it, especially since he could see that Wang Yin had already made up her mind and would never change it. "I'll go back to them now, especially since I don't have much time to relax."
After Zhang Fei [1] left, Wang Yin also left her palace, and she went to check on the other demon emperors and empresses.

Quickly, another week passed. A black flying artifact slowly flew toward a planet. The female demon, Xue Yuemozi, stood in front of it and looked towards the realm. "Hehe! I finally found you, Alder! If I succeed in capturing you and your daughter, my lord will give me a generous gift, so I won't waste this opportunity."
As soon as Xue Yuemozi flew into the Netherworld Realm, the demon cultivators living there immediately noticed her arrival, including the wolf king, Alder.
Alder, Morgana, Oz the First, Ju Yingzhi, and Xin Yanluo immediately blocked Xue Yuemozi's path.
Ju Yingzhi stiffened after she saw Xue Yuemozi, and she clenched her fist so hard that her body trembled. Xin Yanluo immediately grabbed her hand, rubbed it, and calmed her down.
Xin Yanluo secretly sent a message to Zhang Fei, especially since Xue Yuemozi was much stronger than all of them.

"Hehehe!" Xue Yuemozi laughed horribly, and her gaze fell on Ju Yingzhi. "I originally came to this realm to capture that wolf demon, but I didn't expect to meet you here, Princess Yingzhi. Back then, you managed to escape from my subordinates, but you won't be able to escape anymore now. Since you are here now, I will capture you and hand you over to my lord, and he will absorb your rift abilities."

"Humph!" Ju Yingzhi snorted and summoned two transparent swords, pointing one of them at Xue Yuemozi. "Back then, you used underhanded means to slaughter my family and harm me, and I will avenge their deaths today."

"Let me join you." Alder spoke as he transformed into his half-wolf form, with both hands and feet becoming like wolf legs. "Yuemozi! I know you will find me sooner or later, but unfortunately, you won't be able to find my daughter. After I kill you, I will return to the Blackthorn Abyss Realm to settle accounts with those traitors and free my family."

"Where is your daughter?" Xue Yuemozi inquired as she unleashed her aura, causing Alder and the others to involuntarily drift backwards. "If you hand over your daughter, I will grant you an easy death."

"Haha." Alder laughed. "Keep dreaming! If you want my daughter, you can search for her all over the universe! Unfortunately, you will never be able to find her, especially since I have already handed her over to someone I can trust."
Xue Yuemozi frowned and moved to attack Alder, but Morgana was ready to stop her, and countless dark crows immediately appeared to attack her.

"Futile!" Xue Yuemozi's aura exploded, and Morgana's dark crows disappeared instantly. "If I recall correctly, you are the last witch demon of the Abyssal Realm, right? If I kill you now, your annoying race will disappear forever."
Oz the First frowned at that, and he pulled Morgana behind him. "Wife, unlock the seal on my soul."
"But—"
"Wife, we don't have another choice, so you can do it now." Oz the First nodded as he watched Xue Yuemozi's movements.
"Hmm?" Xue Yuemozi narrowed her eyes as Morgana took out the black key, and it gave her a bad vibe. "Do you think I'll let you do that?"
Xue Yuemozi immediately waved her hand, and a large black sickle flew towards them. However, Ju Yingzhi hurriedly cut through the air, and it shot into the hole that appeared there.
"What a troublesome ability!" Xue Yuemozi then moved toward Ju Yingzhi.
However, Ju Yingzhi already prepared a trap for Xue Yuemozi, and she quickly moved before taking her to the dimensional rift that she just created.

Despite this, Ju Yingzhi didn't have the confidence to imprison Xue Yuemozi for too long, especially since her cultivation and strength were higher than hers. "I don't know how long I can trap her inside, so you guys must remain vigilant."

chapters.title: Chapter 902: Spirit Willow Tree Seed
paragraphs: "What exactly is that black key?"

Oz the First summoned the soul, causing the others to frown. "I don't know where this soul came from, but it has been in my body for a long time. Over the past few months, some of my old memories have started to return, and I feel that this soul is a part of me."
"What will happen if your wife opens the seal?" Xin Yanluo asked.

"No one knows." Oz the First answered with a shake of his head. "I haven't gotten any information about this soul, so I'm hesitant to break the seal. I can feel that it holds tremendous power, and we might be able to defeat that female demon if I open the seal."
"You shouldn't do that." All of them looked at Feng Yichen, who had just walked out of the gate. Since they knew that the gate was one of Zhang Fei's abilities, they were not worried about her.
Morgana thought for a moment. "Are you the Dark Phoenix?"

chapters.title: Chapter 903: Yuan Tianling - Zhu Jian
paragraphs: "Have you heard of Zhang Xiaolong from the Scarlet Fox Race?"

Zhu Jian turned to Yuan Tianling, who was walking beside him. "I have never met a member of the Scarlet Fox Race, but I have heard of the name Zhang Xiaolong before. He is a Heavenly Fox Race member, but his name is just a pseudonym, and his real name is Zhang Fei."
'Could it be that they happened to have the same name?' Yuan Tianling then asked again. "Have you met Zhang Fei before?"

"I have never met him, but I have heard a lot about him." Yuan Tianling wore a curious look after Zhu Jian said that. "According to the stories I have heard, his cultivation is still within the ten mortal realms, specifically in the Heaven Realm, but he can fight against cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms. He can fight not just one but several of them at once."

"Wait a minute!" Yuan Tianling exclaimed softly. "The one I met in the Scorching Earth Realm also had a cultivation in the Heaven Realm, and he could fight against cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms. In fact, I witnessed him killing a demon with cultivation in the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, which was simply unbelievable."

Zhu Jian nodded his head slightly. "If your story is true, I believe they are the same man, and he is Zhang Fei, the Heavenly Fox. In fact, many cultivators in the Xianjin Realm greatly revere him, including the Nameless One. If it weren't for him, we would never have known about the threat of Xereth, and they wouldn't have been able to return in time to prepare defenses against the demon."
"Oh?" Yuan Tianling was surprised to hear that. "Please tell me more about Zhang Fei."

"Honestly, I don't know much about him, and the stories I heard about him mostly came from members of my clan who previously challenged the Sun Tower with our Matriarch." Zhu Jian then told Yuan Tianling all the stories he knew about Zhang Fei. "I don't know what your relationship is with him, but I advise you not to get too close to him."
"What do you mean by that?" Yuan Tianling frowned.

Zhu Jian let out a soft sigh. "Currently, the Dragon, Black Turtle, and White Tiger Races are targeting Zhang Fei. His exceptional talent intimidates the three clans, who fear he might surpass and dominate them; thus, they contemplate eliminating him. Apart from them, the matriarch of the Golden Fox Race also doesn't like him, but her fox race still hasn't made a decision about him, especially since their opinion is still divided in two."

"Cowards!" Yuan Tianling cursed angrily. "They are mythical beasts and senior cultivators, but they want to gang up on a young cultivator like Zhang Fei! If I were them, I would commit suicide in shame!"

Zhu Jian nodded in agreement with her. "Actually, one of my clan elders, Zhu Shanniang, also wanted to kill Zhang Fei. However, she intended to do so not because of her talent, but because she had long hated the Heavenly Fox Race."
"Humph!" Yuan Tianling snorted. "If Zhu Shanniang dares to hurt Zhang Fei, I will pluck all her feathers. I will roast her alive, and I will eat her bird meat!"

Zhu Jian fell dumbstruck as he stared at Yuan Tianling. "How are you going to do it? Elder Shanniang's cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, and your cultivation is still at the 1-Moon."

"Even if I couldn't kill her myself, my parents could easily kill her." Yuan Tianling replied nonchalantly, which caused Zhu Jian to frown. "If your race members interfere in our problems, I will ask my grandparents to fight you. They pamper me very much, and they will never refuse my request. Moreover, their cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, so you guys are not their opponents."

'This woman! She has no shame!' Zhu Jian then spoke to her. "I think Elder Shanniang will not do anything to Zhang Fei, especially since Matriarch Hong has strictly forbidden her from looking for trouble with him."

Yuan Tianling shook her head. "You may be right about that, but you yourself said earlier that Zhu Shanniang hates the Heavenly Fox Race so much. She may not dare to act openly, but she can still do it secretly by conspiring with those coward beasts, right?"
"You're right." Zhu Jian answered with a soft sigh. "Elder Shanniang has a close relationship with Huli Xianniang, and they might work together to fight Zhang Fei."
Yuan Tianling thought for a while. "Do you know where Zhang Fei is now?"
"I don't know." Zhu Jian's answer disappointed Yuan Tianling. "Actually, I heard that he has several clones, and he sent them to different realms, one of which is the Xianjin Realm."
'Could it be that the one I met in the Scorching Earth Realm was one of his clones?' Yuan Tianling inwardly wondered. "Do you know which realms he sent his clones to?"

"Zhang Fei has close ties with the Phoenix Clan, and there are rumors that he is Princess Feng Yao's fiancé, so I thought he or his clone was there." Black lines appeared on Yuan Tianling's forehead, but she remembered that Zhang Fei was a dual cultivator. "Some time ago, he caused a commotion at the Sky Dragon Island, but I thought it was one of his clones, especially since that realm is too far away and borders the middle realms."
Yuan Tianling nodded in understanding. "Bring me to the Phoenix Realm; I want to confirm whether they are really the same man."
"Huh?" Zhu Jian stopped walking immediately. "Senior Sister, your parents don't want others to know about your presence here, so—"
"Bring me there, or I'll pluck all your feathers right now." Yuan Tianling threatened Zhu Jian while releasing her aura.
"But—" Yuan Tianling grabbed Zhu Jian's collar and stared at him with killing intent, making him swallow his saliva. "Okay, I'll take you to the Phoenix Realm, but it will take ten days."
"Let's go!"
'This woman is making things difficult for me.' Zhu Jian massaged his forehead as he sighed softly, and he immediately followed Yuan Tianling.

Xereth was furious after Mo Zhuo reported to him that he had not managed to find the Heavenly Fox Race, but he was even more furious after he couldn't contact Xue Yuemozi, and he immediately suspected that something had happened to her.

"I'm sure that brat already killed or captured Xue Yuemozi, and Feng Zichen helped him with that." Xereth then contacted Fa Ling to find out her whereabouts, and she informed him that she had entered the Lower Realm.
Xereth panicked when Fa Ling told him that Long Jiutian contacted her, and she told the blood demon dragon her position.

Xereth immediately ordered Fa Ling to avoid Long Jiutian, Feng Yichen, Xue Yuemozi, and Chao Mojie. "Damn it!! I forgot to tell her that shitty dragon was getting caught by the enemy! I hope they don't meet in the lower realms, or she will die in his hands."
"My injuries have almost completely recovered, and I will look for those shitty foxes after that." Xereth immediately closed his eyes again and focused on his injuries.
"What makes you happy, Big Brother? Why are you suddenly smiling to yourself?" Zhang Lin inquired as she nestled against Zhang Fei's left side.
Nestled to Zhang Fei's right, Zhang Yue also asked a question. "Are you ready to break through to the 5-Star Heaven Realm?"

"You are right; my cultivation is almost breaking through to the 5-Star Heaven Realm, and I can do it today." Zhang Fei hugged the two women even tighter. "I am smiling not because of that, but because Fa Ling has arrived in the Lower Realms. I will not take care of her myself; instead, I will let my two slaves handle it. After they cripple her, I will absorb her demon power."

Qing Yi, who was beside Zhang Yue, immediately spoke. "Fei'er, Xereth must have told Fa Ling about Long Jiutian and Chao Ren, so I'm sure she won't be captured easily. She might take a detour to avoid your slaves, so you must move them to Earth, and she won't suspect that they are waiting for her there."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei immediately used his fifth clone to go to the Sky Jade Realm, and he moved the two slaves to Earth, ordering them to wait for Fa Ling there. "You guys can rest first, and I'll go meet the others now."
Qing Yi, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin immediately rested as soon as Zhang Fei left.

Zhang Fei himself went straight to meet the three Chu sisters, and he had fun with them in turn. Chu Qing and Chu Xing competed with each other to please him, and they even said obscene words during their sex. Unlike her two sisters, Chu Ying remained calm as usual, and she could be said to be one of the calmest of his wives.

Once he had finished with them, Zhang Fei proceeded to each of his other wives' rooms individually. He started with Ru Xue and ended with Helian Yueyi, which lasted for several days based on the flow of time in the training space.

Zhang Fei continued with Murong Qianying and her two daughters, but Shang Yaolin and Shang Yumei were annoyed because their mother could dual-cultivate for real with him, and they could only do so with him through their back door. Thereafter, he had fun with Hong Xinxin, Han Yuanzhi, and Fei Qinyuan. He stored all their Yin Qi in bottles for future use.

Zhang Fei did not immediately dual cultivate with his other women, but instead, he left the training space to break through to the 5-Star Heaven Realm. After he finished breaking through, he went back inside and had fun with the others, starting with the seven women from Earth. As for Shi Wu and Shi Xi, they were just as intimate with him as usual, and he supplied them with plenty of his Yang Qi.

Zhang Fei's relationship with Guo Lan has also improved significantly, and they are often intimate. She actually wanted to give herself to him, but he asked her to wait until her cultivation reached at least the Heaven Realm.

Afterwards, Zhang Fei accompanied all his other unofficial women, but he still hadn't managed to find a cure for Mu Lingshu's condition; not even Tian Yishen could cure her, so they hadn't done anything other than regular intimate relations. He dual cultivated with most of them through their back doors, and he gave them as much of his Yang Qi as possible. Even though they haven't dual cultivated for real, he could still obtain a lot of their Yin Qi, so he didn't have any problems with that.

Many of them didn't like that, so they were just casually intimate with Zhang Fei, such as Shang Xinyu, Shang Yifen, Murong Mengying, and Wang Yourou. Since they produced a lot of Yin Qi, he stored their Yin for future use.
Among his unofficial women, only Shen Huang, Xing Mei, and Lian Xing have started to dual cultivate for real with him.

Xing Mei had long been ready to dual cultivate with Zhang Fei, especially after her husband, Gu Tong, decided to leave her. Lian Xing was not much different from her, and she had been prepared after he brought her to the Nine Stars Realm.

Even though she had lived for a long time and been intimate with Zhang Fei many times, Shen Huang never felt ready to become his woman. She even asked him to accept her daughter, Shen Xinya, but he refused.

Shen Xinya had indeed changed a lot, but Zhang Fei felt that her changes were still not enough, and she had never tried to prove herself to him either. In the end, he decided to use a little coercion, and Shen Huang ended up dual cultivating with him, which lasted for two days.

Since then, ten days have passed in the outside world. Both Zhang Fei and his five clones have never left their isolation, and they have been relentlessly dual-cultivating and dual-soul-cultivating with their respective partners.
"They have already begun to show signs of turning into demons." Wang Yin then gestured toward Ling Long. "She is the fastest to change among them, and she is already halfway there now."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement. "Ling Long already has the marionette demon bloodline in her body, so she will become a demon faster than the others."

"Marionette demon, huh?" Wang Yin muttered as she nodded. "That demon is quite rare, and her cultivation is already quite high. If she fights by your side, she can help you control the movements of your enemies using her techniques."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei [1] then looked at Luo Yu. "She will change after Ling Long, but I think she will become a demon beast, especially since her true identity is the Silver Silkworm Beast."
Wang Lin propped her chin and observed Luo Yu. "I wonder what kind of demon beast she will become, but I'm sure she will still maintain her original traits."

"Haha! I can't wait to see her transformation as a demon beast." Zhang Fei [1] suddenly raised his eyebrows, especially since a voice transmission entered his mind, which came from Feng Xueying. "It seems like another trouble has come to me."
"What kind of trouble? Do you need my help?" Wang Yin asked.
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head. "You may be an undead demon, but you can't help me with this matter. Moreover, I have several powerful people by my side, so I can handle it myself."
"I see." Wang Yin then turned to leave. "I'm going to meet Morgana and her husband."

Since all his partners were progressing in their cultivation, and some of them were close to breaking through, Zhang Fei [1] decided to go to another area of the palace, where Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo lived.

Even though Ju Yingzhi's injury had healed, her strength had not fully returned and her soul was too weak, so Zhang Fei [1] wanted to help her. There, he dual-soul cultivated with her and Xin Yanluo, especially since he already had long-term plans for both of them.
A flying artifact landed in front of the Phoenix Castle, and a woman descended from it. However, Feng Shen and Feng Xueying immediately appeared in front of her, and their strength surprised her.
"Are the two of you the ancestors of your race?" The woman inquired in an impolite manner.
Feng Shen wanted to answer her, but Feng Xueying stopped him. "As an uninvited guest, you should introduce yourself first, unless you have no manners."

'This bitch! A lowly beast like her dares to be impudent in front of me.' The woman then introduced herself. "My name is Leng Xueyan, and you don't need to ask about my origin realm, especially since you two have never heard of it."

"The Sovereign Heaven Realm, right?" Leng Xueyan frowned at Feng Xueying. "If you came here to ask about our leaders and princess, you should already know that they are no longer here, so your coming to our realm was in vain."
Leng Yueyan already knew that, but she would rather not give up so easily after she had traveled so far. "Tell me how to open the portal in the stone monument."

"Do you think we know that?" Feng Xueying shook her head in response. "The only one who knows about it is our princess, and she has already gone up there. If you want to know how to go there, then you have to follow her."
"You—" Leng Xueyan stopped her words and looked at Zhang Fei [5], who had just arrived in his half-fox form. "Seven-tailed Heavenly Fox?"

Zhang Fei [5] landed in front of Feng Shen and Feng Xueying, and the ice phoenix informed him about Leng Yueyan's purpose for coming. He then spoke to the guest. "I know about the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and I also know about the realm beyond. Feng Yao is the only one who knows how to get there, and she has never told anyone, so please don't cause a scene in this realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 904: Trapping Leng Xueyan
paragraphs: "Heh." Leng Xueyan snorted. "What are you going to do if I make a scene here? The two phoenixes behind you are indeed powerful, but you are just a speck of dust in my eyes, and I can crush you without having to move."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head and spoke to her. "Standing at the peak of mortal cultivation for too long has blinded your eyes and mind, and you have become too arrogant because of it."
Leng Xueyan wanted to attack Zhang Fei [5], but she instantly froze as soon as he released his killing intent, combined with his strength, which he borrowed from all the beasts in the beast space.

"You are powerful, but you forget many mysteries in this universe, and there is another sky above the sky." Zhang Fei [5] took out the moonlit whisper sword and pointed it at her. paragraphs: "What do you mean by becoming a cultivator by chance?" Zhang Fei [5] smiled at Yuan Tianling's confused expression before explaining it briefly to her. "Are you able to cultivate this fast because you are a dual cultivator? How many women do you have?"

"You will meet them soon, but you better prepare yourself mentally, especially since their numbers are far greater than you imagine." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer caused Yuan Tianling to let out a heavy sigh and clasp her hands together. "If you were disappointed by that, you can forget about me and go back to your old life."

Yuan Tianling hugged her legs and buried her face between them. "I don't know whether I'm disappointed or not, especially since I knew from the start that you were a dual cultivator. Moreover, you never did anything to me during our month in the lava, and I did that of my own free will. Are they all good and strong women?"

"Many of them are stronger than me, but many of them are weaker than me." Yuan Tianling tilted her head and looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Whether they are good or not depends on each person's opinion, but they are the best for me. Otherwise, I wouldn't accept them as my women, right?"
Yuan Tianling gave a light nod. "Bring me to meet them after this, okay?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] and Yuan Tianling discussed other topics while waiting for Leng Xueyan to become exhausted.
In the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Yuan Tiancheng and the others immediately met Tian Jingxuan and the other leaders. They shared their findings about Xereth, which caused everyone to frown.

Tian Jingxuan then explained to them. "About two weeks ago, three people from the Phoenix Race entered our realm, and one of them held a token that belonged to my late ancestor, Tian Kongquan. Besides, she knew about that thing, and she also knew your past ancestors."

"Hasn't that little girl completed her transformation yet?" Wang Yin asked Zhang Fei [1] as she entered the room, followed by Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo.

As she looked at the cocoon made of red thread, Zhang Fei [1] answered her. "Ling Long has transformed into a demon, but she is in the final process of her transformation, and it will be completed in a while."
"Is she really going to turn into a marionette demon?" Ju Yingzhi asked.
Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "Her demon form was influenced by her demon bloodline, and she has become a marionette demon now."
After they waited for a while, the cocoons made of red thread finally separated from each other, and they floated around Ling Long.

Ling Long's appearance changed drastically after she became a demon, and she looked terrific. She has striking long hair colored in black and white, styled to flow dramatically. Her expression was intense and evil, with crimson eyes and a demon mark on her forehead. She wore a dark dress with intricate embroidery, adorned with marionette-like threads extending from her fingers. Her hands controlled several ghostly, puppet-like figures suspended in midair by magical strings.
"She really became a marionette demon." The three female demons exclaimed.
"Phew." Ling Long exhaled softly before looking at the three female demons, and she moved the red strings around her towards them.
Wang Yin swiftly cut the red strings attached to her body. Unlike her, Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo couldn't do it, and Ling Long directly took control of their bodies.
"Hey! Stop it!" Xin Yanluo shouted at Ling Long because she couldn't control her body.
Ju Yingzhi, on the other hand, remained calm and let Ling Long control her body, especially since she was curious about the extent of the effects of her demon abilities.
Ling Long smirked in response to Xin Yanluo's complaint, and she controlled her to kiss Zhang Fei [1], causing her eyes to widen.
However, Ling Long immediately pulled Xin Yanluo back and did the same to Yu Jingzhi; she forced her to kiss Zhang Fei [1], causing her to sigh inwardly.
"Stop playing around, Long'er."

Ling Long pursed her lips and pulled back her red threads from Xin Yanluo and Ju Yingzhi's bodies, and the two female demons immediately fled from the room, making Wang Yin smile in amusement. "After you become a marionette demon, your marionette heavenly arts should become more potent. "You're right." Ling Long took a mirror, looked at her demon appearance, and returned to her human form. "Sigh! My demon form is so ugly and scary! Even I'm scared to see my own demon form."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed at that. "Since your demon rank is still at the lesser rank, I will send you back to the pavilion, and my real body will help you increase your demon rank."
Ling Long nodded in agreement. "Send me back."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "I think this blood moon phenomenon will reach its peak in some time, but the other demons in this realm will die because of it."
"Do you have a solution to save them?" Wang Yin asked with expectation.

Zhang Fei [1] let out a soft sigh. "You should already know that I can save them, but I would rather not do it. First, I don't know them. Second, I need the Blood Flame. I don't know if the flame will be born if they don't die, and I'll have to wait a thousand years if I fail to get it this time, so I don't want to take the risk."
"At least, you can save those emperors and empresses, right?"

"Hmm?" Zhangi [1] frowned, but Mei said it was okay as long as the other demons stayed and died because of the phenomenon. "All right, I will save those demons as my gratitude to you, but I cannot fight them by myself, or I will kill them. Therefore, you must bring them to me, and I will send them to the Nine Hells Darkland."
"Thank you." Wang Yin sincerely said.

Wang Yin then summoned Shou Fubai to him, and the two of them quickly moved to immobilize those emperors and empresses. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] watched their movements from the palace, and the two of them were forced to fight with those demons.

Despite this, Wang Yin and Shou Fubai needed quite a lot of time to immobilize them, and Zhang Fei [1] directly sent them to the Nine Hells Darkland afterwards.
"Thank you."
"No need." Zhang Fei [1] then walked away. "I will return to seclusion now, while waiting for Luo Yu and the others to turn into demons."
On the other hand, Wang Yin stood with her hands behind her waist, and her eyes continued to watch the blood moon, contemplating when the phenomenon would reach its peak.

Another week passed, and Zhang Fei [5] was very serious in the blood pond. After he waited several months, his body cultivation finally broke through to the fourth stage, the Meridian Cleansing Stage.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host's body cultivation has broken through to the Meridian Cleansing Stage.]
[The host's Qi circulation has increased by 10 percent, endurance by 20 percent, and raw strength by 20 percent.]

[Master, I think you should learn a new body cultivation technique, and it would be better if it was related to the fire element. It can not only increase your body strength, but it will also strengthen your fire elements and techniques.]

[I don't have any information about it, but you have many fire element beasts in your beast space, so I thought you could ask one of them.]

Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly got dressed before going to meet Feng Qingmeng, Huli Haohao, and Zhu Lingyao. Unfortunately, the three female beasts are not body cultivators, so they don't have that kind of technique.

Zhang Fei [5] entered the beast space to meet Yan Jinwu and the people from her golden crow race, but they were not body cultivators either. Zhang Fei [5] then met the last beast, Lei Huoting. To his surprise, she was a body cultivator, and her body cultivation level had already broken through to the fourth stage of the eight body gates, the Golden Body Stage. "Is your body cultivation technique related to the fire element?"
"Yes." Lei Huoting nodded at him before asking. "Do you want to learn my technique?"
"Is it okay if I learn it?" Lei Huoting immediately stood up and touched Zhang Fei [5]'s forehead, imparting her technique to him.
[Obtained the Scarlet Furnace Body Method. Grade: Divine.]
'Another divine-grade body cultivation technique!' Zhang Fei [5] was satisfied with that. "Thank you."
Lei Huoting shook her head at him. "I wasn't a body cultivator before I discovered my technique, and I started learning it after I accidentally discovered it in an ancient ruin in another realm."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "In that case, you can continue your cultivation, and I will go out to learn the body technique."

After Zhang Fei [5] left, Lei Huoting sat in her previous position and continued her cultivation, but she wondered about his purpose for studying another body cultivation technique. 'Is it possible for a body cultivator to practice several body techniques at once?'
As soon as he returned to the pavilion, Zhang Fei [5] immediately sat down in the main garden and read the technique he had just gotten from Luo Huoting.

[The Scarlet Furnace Body Method tempers the cultivator's body by turning it into a living furnace. By drawing in external flames and refining them within, the cultivator's body becomes a smoldering crucible—resistant to heat, able to burn impurities, and capable of explosive internal qi combustion.]

"Hmm? Turning our bodies into a living furnace sounds scary." Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself. "This technique has five stages, like the Heavenly Lightning Body Technique: ember bone, molten flesh, blazing meridians, furnace core, and infernal body. Each stage will increase my body strength by 10%, but it does not increase my raw strength. However, each stage will increase my fire element by 20%, both attack and defense, which is excellent for a fire cultivator like me."

Since the body cultivation technique requires the help of external flames to practice it, Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned four female beasts to help him. Soon, Feng Qingmeng, Zhu Lingyao, Feng Yichen, and Yan Jinwu arrived before him. "I want the four of you to channel your flames into my body, and I will refine them to forge my body and turn it into a furnace."

The four female beasts were shocked by Zhang Fei [5] 's request. Feng Qingmeng then spoke to him. "Are you sure about that? I know your flame element and flame elemental law are at their maximum, but our flames are different from other flames. Moreover, you want the four of us to channel them into your body at the same time, so I'm not sure you can withstand the effects, and you might suffer serious injuries from our flames."

"I understand the risks, but I have to do it to learn my new body technique." The four frowned at Zhang Fei [5]. "All right, you guys don't have to worry too much and sit around me, and we will start right away."

chapters.title: Chapter 908: Three Bloodlines
paragraphs: "Wait a minute." Huli Haohao suddenly stopped them. "I have a much better idea for you. Do you want to hear it?"
Zhang Fei nodded to her. "Please tell me your idea."

"To make things easier and significantly enhance your training effectiveness, the three of them must provide you with their bloodlines." The four female beasts looked at Huli Haohao with raised eyebrows. "Why are you all reacting like this? Zhang Fei is your man, so there should be no problem if each of you gives him a few drops of your origin bloodline, right? If he inherits your bloodlines, he can control your flames easily, and his mastery of the Scarlet Furnace Body Method will increase even faster."
'Haohao is right.' Zhu Lingyao nodded to the other three women. 'Since we have chosen him as our man, I think we can give him a few drops of our origin bloodline.'
"I agree." Yan Jinwu then spoke to the two female phoenixes. "Fire Phoenix and Dark Phoenix are essentially the same race, so I think only one of you needs to give your origin bloodline to him."

Feng Qingmeng and Feng Yichen exchanged questioning glances, but Huli Haohao immediately spoke again. "Senior Yichen, I think the best choice is your bloodline, especially since you have fire and darkness elements like him."
"Yeah." Feng Yichen replied with a nod. "Let's do it then."
"We should do it one by one."

"No need." Zhang Fei stood up and took out the science capsule, shocking the five female beasts who saw it for the first time. "Don't ask about its origin, especially since I can't explain it to you all yet. After I lie down inside, you can drip a few drops of your origin bloodlines into the tubes, and this device will work by itself, which makes the process faster and less painful."

They could only shake their heads because Zhang Fei was always secretive about several things, including the origin of the pills. After he laid down in the science capsule, they took turns dripping their origin bloodlines into the tubes as per his instructions.

Yan Jinwu gave Zhang Fei three drops of her golden crow origin bloodline, and Zhu Lingyao gave him five drops of her vermilion origin bloodline. Unlike them, Feng Yichen gave him ten drops of her dark phoenix origin bloodline, especially since she didn't want to be on an equal footing with the two women.
Huli Haohao took the initiative to give Zhang Fei five drops of her golden fox origin bloodline.
After they did that, Mei activated the science capsule, and the four mythical beasts' bloodlines quickly entered Zhang Fei's body, spreading throughout his body at the same time.
"What do you think will happen to him? Will he be able to use the abilities of our races?" Yan Jinwu asked them.

Huli Haohao nodded at her. "He should be able to use our strengths and abilities, but he can't use them to their full potential, especially since he won't inherit our souls and physiques. However, it should be enough for him, and he can combine our strengths and abilities with his."
"Are you sure this won't be a problem for the three of you?" Feng Qingmeng asked Yan Jinwu, Zu Lingyao, and Huli Haohao.
"Huli Xianniang and Huli Jinhu will be furious if they know that I gave my origin bloodline to Zhang Fei, but I can't care about their reactions." Huli Haohao was the first to answer.
Zhu Lingyao smiled before replying. 'Zhu Hong and the others won't mind my decision, but my sister will be furious, especially with her hatred for the Heavenly Fox Race.'

"Zhu Shanniang's hatred for the Heavenly Fox Race is simply unreasonable!" Yan Jinwu said as she shook her head. "My Golden Crow Race has already decided not to cross paths with Zhang Fei, so they shouldn't have a problem with my decision. By the way, he would be even stronger if he could obtain the other two fire mystical beasts, but I'm not sure if they would be willing to give him their bloodline."
"Lei Huoting is half Fire Qilin, and Long Zhenxia is the flame dragon." Feng Qingmeng said.

Zhu Lingyao nodded slightly. 'Lei Huoting hasn't known Zhang Fei for long, so she probably won't be willing to give him the origin bloodline of her fire Qilin. His problems with the Dragon Clan aren't over yet, and Long Zhenxia is part of them, so I don't think it can be done for now.'

"Instead of thinking about those two women, he should look for bloodline beasts with ice, light, wind, and water elements. Obtaining them would enhance his four elements even more." They agreed with Feng Yichen, but getting the four of them was not a simple matter. "Kunpeng has wind and water elements, right? Feng Xueying is an ice phoenix, and they are close to each other. As for the beast with the light element, I don't have any ideas about it."

Huli Haohao immediately told them. "Fu Xin and her Fu Clan are the mythical deer beast race, and they have a high affinity with the light element. Unfortunately, they do not have a branch clan in this realm, and they live in the Radiant Sky Realm. Moreover, Zhang Fei does not know them yet, and he does not want to go anywhere to focus completely on himself, so it will not happen anytime soon."

"Zhang Fei may be close to Ancestor Xueying, but I'm not sure that she would be willing to give her ice phoenix bloodline to him. Yuwen Xingyuan is also not an easy woman, so I'm sure she won't fulfill her request unless he uses his demon abilities to subdue her." Feng Qingmeng's words made the others smile bitterly, but they thought that it was the simplest and quickest solution to subdue the female Kunpeng Bird.
Two hours later.
[Obtained Golden Crow Origin Bloodline.]
[Obtained Dark Phoenix Origin Bloodline.]
[Obtained Vermilion Bird Origin Bloodline.]
[Obtained Golden Fox Origin Bloodline.]
Four consecutive notifications appeared in Zhang Fei's mind as the process ended, and Mei immediately opened the glass cover of the capsule.

Zhang Fei immediately came out of the capsule and checked his whole body. Even though he didn't experience any significant improvement in his physique, he could feel that his fire element had become stronger thanks to the three flame mythical beast bloodlines. Besides, his natural charm also increased, which was due to Huli Haohao's Golden Fox Origin Bloodline.

Zhang Fei extended both hands forward before using his fire element, and four different flames appeared above his palms. The four flames were his original dark flame, the deep red flame of the vermilion bird, the golden red flame of the golden crow, and the dark crimson flame of the dark phoenix.
"Wow!" Yan Jinwu exclaimed when she saw the four flames. "You just got our bloodlines, but you can use our flames right away."

"Your flames are different, but they're basically the same, so I can use them easily." Zhang Fei paused to think before he brought the four flames closer together, which shocked Zhu Lingyao and the others. However, the four different flames quickly merged into one, forming a flame vortex with several different colors. "Combining my flames is much easier than combining my flame with my ice element, and this one is much stronger than my original dark flame."

"In this universe, you are probably the only person who dares to try combining flame and ice together, but your idea resulted in your Hellflame Frost Lotus." Hulai Haohao then asked him. "What is the name of this new technique of yours?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought as he observed his flame. "Even though I haven't tried its explosive power, it should be stronger than my Hellflame Frost Lotus, especially since it's a combination of four different flames."
"How about we try your new technique in the outside world first?"
"All right."
A while later, they had arrived at the Nine Stars Darkland. Zhang Fei intentionally brought them to that realm because there were no humans in it, and only demon beasts lived there.
"Try it now; I'm curious about its explosive power." Feng Qingmeng and the others nodded in agreement with Yan Jinwu; even Feng Yichen was also curious about it.
Zhang Fei first turned the flame in his hand into a ball, and he infused his fire elemental law into it, making it several times stronger.
"Hmm? Let's see the explosive power with my maximum power." Zhang Fei immediately threw his flame quite far away, and it slammed into a distant area not long after.
*Boom... Boom....*
A loud explosion sounded in the area; Zhang Fei's flames soared high into the sky and formed a flame vortex, followed by waves of strong winds sweeping across the realm.
"Oh my gosh!" The female beasts exclaimed as the waves of wind swept towards them, and the heat generated by Zhang Fei's attack could still be felt from quite a distance away.
"How can your flame's explosive power be this strong?" Huli Haohao asked.
Zhu Lingyao pointed in that direction. 'Look at that—the power of his flame is not decreasing; it is actually increasing.'
"The flame vortex also expands and burns a wider area." Feng Qingmeng muttered to herself.
Yan Jinwu released a soft sigh as she shook her head. "Even my golden flame is not that strong."
"My dark flame is also inferior to it." Feng Yichen commented briefly.

"Haha! In fact, my flame power is 400 percent higher than it should be, which is thanks to my Yin-Yang Fire Art." They turned to Zhang Fei with questioning looks. "I got the technique in a hidden floor in the Star Tower, but I need the ten heavenly flames to learn it, and each flame increases the power of my fire element by 100 percent. Currently, I have obtained four of them, so my fire element power has increased by that much. After I get the Blood and Sky Flames, my power will increase by another 200 percent."

Zhang Fei's explanation caused Feng Yichen and the others to fall dumbstruck, especially since the 100 percent increase for each flame was simply too much. Moreover, there are still six heavens left, and his fire element power can still increase by 600 percent. Additionally, his new body cultivation technique will increase his fire element power by 20 percent for each of its five levels, resulting in a total increase of 100 percent when he reaches the final stage.
"Your technique is incredibly insane!" Yan Jinwu exclaimed after returning to her senses. "Can you teach us that technique?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "You guys can learn the technique, but you will never be able to perfect it, especially since some of the ten heavenly flames only exist once in this universe."

"Forget it." Yan Jinwu replied with a soft sigh. "Since we can't perfect it, then there's no point for us to learn it. Instead, you can help us to master the Scarlet Furnace Body Method that you got from Luo Huoting, so our physical strength and our fire elements will increase significantly."
"Before that, we have to help him first, and he can help us after." They nodded in agreement with Feng Qingmeng.

After he extinguished his flame, Zhang Fei brought them back to the pavilion, and immediately they helped him study the Scarlet Furnace Body Method. Their bloodlines in his body allowed him to easily accommodate the power of their flames, just as Huli Haohao had anticipated.

With their help and the comprehension method, it didn't take Zhang Fei too long to master the technique, and he had reached the ember bone stage in just under an hour, which increased his body strength by 10 percent and fire element by 20 percent.

However, Zhang Fei did not want to stop there, and he wanted to immediately break through to the next stage. Although the women also wanted to learn the technique, they chose to help him first, and he imparted the technique to them.

Zhang Fei decided to switch places with his fifth clone, especially since he had to help all his women to improve their cultivation and soul power. He first helped them learn the Scarlet Furnace Body Method, but he only taught it to those with the fire element, especially since the method for learning it was different from the heavenly lightning body technique.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei's four clones also taught the technique to their respective partners, but only to those who have the fire element, just like his main harem members.
In his hiding place, Xereth wore a gloomy expression, especially after he failed to contact Fa Ling.

"Fuck! All my plans have gone awry, and almost all my men have fallen into the enemy's hands, either dead or captured by them. Only Mo Zhuo remains now, and that fool still hasn't discovered the Heavenly Foxes' hiding place." Xereth immediately stood up from his seat. "I have to go to several demon realms to find new subordinates, or my master will kill me if I haven't managed to complete all my tasks by the time limit."

As soon as Xereth removed his barrier, dozens of golden swords plunged toward him. He immediately dodged them, released his black scythe, and counterattacked Tian Huangjin, who was flying towards him.
Tian Huangjin narrowed her eyes, dodged to the side, and deflected some of Xereth's attacks.

"Bitch! I don't have time to deal with you now!" Xereth immediately unleashed his full power, released his darkness, and used a technique to increase his strength further. He shot toward Tian Huangjin, who was trying to escape his darkness. "You have been bothering me time and time again, so it is time for me to settle accounts with you."
'Crap!' Tian Huangjin spun around and parried Xereth's black scythe, but his darkness quickly invaded her body, causing her to grimace in pain.

"Heh!" Xereth snorted and swung his black scythe towards Tian Huangjin again; he blasted her towards the ground. The demon dived toward the female winged race to kill her, but she deflected his scythe.

"Argh!" Tian Huangjin screamed in pain after Xereth's black scythe scratched her left shoulder, causing it to bleed. At the same time, his darkness entered her body through her wound, causing her strength to become unstable. 'Shit! His darkness disrupts my power.'

"Die!" Xereth once again attacked Tian Huangjin, but she quickly grabbed her golden necklace just before the blade pierced her chest. A golden light emerged from the necklace and blasted the demon away from her. "Fuck!"

Xereth immediately stabilized himself in the air and looked at Tian Huangjin, but a man's figure with six golden wings covered his sight. The appearance of the man made him become serious and nervous, and he squeezed the handle of his black scythe tightly.
"Are you okay, daughter?" The man asked in a soft voice, but his eyes narrowed toward Xereth.

"Cough... Cough..." Tian Huangjin coughed as she held her left shoulder. "Father, I don't know what he used earlier, but his darkness was able to penetrate my golden protection, and it invaded my body."

"Hmm?" The man turned to Tian Huangjin and grabbed her left shoulder. A golden light appeared from his hand, healing her wound and dispelling Xereth's darkness from her body. "I'm familiar with this darkness, and it should belong to Taotie."
Tian Huangjin nodded at him. "Xereth is indeed Taotie's subordinate, and he once summoned his avatar here."
"I see." The man then looked at Xereth, and a few golden swords appeared above his head. "Since you dare to hurt my daughter, you must suffer the consequences."
"Shit!" Xereth flew away as soon as those golden swords flew toward him, but several golden threads suddenly appeared and bound him, preventing him from dodging them.
*Stab... Stab... Stab...*

"Gahhhh!" The attacks had left Xereth's body covered in wounds, from which black blood flowed. However, his blood quickly covered him, and he disappeared from that realm. "I will definitely repay today's events several times over!"
"Why didn't you kill Xereth, Father?" Tian Huangjin asked in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 909: Tian Huangjin Left
paragraphs: The man let out a soft sigh as he gently rubbed Tian Huangjin's head. "You've left our domain for so long to hunt that demon, so you don't know much of what has happened in the past few hundred years there, and the Paradise Realm is in great turmoil now."

"Hmm?" Tian Huangjin frowned in response, but the man immediately told her many incidents that happened in the Paradise Realm. "In my entire life, I never imagined that the Celestial Demon Race and the Asura Demon Race would unite, let alone that what united them was a marriage relationship. Moreover, they had been passive for hundreds of years, but they suddenly made a move by attacking the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain."

"Fortunately, they had Long Wuzhao and the others, and they repeatedly repelled them. In fact, the Celestial Demon God and the Asura Demon God were hiding in their respective realms, and both of them were seriously injured by the Dragon Emperor's attack." Tian Huangjin was not surprised to hear this because the five-clawed golden dragon is the strongest being in the Paradise Realm, and his strength seems limitless. "How was your adventure in the three mortal realms? Did you find many intriguing things besides your hunt for Xereth?"

"Father, I met our first ancestor's reincarnation." The man froze after Tian Huangjin said that. "I didn't lie to you, Father. I met her two and a half months ago, and her reincarnation was an 11-year-old little girl named Xu Ling'er. She is with Zhang Fei now, and that little guy is also a unique creature because he has three identities in one body."
"Three identities in one body?"
"Zhang Fei is a human, a heavenly fox, and a lust demon."
"What?" The man exclaimed in shock before grabbing her shoulders. "Are you sure that Zhang Fei is a human, a heavenly fox, and a lust demon?"
"I've seen all three of his identities myself."

"I see." The man pulled back his hand and muttered. "I never thought that the prophecy would really come true, and the peacemaker was already born in this universe. Based on the prophecy, our first ancestor will be his right-hand man, and the first demon ancestor will be his left-hand man."
"Huh?" Tian Huangjin blinked her eyes repeatedly. "What kind of prophecy do you mean by that, Father? Do you mean the reincarnation of the first demon ancestor?"

"The prophecy says that one day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again. He is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon. He is the one who will bring peace to humans, demons, and natural races." The man's answer stunned Tian Huangjin. "At that time, the reincarnations of the ancestors of all races will join him and fight by his side, but only two will stand beside him: one is our first ancestor, and the other one is the first demon ancestor."

"Is Zhang Fei really the person destined to be the peacemaker? Why were only our first ancestor and the first demon ancestor chosen to stand by his side? Aren't the first ancestors of the beast and natural races stronger than them?" Tian Huangjin asked in confusion.

The man released a soft sigh. "Daughter, you should know that the ten-tailed fox is not an ordinary beast, and he stands above all beasts, including the Dragon Emperor. According to legend, there are two primordial beasts born in this universe, one representing Yin and the other representing Yang. However, there is one beast that was born from Yin and Yang, and he is entirely different from those two beasts."
"The ten-tailed fox was born from Yin and Yang." The man nodded to Tian Huanjing. "No wonder Zhang Fei has light and darkness elements, and he has three identities in one body."

The man then continued. "Like the two primordial beasts, our race represents Yang, and the demon race represents Yin. However, prophecy is nothing more than a mere prediction before the final result appears, so we will wait for the result far in the future."
"Yeah." Tian Huangjin then asked. "Father, if the ten-tailed fox is that strong, then how did it die?"

"No one knows." The man replied with a shake of his head. "Everyone who once saw and met the ten-tailed fox no longer exists in this universe, and there is very little information about him. However, the Dragon Emperor and the Saint of the Natural Race may have additional information about him, but they may have deliberately not shared it with other people."
"I see."
"Daughter, it's time for you to return to our domain."
"But—"

"Did you forget your promise?" Tian Huangjin lowered her head in response, especially since she was eager to kill Xereth. "You promised that you would return if someone forced you to summon my avatar here, remember? If you cannot keep such a trivial promise, how can you expect to be like our first ancestor and lead our race in the future? Since you have done so today, you must return to our domain."
Tian Huangjin let out a soft sigh. "Alright, I'll return to our domain today, but I have to contact Zhang Fei first so that he can prepare other plans to deal with Xereth."

"Even though Xereth is not dead yet, my previous attack was enough to cause him serious injuries, and he won't be able to recover for months or even years." Tian Huangjin contacted Zhang Fei directly, informed him about her return, and asked him to meet her in the Radiance Realm after he ascends to the Paradise Realm in the future. "Are you done?"

When Tian Huangjin took out a small device, the man immediately entered her golden necklace again. She looked far away for a while before activating the device, and a golden pillar shot into the sky from the device.
Tian Huangjin let out a soft sigh and flew into the sky via the golden pillar, which immediately disappeared along with her disappearance.
*Bam*
Xereth fell to the ground as soon as he appeared in a dark realm, and the blood that flowed from his wounds soaked the ground beneath him.

"Damn it! My previous injury hasn't fully recovered yet, and that fucking bird injured me this badly!" Xereth took out several pills, swallowed them, and circulated his Qi. "Shit! I won't be able to recover for long! At this rate, I will die at the hands of my master, especially since I can't possibly find all those items in my current condition."
Xereth immediately threw a device and created a barrier to protect himself, and he began cultivating to restore his condition. "I hope I won't spend too much time recovering from my injury."
"What are you thinking about?" Luo Yu, who had just completed her transformation into a demon beast, asked Zhang Fei [1].

"Tian Huangjin has returned to her domain in the Paradise Realm." Zhang Fei [1] then pulled Luo Yu into his arms and gave her a brief kiss. "At first, I thought you would transform into another demon beast, but it turns out you didn't, and you're still a silver silkworm. It's just that you transformed into a demon one, and you gained the darkness element."

chapters.title: Chapter 910: Feng Yao - Luo Yunxiao
paragraphs: "This place is truly incredible and astonishing!" Feng Jiu exclaimed as they arrived at the Empyrean Domain.
Feng Tian nodded in agreement with his wife. "I think this domain is ten times larger than our Phoenix Realm."
"You're wrong, Father." Feng Tian turned to Feng Yao. "This Empyrean Domain is a hundred times larger than our Phoenix Realm."
"Are you serious?"

"Despite its apparent small size, this domain is significantly more expansive than it appears. In reality, this domain encompasses dozens of major factions, each concealed by a unique formation." Feng Yao then pointed to the sky. "Can you two see something up there?"
Feng Tian and Feng Jiu tried to look at the sky using their senses, but they only saw clouds and various kinds of flying beasts. "Is there something behind the clouds, Yao'er?"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded. "The Immortal Lotus Sanctuary is located behind the clouds, specifically on a floating island that is significantly larger than our Phoenix Realm."
"Can't we see it because of that formation?"

"Yeah." Feng Yao turned to Huo Ling, who immediately took them flying and disappeared into the clouds. However, Feng Jiu and Feng Tian still couldn't see the floating island that their daughter had just mentioned, confusing them.

"The Immortal Lotus Sanctuary keeps moving around this realm, but you can find it easily if you pay attention to the movements of these flying beasts." Feng Yao then pointed in a certain direction. "See that area? Our destination is there, but we will never be able to enter there with our current strength. Fortunately, we have Huo Ling, and she can lead us through their formation."
Feng Jiu and Feng Tian turned in that direction, and they saw several giant flying beasts flying in formation as if guarding something invisible.
"Let's go there, Huo Ling."

Moments later, Feng Jiu and Feng Tian were amazed once again, especially after they saw the palace in the middle of the floating island. The palace is truly magnificent, gigantic, and vast. The palace is very similar to the ancient palace of the ancient emperor, and countless living beings of various races live side by side in harmony, except for demon races.

"Master, you should take your parents there yourself since I'm too lazy to meet those people." After saying this, Huo Ling brought them to the land outside the city that was located below the palace, and he entered Feng Yao's body afterward.
Then, Feng Yao led her parents to the main gate, but they had to pay 10 purple jewels for one person to get permission to enter.
'So expensive! Ten purple jewels per person just for entering.' Feng Jiu and Feng Tian inwardly grumbled.
"Welcome to the Immortal Sanctuary City."
"Thank you." Feng Yao immediately led her parents to look around the city area while heading to the palace.

Even though they were so old, Feng Jiu and Feng Tian acted like country bumpkins when they saw various items that did not exist in the Three Mortal Realms. However, the prices of these items are simply too expensive for cultivators like them who have just ascended to the Paradise Realm, causing them to sigh repeatedly.
"How fast is the speed of a flying artifact worth one billion golden jewels?"
Feng Yao smiled at that. "We only need a day's journey from the Phoenix Realm to the Sky Jade Realm."
"So fast!" Feng Jiu and Feng Tian claimed. "We phoenixes are one of the fastest beasts in the universe, but we can't possibly travel that far in just a day."

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed as she embraced Feng Jiu's shoulders. "Mother, don't compare our flying speed with the artificial speed of these flying artifacts, especially since they use some rare items to increase their speed, for example, the gale obsidian crystal, the void-breaking crystal, and many other boost items."

Feng Jiu let out a soft sigh. "I feel that my old flying artifact is already too fast, but its speed is like a snail when compared with these flying artifacts, so it's not wrong for me to leave it to Zhang Fei."
"Yeah." Feng Yao nodded at her. "Let's meet the Luo Clan and Luo Yunxiao first, and I will take you two to a special place, which is most suitable for phoenixes like us to cultivate afterwards."

"Let's go now." Feng Jiu pulled her daughter along with her. "Your father and I can't wait to break through to the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and we will break through to the Five Celestial Realm after that."
When they arrived at the palace gate, Feng Yao immediately showed the same plaque as before, causing the two guards to freeze with wide eyes.

Feng Jiu and Feng Tian exchanged curious glances at that, especially since all the guards who saw their daughter's plaque looked so frightened, and the previous two guards also referred to her as Empress.
Feng Yao smiled faintly. "Please tell Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi that I have important business with them, and please also tell them that this matter is related to Earth."
The two guards looked confused when Feng Yao mentioned the Earth, especially since there was no such place in the Paradise Realm. "Empress Huo, I will convey your arrival to Lord Luo first."
"Go."

After one of the guards left and the other returned to his post, Feng Yao took her parents to a small garden not far away. Feng Jiu asked her directly. "Who were you in the past? Why did they call you Empress Huo? How could they recognize you? Your current appearance should be different from your past life, right?"

"You are right, Mother." Feng Yao replied with a nod. "My appearance in each of my reincarnations is different, but I am the only one who has this plaque, and it is made from a special material that no one else has, so they immediately recognize me as soon as they see it. I had too many names in the past, but people in the Paradise Realm used to know me as Huo Yanling, and my title was the Flame Spirit Empress."
"Flame Spirit Empress?"

Feng Yao nodded to her parents. "No one in the Paradise Realm has such a good affinity and control over fire as me, which is thanks to Huo Ling. Due to one incident that happened in the past, they referred to me as the Fire Spirit Empress."
"Did you have your domain in this realm in the past?"

"The Blazing Nirvana Domain." Feng Yao's answer surprised her parents. "My domain is in another region, and we have to return to the previous place before we can go there. However, I will not be taking you two there anytime soon, and I want you to break through to the Five Celestial Realms first."
"All right, we will follow your plan."
[Master, the female winged race has returned to her domain.]

'Hmm?' Feng Yao fell into contemplation after that. 'Since that woman has returned to her domain, only Serpentera can help Zhang Fei fight Xereth. Although it will be troublesome, I'm sure everything will be fine, and they can handle that demon themselves.'
[Are you sure about that, Master?]

'Yeah.' Feng Yao then looked at the three people flying toward them, focusing on the young woman in the middle. 'She 's Luo Yunxiao, huh? She is like a goddess, and she has one of the forbidden physiques, so she will be useful to Zhang Fei.'
Soon, the three of them immediately landed in front of Feng Yao and the others, but Luo Yunxiao seemed to hold back her excitement, making the Phoenix Princess smile.
"Are you really Empress Huo Yanling, Senior?" Luo Fengyan and Huang Xiaoyi respectfully asked.

"Do you think anyone would dare and be able to imitate my plaque, Patriarch Luo? Even your grandfather, Luo Changsen, would not dare to do so." Feng Yao's response made the two smile awkwardly. She then took out a bracelet and gave it to Luo Yunxiao, which shocked her and her parents. "Zhang Fei asked me to give it to you, and he told me that he made this bracelet based on the one you wore when you were little."
"Zhang Fei." Luo Yunxiao muttered to herself as her tears fell unconsciously, causing her parents to sigh softly. "How is he now?"

"He's doing well, and his cultivation has already reached the 5-Star Heaven Realm, even though he's only been cultivating for a little over a year." Luo Yunxiao and her parents looked at Feng Yao with expressions full of shock because they knew the quality and quantity of the Qi in the Three Mortal Realms, especially in the lower realms. "By the way, these two are my parents in this lifetime, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, and they are fire phoenixes."

Hearing that, Luo Fengyan and Huang Xiaoyi just realized the identities of the three of them, but they were not surprised by the difference in cultivation between Feng Yao and her parents, especially since she was a reincarnator.
"Shall we talk somewhere else? I'm sure you have many questions about Zhang Fei, right?" Feng Yao questioned Luo Yunxiao.
Luo Yunxiao wiped her tears and spoke to her parents. "I will bring Empress Huo to my private residence."
"All right, you can bring her with you, and we will entertain her parents."
Afterward, Luo Yunxiao took Feng Yao away with her, and her parents took the two phoenixes with them.
When they arrived at her private residence, Luo Yunxiao brought Feng Yao to a wall, where a crystal lotus was located. "Empress Huo, please insert your memories into this crystal."
"Call me Feng Yao because that is my current name." Feng Yao touched the lotus crystal and transferred many of her memories into it, especially about Zhang Fei and all her women.

In a few moments, the lotus crystal projected all of Feng Yao's memories, making Luo Yunxiao gasp. "He's much different from what I've imagined all this time. Who are these women? Are they his women?"
"Yes." Feng Yao first informed Luo Yunxiao about the identities of all the women before posing a question to her. "Are you disappointed that he has many women?"

Luo Yunxiao exhaled with a sense of relief. "I'm happy that Zhang Fei has many loving women by his side."

"In fact, Zhang Fei died once before he became a cultivator, but the murderer brought him back to life, which allowed him to become a cultivator." Luo Yunxiao's eyes widened in shock as she stared at Feng Yao, who immediately explained the incident according to Zhang Fei's story. Luo Yunxiao fell into a daze after she heard that. "Don't tell me that Zhang Fei is a human, a beast, and a demon."

Feng Yao grabbed Luo Yunxiao's hand and checked her inner body. "Unfortunately, your physique has not yet awakened, or you would have become the ruler of the Paradise Realm now. Unfortunately, no one has detailed information about my physique, including my parents, my grandparents, and Senior Yuan Xiao."
[Master, I think you should not tell this little girl the truth; I'm afraid it will only make her feel pressured.]

Unlike Huo Ling, Feng Yao thought that it would be better if Luo Yunxiao knew the truth about her physique earlier, and she told her directly. "The Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique once belonged to a primordial cultivator, and your physique grade is the Supreme Grade."
"What?" Luo Yunxiao let out a low cry. "Are... are you serious about that? How... how did you know that much?"

"You're a smart girl, so you should be able to guess my true identity, right?" The realization of Feng Yao's true identity stunned Luo Yunxiao. "That primordial cultivator was truly powerful, and all primordials were extremely fearful of his strength and abilities, including the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast."

"The Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast." Luo Yunxiao muttered to herself in a daze. She had heard stories about the two primordial beasts, but she and the people in the Paradise Realm never knew their identities.

Feng Yao then continued. "Your physique has the ability to reverse the natural flow of Heaven and Earth, allowing you to manipulate yin and yang. Yin and Yang are the foundation of everything, such as day and night, life and death, and creation and destruction. If you awaken the true ability of your physique, you will be able to disrupt the equilibrium of the universe, and you will be able to overturn impossible odds."
"Is the ability of my physique really that powerful?" Luo Yunxiao asked in disbelief.
