chapters.title: Chapter 911 911: Tian Kui
paragraphs: "You may not believe me now, but you will realize it once your physique awakens, and you will be powerful enough to fight by Zhang Fei's side." Feng Yao then gave Luo Yunxiao a storage ring and told her about its contents, leaving her stunned. "I know you love him very much, or else you wouldn't have continued to wait for him, so I gave it to you. His cultivation is indeed too low compared to yours, but his Yang Qi is much stronger than any man's. It will strengthen your physique, and you will probably be able to awaken your Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique faster."

"You are right, I have always loved Zhang Fei, and I will always wait for him to ascend to this realm." After saying this, Luo Yunxiao immediately took a bottle from the storage ring, and she drank his Yang Qi without the slightest hesitation. "I've never drunk a Yang Qi before, but his Yang Qi isn't as bad as I imagined, and it's really strong."
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "I have drunk his Yang Qi myself, so I know for sure how powerful it is."
After a brief surprise, Luo Yunxiao asked her. "Do you like Zhang Fei too?"

"Not really." Feng Yao's answer confused Luo Yunxiao. "That kid has tried to seduce me too many times, but I don't have that kind of feeling, so I just respond to his feelings by playing around. Moreover, my destiny has been set since I was first born in this universe, and I will disappear after my task is finished."

"What do you mean by that?" Feng Yao just smiled and did not answer Luo Yunxiao. "By the way, you said before that the primordial cultivator was powerful, so how could he die? How could his physique end up in my possession?"

"The primordial cultivator I mentioned before was Hu Tianlang, and he was the first ten-tailed fox." Luo Yunxiao's eyes widened after Feng Yao said that. "I don't know how his Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique could end up in your possession, especially since Zhang Fei has been chosen as his heir. Perhaps fate deliberately arranged everything in such a way, including your meeting with him and your feelings for him. There are several women who will become extremely powerful by his side, but only one of them can reach your level."
"Who is she?"

"Xu Ling'er." Luo Yunxiao was surprised to hear that, especially since she was still too small. "She is the reincarnation of Tian Huangjin, the first ancestor of the winged race. Once she regains her past memories and strength, none of Zhang Fei's women can compare with her. According to prophecy, there are only two people who will stand by his side; one of them is the first ancestor of the winged race, and the other one is the first ancestor of the demon race. However, Hu Tianlang's physique now belongs to you, and you will be the third person to stand by his side, proving the prophecy wrong."

Luo Yunxiao herself had heard of the prophecy, especially since it was no longer a secret in the Paradise Realm. However, she never imagined that her special physique had anything to do with it, especially since it was clear that the figure referred to in the prophecy was the heir of the ten-tailed fox. "Is it possible that the whole prophecy will end up being wrong, Senior? Since the old fox's physique is already mine, Zhang Fei will not be able to perfect himself, right? If that happens, he will be weaker than his predecessor, and he will probably fail to become the peacemaker."

"I don't know what fate's plan is for this universe, and we can only find out the answer in the future." Feng Yao fell silent and thought for a while before continuing. "Even though Zhang Fei didn't inherit Hu Tianlang's physique, there are still several other forbidden physiques in this universe, and one of them is no less terrifying than the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. If he can obtain it, he might be even stronger than his predecessor."
"What is the name of that physique, Senior?" Feng Yao immediately told Luo Yunxiao about the physique, which shocked her. "Do you think Zhang Fei can obtain that physique?"

Feng Yao shook her head. "I can't say for sure, but I think the possibility of Zhang Fei being able to obtain that physique is very high, especially since he is the second living being to possess both Yin and Yang after Hu Tianlang."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "I still have many questions about Zhang Fei and all the women by his side, so I hope you are willing to stay for a few days."
"All right, I will stay here for a week, and I will take my parents to the Flame Spirit Citadel after."
"Phew." Luo Yunxiao exhaled with a sense of relief. "Let's join our parents, Senior."

Meanwhile, Zhe Wuming was in the dungeon of the Bai Royal Palace and stood in front of the sealed door, mainly because he sensed something from that place. He touched the seal and raised his eyebrows. "Who planted such a powerful seal here? What is the purpose of that person sealing this door?"

Curious about it, Zhe Wuming sliced the air and created a void hole that connected him to the inside of the door, but his expression changed after he saw the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast curled up inside.
"A demon beast?" Zhe Wuming decided to enter without breaking the seal.

The Ancient Devourer Demon Beast itself is a towering, shadowy behemoth shrouded in black mist, its body covered in spiky scales that reflect no light. It had countless maws across its limbs, and its main head resembled a grotesque fusion of dragon and wolf.

Sensing his arrival, the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast opened its eyes and stared at Zhe Wuming with its crimson void eyes. "A human with the void element, huh? I've been trapped here for countless years, and I've never met anyone before. So, what are you doing at my resting place, human? Why did you barge in here?"

"Who are you? How could such a powerful beast like you be sealed in a place like this?" Zhe Wuming carefully asked so as not to provoke the anger of the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast, and he also did not dare to get too close to it, even though its body was chained by a chain artifact.
The Ancient Devourer Demon Beast narrowed his eyes at Zhe Wuming. "My name is Tian Kui, and humans gave me the nickname the one who devours the skies."
"The one who devours the skies." Zhe Wuming muttered with a slight frown.

"As for how I ended up sealed in this place, it was because a powerful demon took me away from our realm." Zhe Wuming looked at Tian Kui with a questioning look. "An extremely powerful beast slaughtered all my kin to obtain their power, and I was the last of my kin. The demon saved me and locked me here to avoid its detection, and I've lived here ever since. He asked me to wait for someone, but I've waited for so long, and that person still hasn't appeared."
"Who is the person you are waiting for?"
Tian Kui shook his head. "The demon didn't know that person's identity, but he told me that the person was the only one who could defeat that beast."
"What kind of beast are you referring to?"

"The Primordial Nihility Beast." Zhe Wuming was shocked to learn that the beast was the epitome of all beasts, despite never having encountered such a high-level beast before. "That beast sent the Taotie to capture my kin and several other beast races, and it devoured all of them just for its selfish ambition to strengthen itself."

"All living beings are the same, whether humans or beasts; many of them are too selfish." Zhe Wuming paused to gather his thoughts before speaking to Tian Kui. "I don't know if my friend is the one you are waiting for or not, but he is no ordinary beast, and a monumental task awaits him in the future. If you like, I will bring him here to meet you, but he is in the process of obtaining the lightning element right now."
"What's so special about your friend?"
"He's not only a heavenly fox, but he's also a human and a demon."
*Roar*
Tian Kui roared so loudly that it shook the area. "Do you think I will believe that there is a living being who has three identities in one body?"

"There's no benefit for me to lie to you, okay?" Zhe Wuming replied with a shake of his head. "My friend does have three identities, and most cultivators at my level already know about it. Since the demon asked you to wait for someone who can defeat the Primordial Genesis Beast, and my friend is a special existence, I think there's no harm if you meet him first, right?"
"Hmm?" Tian Kui pondered that.
*Bam*
Tian Kui and Zhe Wuming immediately looked towards the door, especially since someone blasted it from the outside.
"Hahaha!" A man walked in as he laughed. "At first, I thought you had died because of loneliness, but it turns out you are still alive, Tian Kui."
"What are you doing here, Serpentera? Why did you leave your hiding place? Why did you destroy your late master's seal?"
"Taotie's lackey has found me, so I left my hiding place and went to another realm." Serpentera approached Tian Kui before frowning at Zhe Wuming. "How did you break through my late master's seal?"
"This human used the void element, so the seal couldn't prevent him from entering this place." Tian Kui told him.
"I see." Serpentera then ignored Zhe Wuming. "By the way, I met a special kid, and I think he was the person my late master was talking about back then, so I came here to tell you about him."
"What's so special about that kid?"

chapters.title: Chapter 912 912: Zhang Lingxue's Change
paragraphs: [Ding]
[The host obtained the lightning element.]
[The host's lightning element has reached the lower stage.]
[The host successfully formed the peak-grade lightning element core.]
[Congratulations! The host has mastered the initial stage of the lightning elemental law.]
[Quest: Obtain lightning element.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Status: Done
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

Unlike when he obtained his other elements, Zhang Fei [1] needed ten full days to obtain the lightning element. He succeeded in forming his peak-grade lightning core, and he also succeeded in learning the early stage of the lightning elemental law. However, what made him most satisfied was not all that, but his body's strength, which had increased quite significantly thanks to the tempering of the lightning element, which was strengthened by the lightning elemental law.

Behind him, Lei Ting sighed in relief as Zhang Fei [1] managed to achieve all three. "Congratulations, you finally got the lightning element. This way, your lightning tribulations will no longer trouble you, especially after your lightning element reaches the peak stage in the future."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei [1] turned to face Lei Ting, grabbed her hand, and gave her the two beauty pills. "I don't sell them in my shop, and you can consider them a token of my gratitude."
"What kind of pills are these?"
"Swallow them."

Lei Ting nodded to Zhang Fei [1], swallowed the pills, and dissolved them directly. In a few minutes, she experienced their effects and felt a little nauseous because of the foul smell on her body, but he quickly helped her to remove the black liquid.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed and caressed her cheek. "You were already pretty because you were a fairy, and you have become even prettier."

"Let me see my appearance." Lei Ting immediately took a mirror before falling into a daze. "Wow! Such miraculous pills! I was quite young before, but I'm getting younger again! Have you considered offering them for sale in your shop?
"Why should I sell them to the public?" Lei Ting looked at Zhang Fei [1] in confusion. "I only give my two pills to certain people, especially those who pique my interest."
Lei Ting was stunned to hear that. 'Does that mean he's interested in me?'
"Do you want to train and cultivate together with Zefyr and Xin Xianzi?"

Lei Ting was actually curious about that because the development of the two female fairies was too fast, especially Xin Xianzi, which happened after she entered seclusion with Zhang Fei [1] a few months ago. "Is it okay if I join them?"

"Would I offer it to you if I minded that?" Zhang Fei [1] then lifted Lei Ting to her feet. "I will send you there now, and I will go to meet the three people who have been waiting for me since ten days ago."

After Lei Ting disappeared, the lightning spirit immediately came out of Zhang Fei [1]'s body. "Master, this place is most suitable for you to improve your lightning, so you should do seclusion here for a while."

"This place is indeed suitable for me, but my cultivation will slow down if I enter seclusion in this realm." The lightning spirit looked disappointed after Zhang Fei [1] said that "Instead, I will go to the Raging Thunder Realm, especially since that planet is one of the planets in the upper realms. The lightning and lightning elemental laws there are much stronger than in this realm, and the Qi there is beyond question. If I exclude myself there, I can improve all three at once, and so can you."
The lightning spirit nodded in understanding. "Master, please give me a name."
"I'll call you Lei from now on."
"Thank you, master."
A while later, Zhang Fei [1] had arrived at the Bai Kingdom, where Zhe Wuming, Tian Kui, and Serpentera had been waiting for him since ten days ago.

There, Zhang Fei [1] saw the three of them chatting with the members of the Bai Royal Family, but Tian Kui did not join in their conversation, and he was more focused on eating the dishes in front of him.
Zhang Fei [1] noticed Bai Shouyi's gaze on her, but he had never wanted her as his woman. He ignored her and spoke to one of them. "I didn't expect that you would come to this realm, Serpentera."

"Haha." Serpentera laughed at that. "I've looked for several other realms for my new hiding place, but I couldn't find a suitable one. I suddenly remembered Tian Kui, so I came here to tell him about you."

'Mei-' Zhang Fei [1] had not finished speaking to the female AI when Tian Kui suddenly attacked him, but he quickly teleported behind him. He then borrowed the power of all the beasts living in his beast space before attacking the demon beast, but his strength disappeared as soon as he touched his body.
"Hahaha! You're great, but you won't be able to attack me, kid!" Tian Kui immediately turned around and attacked Zhang Fei [1] again, but his attack only penetrated his illusion. "Illusion, huh?"
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] was already standing on a roof not far from them, staring at Tian Kui seriously. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
Name: Tian Kui
Gender: Male
Race: Ancient Devourer
Rank: Mythical Demon Beast
Demon Rank: Unknown
Cultivation: Unknown
Element:
- Darkness [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law:
- Darkness [Perfection Stage]
Core:
- Darkness Core [Peak Rank]
Physique: Devourer Physique
Abilities: Devouring Heaven Maw, Devourer Domain, Devourer Flames, Devourer Minions
Master: None

'He can devour any physical or spiritual object, including laws and qi. He can also create a domain where he absorbs the power of enemies, weakening them and healing himself. His flame can also devour the souls of his enemies, preventing them from reincarnating.' Zhang Fei [1] was quite shocked by Tian Kui's abilities. 'Who do you think is suitable to get his bloodline, Mei?'

[Master, I think Zhang Linguxe is most suitable to receive Tian Kui's bloodline. She already has the fire phoenix bloodline in her body, and she will probably transform into a new race like Ru Xue and Zhang Lin.]

'Honestly, I'm still confused about Ru Xue, especially since her demon beast rank is a mythical beast rank due to Long Baiyun's light dragon bloodline. However, the system doesn't consider her worthy to be my main wife, which is really strange for me.'
[Sorry, Master. I don't have an answer for that, but as I said before, Zhang Lingxue is most suitable to receive Tian Kui's bloodline.]
"Hey, Kid! How long are you going to stand there daydreaming?" Tian Kui shouted at Zhang Fei [1]. "Come down now!"
'Such a bossy attitude!' Zhang Fei [1] immediately moved in front of them. "Your abilities are truly terrifying, old beast."

"Hahaha!" Tian Kui laughed out loud as he placed both hands on his waist. "Do you think the Primordial Nihility Beast would slaughter my race if our abilities were ordinary? That bastard was frightened by our abilities, so he slaughtered my race to prevent us from surpassing him and devouring him."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding. "Old Beast, I want your bloodline for one of my wives, and you can maintain the existence of your race through her, so I hope you are willing to give it to me. Moreover, she is not an ordinary woman, and she has the fire phoenix bloodline."

"Are you sure you can protect your wife?" Tian Kui doubtfully asked, even though he had seen a bit of Zhang Fei [1]'s abilities. "If you turn your wife into my devourer demon beast race, I'm sure that bastard and his subordinates will hunt her down, which will only harm her."

"You don't have to worry about that; all my wives will always be safe in my private place." Tian Kui seriously stared at him, but he was surprised when Zhang Fei [1] opened a portal to the training space, and Zhang Lingxue casually walked out of it. "As you can sense yourself, her physique is much stronger than other women, and her cultivation almost breaks through to the Sovereign Realm. If I turn her into the devourer demon beast, I'm sure she will be even stronger with all the abilities of your race."

Tian Kui observed Zhang Lingxue for a while before asking her. "Are you really okay with becoming a demon beast? Once you become one, your life won't be as free as it is now, and many cultivators will hunt you down if they find out about your race."

"Senior, my husband is a demon and a beast, so why would I mind becoming a demon beast?" Zhang Lingxue grabbed Zhang Fei [1]'s hand. "Moreover, I'm not as weak as you imagine, and we will continue to grow together until we become truly powerful."

Seeing Tian Kui continue to hesitate, Serpentera patted his shoulder and spoke to him. "This little girl has already made her decision, so you don't need to worry about it anymore. Allow Zhang Fei to transform her into your beast race, ensuring that your lineage will continue to exist in this universe through her descendants."

"Yeah, you're right." Tian Kui immediately cut off several parts of his body, such as hair, nails, and skin. He then gave Zhang Fei [1] ten drops of his origin's demon beast bloodline. "Bring her back to me again after you turned her into a demon beast."

"Sure." Zhang Fei [1] turned to Zhe Wuming, who nodded at him. After he sent the nameless one back to the Xianjin Realm, he immediately sent Zhang Lingxue to the pavilion. "Do you two want to go to the demon realm in the upper realm? I will return to the Demon Purgatory Realm now, especially since all my partners live there."
"Let's go!" Serpentera and Tian Kui immediately decided.

Before he took the two demon beasts away, Zhang Fei [1] first picked up Wushuang in another area, especially since the Nine Stars Realm was already completely safe. Thereafter, he took her and the two demon beasts to the Demon Purgatory Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 913 913: Raging Thunder Realm
paragraphs: After Zhang Lingxue transformed into a demon beast, Zhang Fei [1] brought her to meet Tian Kui in the Demon Purgatory Realm, which made the old demon beast overjoyed. However, she didn't stay in that realm for too long, and he sent her back to the pavilion again.
Zhang Fei decided to stop dual cultivating with his other women, and he focused himself on helping Zhang Lingxue for the next few days.

Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived at the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, but he was not alone, as Hong Xinxin decided to accompany him to go to the Raging Thunder Realm. "You became a body cultivator a little over a year ago, but your body cultivation has already reached the fourth stage, and you've managed to obtain the lightning element."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out Feng Jiu's flying artifact, took Hong Xinxin to board it, and flew it out of the realm directly. "If it weren't for you, I would never have become a body cultivator, and my physique would be much weaker than now. Although I have reached the fourth stage of body cultivation, I am still not satisfied because my goal is to reach the Paradise Realm, which is populated by countless powerful cultivators from various races. Even Feng Yichen is significantly weaker than those powerful cultivators, so I cannot stop my progress here; I must reach the Eight Body Gates before I can take all of you there."

"Yeah." Hong Xinxin replied with a nod. "All of us still have to improve ourselves, especially since the problems we will face will be even bigger after we go to the Paradise Realm. In recent times, we have relied too much on you, including the problems in the Red Sun Realm and Xereth. We cannot continue like this, and we must always strive to become stronger so we can help you face the problems that will come to us in the future."
Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh. "Don't worry, we still have a lot of time to prepare ourselves, and I'm sure we will be ready to ascend to the Paradise Realm when the time comes."
"I hope so." Hong Xinxin then asked. "Are you going to leave your clone in the Raging Thunder Realm?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "The lightning element is one of the best attack elements with deadly power, and I can also use it for a wider range of attacks at the same time. Therefore, I want to raise my lightning element and elemental law to their peak, but I can only do it faster if one of my clones enters seclusion in that realm."

"You are right." Hong Xinxin then stretched out her hand and used her lightning element. "In addition to deadly explosive power and a wide attack area, we can use our lightning element to increase our speed. If you combine it with your wind element and your movement technique, no one will be able to catch up to you—not even Zhe Wuming with his void element. So, what kind of lightning techniques do you have now?"

"I don't have any techniques better than the Lightning Body Technique you gave me back then, so I won't bother with it." Since she was the one who gave the Lightning Body Technique to Zhang Fei [5], Hong Xinxin naturally understood its advantages. "The Nine Heavens Lightning Art has nine levels, from first heaven to ninth heaven, and each stage has its advantages."
"So, what's the grade?"

"The Divine Grade." Zhang Fei [5] touched Hong Xinxin's forehead and shared the Nine Heavens Lightning Art with her. "Read it first, and we'll start studying them once we arrive at the Raging Thunder Realm."
Hong Xinxin nodded in agreement, and she immediately sat down, reading the three techniques one by one.

"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] exhaled slowly and clenched his fists. "Just a little more, and I will break through to the 6-Star Heaven Realm. If my calculations are correct, and the six of us focus in our isolation, I should be able to break through to the Sovereign Realm in less than six months."

[If only you didn't busy yourself with all those useless things, your cultivation would have broken through to the Sovereign Realm long ago, Master. You have so many godlike cheats, but those problems keep distracting you from focusing on your cultivation.] Zhang Fei [5] responded to Mei with a wry smile, but he knew that the female Ai was right about that. [The flow of time in the training space is two times faster than the outside world, you also have so many women by your side, and the Qi Amplifier always increases their Yin Qi by four times. You have also obtained the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion equipped with the Boundless Yin-Yang Array, so the Sovereign Realm is already within your reach. If you fully focus yourself in your isolation, I'm sure you can reach the Quasi Divine Realm in no time.]

'You're right, Mei.' Zhang Fei [5] sighed heavily. 'The situation in all realms is relatively safe and calm, and all my enemies are also in seclusion. I don't know the extent of Xereth's injuries, but Tian Huangjin stated with certainty that he won't be able to move for a few years. Therefore, I won't think about those useless things anymore, and I will focus on my cultivation with the target of the Quasi-Divine Realm first.

[Master, Huoyun Zhiyan and the others are still in the process of concocting the True Foundation Pill, and it should be completed in another two and a half months if there are no obstacles. I don't know how many pills they will manage to concoct, but they will be able to speed up your breakthrough to the Sovereign Realm.]
Zhang Fei [5] gave a light nod. 'I hope they can concoct at least three pills; five pills would be even better.'
In the Paradise Realm, Huo Ling had already taken Feng Jiu and her parents to leave the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and she took them to the Flame Spirit Citadel.

Luo Yunxiao still wanted to talk to Feng Yao, but she couldn't stop her and her parents from leaving. After they left, she told her parents that she was going into seclusion, and she would not come out for decades or even hundreds of years to come.

Luo Fengyan and Huang Xiaoyi naturally understood Luo Yunxiao's intentions, especially after they noticed the existence of Zhang Fei's Yang Qi in her body. They didn't stop her and let her do as she wished, but they hoped that he would ascend to the Paradise Realm as soon as possible, or their daughter would wait for him too long.
With Huo Ling's speed, it didn't take them long to arrive at the Flame Spirit Citadel, even though it was in a different region from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
The Flame Spirit Citadel itself is hidden within the scorched heart of the Blazing Inferno Mountains, and it is a fortress forged in the embers of a long-extinct volcano.
"What exactly is this place, Yao'er?"

Feng Yao immediately explained it. "This Flame Spirit Citadel was built by the Primordial Fire Spirit Clan after they tamed the Fire Calamity Beast, and the flame under this building was obtained from a small portion of the Eternal Flame."
"The Primordial Fire Spirit Clan? The Fire Calamity Beast? The Eternal Flame?"

"The Primordial Fire Spirit Clan has existed since the primordial era along with various other primordial races, and Huo Ling is one of their descendants. Unfortunately, many of them disappeared after the Primordial Era ended, and the current fire spirits are no longer as powerful as their predecessors." Feng Tian and Feng Jiu looked at Huo Ling walking in front of them in shock. "They have the ability to communicate with all types of flames, and the Eternal Flame is the first rank of the ten heavenly flames. The flame used to be in the Eternal Domain, and countless fire cultivators always crowded the domain. Unfortunately, the flame suddenly disappeared without a trace, causing the Eternal Domain to eventually become forgotten as almost no living beings visited it anymore.
"How do you know about all that? Did you live in the Primordial Era?" Feng Yao just smiled at Feng Jiu, who could only sigh. "Is the Fire Calamity Beast still alive?"

"The Fire Calamity Beast is an immortal rank beast and powerful, so it is still alive today, and it lives far below this citadel." Feng Jiu and Feng Tian were shocked again, especially since there were no immortal-rank beasts in the Three Mortal Realms. "There are countless immortal rank beasts in this realm, including immortal rank phoenixes. All of them live in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, under the leadership of the five-clawed golden dragon emperor, Long Wuzhao."

Feng Tian and Feng Jiu almost fell over after hearing that, especially since they themselves were fire phoenixes, but they had never managed to reach the immortal rank, including their ancestor Feng Shen.

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled at that. "To become immortal rank beasts, you two need the Celestial Qi. Therefore, you don't have to be disappointed by that because you are already in this realm now, and you will be able to reach that rank in the future."
"Does Taotie also live in this realm?"

Unfortunately, that guy has too extensive relationships, and he also has many strange abilities, so I hope you can rethink everything after the previous incident. If we become his enemies, he will do even more cruel things to us, like he did to Elder Jishan and Elder Yingwu."

"What did Zhang Fei do to them?" Long Zhenxia explained the situation directly to Long Xiaogang and Long Xinran, which caused them to shiver in fear. "That kid is really cruel; he enslaved and forcibly contracted Long Jishan to become his contract beast."
"Do you know where Zhang Fei is holding Long Yingwu?"

Long Zhenxia shook her head at her mother. "You two already know Zhang Fei's cruelty, so I want you two to stop following our patriarch's orders. If necessary, we should leave this realm and move to a different one, which would prevent us from having any more trouble with him. If we continue to stay here, I'm afraid we will die in his hands one day."

"Leave first." After Long Zhenxia left, Long Xiaogang turned to his wife and asked her a question. "What do you think about our daughter's idea? Should we leave this realm and settle in another realm?"

Long Xinran let out a soft sigh. "Our condition hasn't fully recovered yet, so we should focus on recovering first while thinking things through. If leaving this realm is indeed the best option we have, I think it's okay if we do so. However, we must find another realm far away from this one, or our Dragon Realm."
"I agree with you." Long Xiaogang immediately helped his wife sit down, and the two of them swallowed some pills to speed up their recovery. "Let's focus on ourselves first."
"Yeah."

Zhang Fei [5] first sent Ye Lian and the women with the lightning element back to the pavilion; he would rather not take the risk of letting them stay there because they might be affected by his lightning tribulation. He was sure that his lightning tribulation would be too strong for them, especially since he would be breaking through several stages at once.

Then, Zhang Fei [5] summoned Long Jishan, who was still gloomy after learning his fate as a contract beast. "You are my slave and beast contract, and you can never change your fate, so you'd better accept reality and obey me. If you continue to behave like this, I will beat you black and blue."
"Yes, Master." Long Jishan replied with a helpless sigh.

Lei Que and Lei, who were training in other areas, immediately flew to Zhang Fei [5]'s side. Hong Xinxin, who was sitting on the thunderbird's back, asked him. "Are you going to break through to the 10-Star Heaven Realm directly?"

"Moreover, my foundation is completely solid now, so I think it's no problem if I break through to the 10-Star Heaven Realm directly, and I'll swallow the one superior-grade pill once I reach that stage. This way, I can break through to the Sovereign Realm, and I might be able to reach the sixth or seventh stage straight away."

Hong Xinxin shook her head upon hearing that. "You're too reckless, do you know that? However, you've already done it once seven months ago, and you've improved a lot since then, so I think you should be able to make it through."
"Don't worry, Master. I will help you through your multiple breakthroughs, and I will make sure everything will be fine." Lei, the lightning spirit, spoke.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in response. "Let's begin."

"I've given my flame dragon origin bloodline to you, so you should heal my parents and little brother now."

"What are you going to do in this place?"

He used me to harm my clan members!' Long Zhenxia then asked.

Zhang Fei [4] immediately opened a portal to Yin-Yang Space and threw Long Yingwu into it, making Long Zhenxia curious about it.
He didn't provide any explanation and instead took her to Long Jishan's room.
Zhang Fei [4] did not take any immediate action against Long Jishan and instead fell into deep thought. 'He's a dragon, and I will lose if I kill him.'
[Master, Long Jishan's soul has been trapped inside the Abyssal Mirror for months, so I think you can release him and enslave him.

'Mei, you're becoming more and more evil, but I like your idea.' Zhang Fei [4] took out the Abyssal Mirror, released Long Jishan's soul, and implanted his demon slave mark into it.

Long Zhenxia took a deep breath as she watched Zhang Fei [4]'s actions, making her quite regret her decision to bring him into her clan. 'Elder Jishan and Elder Yingwu were two of the strongest in my clan, but they fell into his hands because of me.'
After he returned Long Jishan's soul into his body, Zhang Fei [4] immediately made a forced contract with him.
[Ding]

[The beast feature has been upgraded to level six.]
[Master, only the Beast Sanctuary has increased to level three, and it also seems to be at max level.]
Zhang Fei [4] nodded slightly, sent Long Jishan into his beast space, and asked Long Zhenxia to take him to her family.
Once they were there, Zhang Fei [4] immediately withdrew the pink gas from the bodies of Long Xiaogang, Long Xinran, and Long Taiyuan.
"They will wake up soon, but you must take them away from this clan.

"Thank you." Long Zhenxia sighed in relief.

Feng Qingmeng nodded in agreement with the statement.

"Haha." Yan Jinwu laughed wryly.

Huli Haohao and the other two chose not to respond to Yan Jinwu, especially since they were already quite familiar with Zhang Fei [4]'s character after they had lived with him for several months based on the time flow inside the training space.
Judging from the character of all his main wives, they could guess the reason he didn't take her as a member of his main harem.
Even so, it's actually not a big deal, especially since he and his five clones are basically the same person due to their hive minds and souls.

He then merged all of them into one, creating a fireball with a combination of five different colors.

"I think you can destroy a region if you use it with your full power." Huli Haohao commented.
"I agree." Feng Qingmeng spoke while nodding.
"The dragon flame has the strongest explosive power among all the flames, so the explosive power of this technique should be even stronger.
Unlike them, Zhu Lingyao was more curious about Zhang Fei [4]'s actions against Long Zhenxia and the dragon clan, so she asked him about it directly. 'What did you do to them?'
Zhang Fei [4] explained to them all about his actions, including those against Long Jishan and Long Yingwu, leaving them stunned for quite a while.
"Hahaha!" Yan Jinwu laughed.

Huli Haohao nodded in agreement.
"Among all mythical beasts, the dragon race has the highest pride and arrogance, so I'm sure Long Jishan will suffer after he finds out that he has become a beast contract and a slave."
"Long Jishan is a lightning dragon, and I think he would be a perfect mount for Zhang Fei [4], especially since he has obtained the lightning element now." Feng Qingmeng then asked him.

Wouldn't it be better to give her to one of your wives with water, ice, or lightning?

Zhang Lin has already transformed into the Abyssal Leviathan Dragon Demon Beast with the water element, and her beast rank is mythical.
For now, I will use her to get a lot of Yin Qi."

chapters.title: Chapter 916: Sovereign Realm
paragraphs: *Rumble... Rumble...*
Unlike Zhang Fei [5]'s usual breakthroughs, the sky in the entire Raging Thunder Realm quickly darkened, causing all the lightning cultivators living there to panic.

Although the cultivators did not understand the situation, many of them immediately moved towards the Thunderfall Gorge to investigate. However, they moved cautiously because the lightning tribulation was not an ordinary phenomenon, and they could feel that the lightning tribulation that appeared was a combination of several tribulations at once.
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Unlike those people, Zhang Fei [5] did not panic in the slightest, but instead, he looked forward to his multiple lightning tribulations to descend. Moreover, those lightning bolts did not immediately descend, and the heavens seemed to be brewing them.

Zhang Fei [5] swiftly swallowed one superior-grade true foundation pill to stabilize his chaotic foundation, which had become unstable after four consecutive breakthroughs. He hurriedly dissolved the pill and spread its effects throughout his body.
*Rumble... Rumble...*
Sometime later, Zhang Fei [5] smiled with satisfaction after sensing the effects of the pill, and his foundation began to stabilize.

Hong Xinxin immediately floated to his side and asked him a question. "Are you sure you want to break through to the Sovereign Realm now? Your lightning tribulations this time are already too powerful because of the combination of the four, and the heavens seem to intend to kill you."

"Do you believe me, Xinxin?" Hong Xinxin responded to Zhang Fei [5] with a frown. "My lightning body cultivation has reached the perfection stage level, and I have obtained the lightning element along with the lightning elemental law. I know my lightning tribulations will become even more powerful once I break through to the Sovereign Realm, but I am confident that I can pass them, and I will use them to increase my body cultivation level. Besides, my body is really strong now thanks to the other two body techniques, and I still have my passive regenerative healing factor, so you don't need to worry about me."
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Hong Xinxin released a heavy sigh, especially since Zhang Fei [5] was too crazy. She was happy if she became more powerful, but her methods to improve herself were too extreme; even cultivators at Zhe Wuming's level would never dare to do such a thing.

Unlike Hong Xinxin, Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu, who lived inside Zhang Fei [5]'s soul sea, did not worry about him. Instead, they prepared to help him, and they planned to utilize his lightning tribulations to their benefit.
A portal suddenly opened there, and Zhang Fei led his three other clones out of it, confusing Hong Xinxin. "Do you intend to divide these lightning tribulations?"
*Rumble... Rumble...*

"I used this method when I broke through to the Heaven Realm, or I would have died long ago." Zhang Fei immediately took out his seven cores, and he also released his three souls before merging them into one. He activated the soul link and borrowed the power of all the beasts in the beast space, and he didn't forget to use his enhanced body condition ability, strengthening his body even further. "The true foundation pill is indeed extraordinary, and my foundation is stable now, so I will break through to the Sovereign Realm now. Move away, Xinxin."
"Be careful!" Hong Xinxin immediately flew away from Zhang Fei and the others.
[Master, after you break through to the Sovereign Realm, you should take some time to recover before attempting to break through again.]
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei nodded in response.
[You gained 35,000,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to the 1-Star Sovereign Realm.]
*Rumble... Rumble...*
As soon as the notification appeared, the sky above the realm rumbled violently, and it also caused all corners of the realm to experience a large earthquake.
Zhang Fei's last clone hurriedly came out of the Yin-Yang space and joined them, and the six of them prepared to face the wrath of heaven.

As a lightning spirit, Lei sensed something unusual from Zang Fei's multiple lightning tribulations, and he immediately warned him. "Master, your breakthrough is odd, and I can feel the Divine Qi from the lightning bolts."
"The Divine Qi?" Zhang Fei was shocked by that. "Wouldn't the Divine Qi only appear when I break through to the Seven Divine Realms? Why is it appearing now?"

Lei immediately explained. "Normally, the Divine Qi will only appear when you break through to that stage, but your actions in the past and today have provoked the wrath of the heavens. They seem to regard you as an anomaly, and they intend to use all means to kill you."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Hey, isn't this good? Since the heavens want to kill me, I will use their gift to improve some aspects of myself."

"Yes, Master." Lei nodded at him. "Even though you can't absorb Divine Qi directly with your cultivation still at the ten mortal realms, it is still useful for forging your body, soul, and seven cores. By the way, you should prepare now; I can feel that those lightning bolts are about to descend."
"Lei Que! Do it as usual! You must follow us, Long Jishan!" The thunderbird immediately carried Zhang Fei into the sky, followed by his five clones and the lightning spirit.

'Tch! This crazy kid! He already knows that his multiple lightning tribulation is too powerful, but he asked me to follow him there.' Despite this, Long Jishan immediately transformed into his lightning dragon form and caught up with Zhang Fei and the others, disappearing behind the increasingly dark and rumbling clouds.

Hong Xinxin squeezed her hands together tightly as she looked up at the sky, but she then turned her head towards the outside of the place, especially since she felt many auras approaching her location. 'Fei'er's lightning tribulations piqued their curiosity, but they wouldn't dare enter this place with their current strength.'

Even though they were already there, those lightning bolts still hadn't struck them, and the heavens continued to brew them even stronger. Although he couldn't absorb the Divine Qi directly, Zhang Fei could already feel the difference with the regular Qi, making him impatient to break through to the Seven Divine Realms.
"Master, get ready."
Zhang Fei nodded to Lei, activated his light element, and created the female light-winged race to speed up his recovery after those lightning bolts attacked him.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

Dozens of lightning bolts immediately attacked them, but Zhang Fei and his five clones moved quickly using their lightning elemental laws, and the lightning spirit also helped them, allowing them to absorb those lightning bolts without having to experience too much pain.
On the other hand, Lei Que spouted quite a lot from his mouth, but he hurriedly swallowed a superior-grade healing pill while absorbing those lightning bolts.

Long Jishan also suffered from the impact of the lightning bolts, but he was not in as much pain as the thunderbird. After all, he was a dragon with a strong physique and high cultivation, and he also mastered the lightning elemental law.

Zhang Fei and the others did not have an opportunity to breathe a sigh of relief, especially since dozens of other lightning bolts attacked them once again, and their power was greater than the first.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

All of them grimaced in pain after being hit by the lightning bolts, but the one who experienced the most pain among them was Lei Qui. Fortunately, Zhang Fei had given him many healing pills, and he also helped his recovery using his light element.

[Master, I detected Divine Qi flowing into your body through those lightning bolts, and the number continues to increase, so I think your Heavenly Body Tempering will reach the final stage after you complete your breakthrough this time.]

Zhang Fei was puzzled by that, especially since he still couldn't absorb the Divine Qi from the air directly, but his body could absorb the one contained within those lightning bolts. He immediately ignored that as the third attack moved towards them; he and his five clones quickly absorbed those lightning bolts.

Time passed, and Zhang Fei and the others continued to receive attacks from his multiple lightning tribulations. Meanwhile, countless cultivators had gathered outside the Thunderfall Gorge, and some of them tried to enter it, but they were forced back by the powerful lightning that continued to rain down on the place.

Three middle-aged male cultivators decided to use defensive artifacts to break into the place, but they only found Hong Xinxin inside. One of them immediately approached her and spoke to her. "Miss, my name is Lei Xuantong, and I would like to ask if you know the identity of the person who made the breakthrough up there."

"My husband." Hong Xinxin's answer confused them because she was still a virgin, so they found it difficult to believe. "It's up to you whether you want to believe it or not, but I advise you guys not to bother me and leave this place right now."
"Hey, you—" Another middle-aged man wanted to scold Hong Xinxin, but a powerful lightning bolt quickly descended from the sky.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*
"Arghh!" The middle-aged man screamed in pain as soon as the lightning bolt struck his body, causing his clothes to shatter and him to suffer serious injuries.
Lei Xuantong and the other middle-aged man immediately jumped away, and they looked at the sky with expressions of shock.
Hong Xinxin directly spoke to them. "My husband never likes it when men try to get close to me, so you two better leave this place, or you will suffer like your friend."
"How—"
"Stop asking and leave!" Hong Xinxin interrupted Lei Xuantong. "If my husband doesn't attack you two, I will attack you guys."
Lei Xuantong nodded to Hong Xinxin and turned to leave. "Let's go back."
"What about that guy?"
"His injuries are too severe, and he will die soon." Lei Xuantong hurriedly left the place, followed by the other one.

Hong Xinxin turned to face the middle-aged man, whose body had burned from the earlier lightning bolt attack. She used her lightning element, and she ended her suffering by killing him. She then looked up at that sky with a smile, realizing that Zhang Fei and the others were fine behind those dark clouds. "If he didn't have the lightning element and hadn't studied its laws, he wouldn't have been able to withstand his breakthrough this time. However, the heavens seemed eager to kill him, so I'm sure his lightning tribulation won't end anytime soon, and it will probably last for days."
Meanwhile, in the Xianjin Realm, several people were gathered together, discussing some matters. They were Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, Wang Wugui, Huli Xianniang, and Zhu Shanniang.
"How did it go? Were you able to contact your people in the Sky Dragon Realm?" Wang Wugui asked Long Qiang.

Long Qiang shook his head in response. "I couldn't contact Long Aotian or the others, and the two people I sent there also disappeared without a trace. What about you? Does Wang Guzhe still refuse your orders?"

"Tch! Don't talk about that bastard!" Wang Wugui replied irritably. "Our ancestors had already forced him to capture Zhang Fei, and they even threatened to punish him severely, but he still refused to do so."

"Huli Haohao has been missing for several months." Dai Hubai and the other two men turned to Huli Xianniang. "Zhu Shanniang has also been unable to contact Zhu Lingyao for the past few months, and we suspect that their disappearance has something to do with Zhang Fei."
"What is the reason you two think that?"

Zhu Shanniang explained directly. "People from my clan and sect in that realm have seen Zhang Fei come there several times, and he came specifically to meet my sister, so we guessed that way. Besides, they also told me that several other people have also disappeared, such as Yan Jinwu and Nu Qicheng."
"Does that mean the Golden Crow and Nian Clans decided to side with Zhang Fei?" Dai Hubai asked with a frown.

Zhu Shanniang nodded at him. "Those two clans have different views than us about Zhang Fei, and they would rather not be his enemy from the start, so you shouldn't be surprised if they decide like that. As for my vermilion bird clan, you guys must already know our situation, and Zhu Hong ordered our clan members not to look for trouble with him."
They nodded in understanding to Zhu Shanniang, and then Wang Wugui asked the female fox a question. "What about your Golden Fox Clan?"

"Don't you already know the answer?" Huli Xianniang turned to ask while shaking her head. By the way, I heard that Feng Yao and her parents had already left the upper realms about five months ago, and Feng Jiu handed over the Phoenix Clan to that little bastard."

Huli Xianniang's words caused their faces to darken and frown, as they did not expect Feng Jiu to make such a decision. "So, what should we do now? Since Zhang Fei has not appeared in this realm again since that day, our only choice is to go to the Sky Dragon Realm ourselves to capture his clone."

"You guys should go to that realm now." Huli Xianniang and the others immediately turned to Huli Jinshu, who had just arrived along with the male ancestor of the Dragon Clan. Huli Jinshu shook her head at Huli Xianniang. "You don't need to think about her, and I will take care of her myself later."
"All right." Huli Xiannang immediately agreed.

"Are you sure about that, Ancestor Jiuxiao?" Long Qiang could hardly believe his ancestor's conjecture.

Long Jiuxiao shook his head as he answered. "For now, this matter is still just my guess based on the situation in our branch clan, but I'm sure my guess is correct. Therefore, you must find that person, and you can kill him or her directly."

"I can handle her myself." Huli Jinhu refused with a shake of his head. "I hope they will be able to capture Zhang Fei, or he will become a threat to us."
Long Jiuxiao nodded in agreement. "Feng Tian and Feng Jiu have long known the way to go to the Paradise Realm, but they did not tell us or invite us to go with them."
"Forget it." Huli Jinhu released a soft sigh. "They are gone now, so there is no point for us to talk about them anymore, and we should focus on getting rid of Zhang Fei."
"Let's go back."

Zhe Wuming, who had been concentrating on his cultivation, abruptly opened his eyes and gazed into the distance. "Those individuals are overly arrogant and stubborn, and they cannot discern which matters are a priority." Unfortunately, they still don't know Zhang Fei's current strength, especially his ability to borrow others' strength. If Huli Xianniang and the others fight with him, they might be seriously injured or even die at his hands, which would worsen our situation, especially since Xereth is still out there."

Zhe Wuming immediately closed his eyes again to continue his cultivation, but he first contacted Zhang Fei, informing him about the departure of Long Qiang and the others to the Sky Dragon Realm. "I hope he won't kill them, at least before we manage to get rid of Xereth."

sentences.text: *Rumble...
Rumble...*
Unlike Zhang Fei [5]'s usual breakthroughs, the sky in the entire Raging Thunder Realm quickly darkened, causing all the lightning cultivators living there to panic.
Although the cultivators did not understand the situation, many of them immediately moved towards the Thunderfall Gorge to investigate.

However, they moved cautiously because the lightning tribulation was not an ordinary phenomenon, and they could feel that the lightning tribulation that appeared was a combination of several tribulations at once.
*Rumble...
Rumble...*
Unlike those people, Zhang Fei [5] did not panic in the slightest, but instead, he looked forward to his multiple lightning tribulations to descend.
Moreover, those lightning bolts did not immediately descend, and the heavens seemed to be brewing them.
Zhang Fei [5] swiftly swallowed one superior-grade true foundation pill to stabilize his chaotic foundation, which had become unstable after four consecutive breakthroughs.
He hurriedly dissolved the pill and spread its effects throughout his body.
*Rumble...
Rumble...*
Sometime later, Zhang Fei [5] smiled with satisfaction after sensing the effects of the pill, and his foundation began to stabilize.
Hong Xinxin immediately floated to his side and asked him a question.
"Are you sure you want to break through to the Sovereign Realm now?
Your lightning tribulations this time are already too powerful because of the combination of the four, and the heavens seem to intend to kill you."
"Do you believe me, Xinxin?" Hong Xinxin responded to Zhang Fei [5] with a frown.
"My lightning body cultivation has reached the perfection stage level, and I have obtained the lightning element along with the lightning elemental law.

I know my lightning tribulations will become even more powerful once I break through to the Sovereign Realm, but I am confident that I can pass them, and I will use them to increase my body cultivation level.
Besides, my body is really strong now thanks to the other two body techniques, and I still have my passive regenerative healing factor, so you don't need to worry about me."
*Rumble...
Rumble...*
Hong Xinxin released a heavy sigh, especially since Zhang Fei [5] was too crazy.
She was happy if she became more powerful, but her methods to improve herself were too extreme; even cultivators at Zhe Wuming's level would never dare to do such a thing.
Unlike Hong Xinxin, Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu, who lived inside Zhang Fei [5]'s soul sea, did not worry about him.
Instead, they prepared to help him, and they planned to utilize his lightning tribulations to their benefit.
A portal suddenly opened there, and Zhang Fei led his three other clones out of it, confusing Hong Xinxin.
"Do you intend to divide these lightning tribulations?"
*Rumble...
Rumble...*

"I used this method when I broke through to the Heaven Realm, or I would have died long ago." Zhang Fei immediately took out his seven cores, and he also released his three souls before merging them into one.
He activated the soul link and borrowed the power of all the beasts in the beast space, and he didn't forget to use his enhanced body condition ability, strengthening his body even further.
"The true foundation pill is indeed extraordinary, and my foundation is stable now, so I will break through to the Sovereign Realm now.
Move away, Xinxin."
"Be careful!" Hong Xinxin immediately flew away from Zhang Fei and the others.
[Master, after you break through to the Sovereign Realm, you should take some time to recover before attempting to break through again.]
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei nodded in response.
[You gained 35,000,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations!
Your cultivation broke through to the 1-Star Sovereign Realm.]
*Rumble...
Rumble...*
As soon as the notification appeared, the sky above the realm rumbled violently, and it also caused all corners of the realm to experience a large earthquake.
Zhang Fei's last clone hurriedly came out of the Yin-Yang space and joined them, and the six of them prepared to face the wrath of heaven.
As a lightning spirit, Lei sensed something unusual from Zang Fei's multiple lightning tribulations, and he immediately warned him.
"Master, your breakthrough is odd, and I can feel the Divine Qi from the lightning bolts."
"The Divine Qi?" Zhang Fei was shocked by that.
"Wouldn't the Divine Qi only appear when I break through to the Seven Divine Realms?
Why is it appearing now?"
Lei immediately explained.
"Normally, the Divine Qi will only appear when you break through to that stage, but your actions in the past and today have provoked the wrath of the heavens.
They seem to regard you as an anomaly, and they intend to use all means to kill you."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Hey, isn't this good?
Since the heavens want to kill me, I will use their gift to improve some aspects of myself."
"Yes, Master." Lei nodded at him.
"Even though you can't absorb Divine Qi directly with your cultivation still at the ten mortal realms, it is still useful for forging your body, soul, and seven cores.
By the way, you should prepare now; I can feel that those lightning bolts are about to descend."
"Lei Que!
Do it as usual!

'Tch!
This crazy kid!

He already knows that his multiple lightning tribulation is too powerful, but he asked me to follow him there.' Despite this, Long Jishan immediately transformed into his lightning dragon form and caught up with Zhang Fei and the others, disappearing behind the increasingly dark and rumbling clouds.

Hong Xinxin squeezed her hands together tightly as she looked up at the sky, but she then turned her head towards the outside of the place, especially since she felt many auras approaching her location. 'Fei'er's lightning tribulations piqued their curiosity, but they wouldn't dare enter this place with their current strength.'
Even though they were already there, those lightning bolts still hadn't struck them, and the heavens continued to brew them even stronger.
Although he couldn't absorb the Divine Qi directly, Zhang Fei could already feel the difference with the regular Qi, making him impatient to break through to the Seven Divine Realms.
"Master, get ready."
Zhang Fei nodded to Lei, activated his light element, and created the female light-winged race to speed up his recovery after those lightning bolts attacked him.
*Zap...
Zap...
Zap...*

Dozens of lightning bolts immediately attacked them, but Zhang Fei and his five clones moved quickly using their lightning elemental laws, and the lightning spirit also helped them, allowing them to absorb those lightning bolts without having to experience too much pain.
On the other hand, Lei Que spouted quite a lot from his mouth, but he hurriedly swallowed a superior-grade healing pill while absorbing those lightning bolts.
Long Jishan also suffered from the impact of the lightning bolts, but he was not in as much pain as the thunderbird.
After all, he was a dragon with a strong physique and high cultivation, and he also mastered the lightning elemental law.

Zhang Fei and the others did not have an opportunity to breathe a sigh of relief, especially since dozens of other lightning bolts attacked them once again, and their power was greater than the first.
*Zap...
Zap...
Zap...*
All of them grimaced in pain after being hit by the lightning bolts, but the one who experienced the most pain among them was Lei Qui.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei had given him many healing pills, and he also helped his recovery using his light element.

[Master, I detected Divine Qi flowing into your body through those lightning bolts, and the number continues to increase, so I think your Heavenly Body Tempering will reach the final stage after you complete your breakthrough this time.]
Zhang Fei was puzzled by that, especially since he still couldn't absorb the Divine Qi from the air directly, but his body could absorb the one contained within those lightning bolts.
He immediately ignored that as the third attack moved towards them; he and his five clones quickly absorbed those lightning bolts.
Time passed, and Zhang Fei and the others continued to receive attacks from his multiple lightning tribulations.

Meanwhile, countless cultivators had gathered outside the Thunderfall Gorge, and some of them tried to enter it, but they were forced back by the powerful lightning that continued to rain down on the place.
Three middle-aged male cultivators decided to use defensive artifacts to break into the place, but they only found Hong Xinxin inside.
One of them immediately approached her and spoke to her.
"Miss, my name is Lei Xuantong, and I would like to ask if you know the identity of the person who made the breakthrough up there."
"My husband." Hong Xinxin's answer confused them because she was still a virgin, so they found it difficult to believe.
"It's up to you whether you want to believe it or not, but I advise you guys not to bother me and leave this place right now."
"Hey, you—" Another middle-aged man wanted to scold Hong Xinxin, but a powerful lightning bolt quickly descended from the sky.
*Zap...
Zap...
Zap...*
"Arghh!" The middle-aged man screamed in pain as soon as the lightning bolt struck his body, causing his clothes to shatter and him to suffer serious injuries.
Lei Xuantong and the other middle-aged man immediately jumped away, and they looked at the sky with expressions of shock.
Hong Xinxin directly spoke to them.
"My husband never likes it when men try to get close to me, so you two better leave this place, or you will suffer like your friend."
"How—"
"Stop asking and leave!" Hong Xinxin interrupted Lei Xuantong.
"If my husband doesn't attack you two, I will attack you guys."
Lei Xuantong nodded to Hong Xinxin and turned to leave.
"Let's go back."
"What about that guy?"
"His injuries are too severe, and he will die soon." Lei Xuantong hurriedly left the place, followed by the other one.
Hong Xinxin turned to face the middle-aged man, whose body had burned from the earlier lightning bolt attack.
She used her lightning element, and she ended her suffering by killing him.
She then looked up at that sky with a smile, realizing that Zhang Fei and the others were fine behind those dark clouds.
"If he didn't have the lightning element and hadn't studied its laws, he wouldn't have been able to withstand his breakthrough this time.
However, the heavens seemed eager to kill him, so I'm sure his lightning tribulation won't end anytime soon, and it will probably last for days."
Meanwhile, in the Xianjin Realm, several people were gathered together, discussing some matters.
They were Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, Wang Wugui, Huli Xianniang, and Zhu Shanniang.

Were you able to contact your people in the Sky Dragon Realm?" Wang Wugui asked Long Qiang.
Long Qiang shook his head in response.
