chapters.title: Chapter 917: Three Upgrades
paragraphs: "Those ignorant beasts are starting to move, Xiuluo." Ye Zhiye, who was standing by the window, said this to Tian Shuixiang.

"They have been blinded by their pride, and they have ignored the fact that Zhang Fei has connections with many people who are on a higher level than us, such as the people in the Sun and Star Towers." Tian Shuixiang released a soft sigh, opened his eyes, and continued. "They had heard from others about how he toyed with Xereth when they surrounded him in the Starry Sky Realm, and not even the demon could track his whereabouts, let alone those beasts."

"I think the ones who will suffer the most among them are that female golden fox and vermilion bird, especially since I experienced it myself several months ago." Ye Zhiye shivered as she recalled the events of that day. "Huli Xianniang and Zhu Shanniang may be strong, but Zhang Fei's lust demon abilities can bypass their cultivation. If he uses his abilities on them, they will completely submit to him and willingly surrender themselves to him."

Tian Shuixiang stood up and approached Ye Zhiye before hugging her waist. "I don't like this situation because it can weaken us, especially if Zhang Fei kills Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, and Wang Wugui. Unfortunately, they have already made up their minds to attack him, so we can only wait for the results."
"Yeah." Ye Zhiye leaned against his chest. "What about your decision? Have you thought about my idea back then?"
Tian Shuixiang gave a light nod. "Once the matter regarding Xereth is resolved, we will go straight to the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and we will distance ourselves from the hustle and bustle."

"I'm glad you finally agreed to my idea." Ye Zhiye looked up at him. "Honestly, I'm tired of hiding in the three mortal realms, and I want to return to the Paradise Realm. Moreover, hundreds of thousands of years have passed there, so I think they have forgotten about us, and we should be able to stay safely there."
Tian Shuixiang fell into contemplation because of that. "How about we wait until Zhang Fei is ready to go there?"
"Hmm?" Ye Zhiye raised an eyebrow.

"I don't know what that kid is doing now, but I believe it won't take him too long to go to the Paradise Realm, and he might be ready to go there much earlier than we thought." Ye Zhiye did not deny Tian Shuixiang's words, but he also doubted that Zhang Fei could go to that realm so quickly, especially since his cultivation had not yet broken through to the Seven Divine Realms. "Are you in such a hurry to get back there?"
Ye Zhiye shook her head. "Since you are confident in Zhang Fei, I will follow your plan, and we will return to that realm together with him."
"Let's continue our seclusion."
"Yeah."
Elsewhere, Lin Jingxia stood alone by the window with her hands behind her waist, staring into the distance in deep thought.

Unlike Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, Lin Jingxia knew that Zhang Fei and his five clones were busy with their isolation, so she wasn't too worried about the five mythical beasts leaving to capture him. However, he disliked their decision to attack him, especially since they were much more senior than him.

"I hope that kid doesn't act as crazy as them, or the three mortal realms will lose some powerful cultivators, and we won't be able to do anything if an enemy stronger than Xereth suddenly appears." Lin Jingxia then turned towards the bedroom door, and a woman walked in. "Why did you come to see me, Zhu Hong?"
"Do you have a way to contact Zhang Fei?" Zhu Hong immediately moved to Lin Jingxia's side.

Tian Jingxia shook her head slightly. "If you are worried about Zhu Shanniang, I can assure you that nothing will happen to her for now, especially since Zhang Fei and his clones are in seclusion. However, that kid is really cunning, and he already knows about their jealousy toward him, so he might have already prepared something in the Sky Dragon Realm to deal with them."

"In fact, Zhang Fei brought many female beasts from the Sky Dragon Realm into seclusion with him, one of whom was my cousin, Zhu Lingyao." Tian Jingxia already knew about it because Zhang Fei had told her a few months ago, but she was surprised to hear from Zhu Hong that he brought many people with him. "He brought those from the Golden Crow, Qilin, Kunpeng, Phoenix, and Nian Clans. From my Vermilion Clan, he only brought one member, who is my cousin. He ignored the Dragon, Black Turtle, and White Tiger Clans."
Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding. "Actually, Zhang Fei came here a few months ago to meet me and the Nameless One; he brought Zhi Yan and Xue Bao with him."
"Oh?" Zhu Hong was surprised to hear that. "How do you think this matter will end?"

"The final result depends on both parties." Lin Jingxia exhaled softly and looked out the window again. "Zhang Fei has already explained to me about his purpose of collecting those female beasts, and I can tell you that he is the strongest cultivator in the three mortal realms right now. If those five beasts attack him, and if he is furious with them, then they will definitely die in his hands."
"What do you mean by that? How can Zhang Fei be the strongest cultivator with his cultivation still at the ten mortal realms?" Zhu Hong asked in confusion.

Lin Jingxia released a soft sigh. "For ordinary cultivators like us, the difference in our cultivation levels will determine many things. However, we all know that Zhang Fei is different from us, and he has many things that we cannot understand in his possession; otherwise, the people from the Star Tower would not speak highly of him, right? They were even willing to help him, despite considering him a weakling."
"You mean Zhang Fei is hiding his true strength?"
"No." Lin Jingxia shook her head before explaining. "Zhang Fei's true strength is as we have known all this time, but he has a unique ability that allows him to borrow the power of other beasts."

"Hmm?" Zhu Hong raised an eyebrow slightly. "I've heard of such an ability before, and my ancestor, Zhu Zhen, can also use it. However, he can only borrow twenty percent of other beasts' power, and he can only do it for ten minutes."

"Zhang Fei's ability is on an entirely different level, and he can borrow the full power of other beasts indefinitely." Zhu Hong's eyes widened after Lin Jingxia said that. "The most terrifying thing about his ability is that not only can he borrow power from one beast, but he can also borrow power from several beasts at once."
"Are you kidding me?" Zhu Hong asked with a scream. "How—"

"I don't know how Zhang Fei did it, but he showed it to me in person." Zhu Hong was completely shocked to hear that from Lin Jingxia. "Feng Yichen is already too strong for us, and he can borrow her full power. Not to mention, there are many female beasts by his side now, so you should be able to imagine how strong he will be if he borrows their power, right?"
"If Zhang Fei does that, he will become unrivaled."

"That's right." Lin Jingxia nodded. "Actually, I didn't want to tell anyone else about this, but I understand your worries about Zhu Shanniang, so I'm telling you. I can't do anything about her, so you have to try to stop her yourself, or it will be too late once she reaches the Sky Dragon Realm."

Zhu Hong massaged her forehead. "I have repeatedly warned Zhu Shanniang not to seek trouble with Zhang Fei, but her unreasonable hatred towards the Heavenly Fox Race has already blinded her. Even after he said he wasn't one of them, she still wants to be his enemy. By the way, thanks for the information; I will contact her now."
"It's okay." After that, Lin Jingxia continued her seclusion.

In various locations, individuals familiar with Zhang Fei discussed the decision made by the five beasts to hunt him down, including people from the Red Sun Realm and others. They regretted those people's decision because they knew his character was good enough, and some of them sent him voice messages, persuading him not to kill the five beasts.

However, Zhang Fei did not reply to them because he and his clones were busy facing the lightning tribulations that continued to descend on the Raging Thunder Realm, causing them to sigh to themselves.
The ancestors of several mythical beast races were also disappointed with Long Qiang and the other four, and they decided to stay away from the Dragon, Black Turtle, and White Tiger Clans.

The most furious among them was Huli Zhishen, especially since Huli Jinhu made a unilateral decision, even though she had repeatedly opposed his idea of killing Zhang Fei. She decided to leave the Xianjin Realm and return to the Wilderness Expanse Realm without caring about the situation in front of them, especially because she had a bad feeling that her partner's decision would endanger their race members.

On the flying artifact, Zhu Shanniang stood at the stern with a frown, listening to Zhu Hong's voice message asking her to immediately return to the Xianjin Realm. 'What's wrong with her? Why would she go to such lengths just for that brat? She even threatened to excommunicate me from our race if I joined these guys to attack that brat.'
"What happened to you?" Zhu Shanniang turned to Huli Xianniang and explained to her about Zhu Hong's voice message, causing her to frown. "Did she tell you her reasons for that?"
Zhu Shanniang shook her head in response. "Zhu Hong told me that Zhang Fei is extremely dangerous, but she didn't give me more details about him."

"I didn't expect that Zhu Hong was so cowardly now; she was so afraid of a snotty brat like Zhang Fei. If I were her, I would step down from her position as the matriarch of your race, and I would hand it over to you, so your race would be more developed than it is now." Zhu Shanniang did not respond to Huli Xianniang, especially since she never had a dream of becoming the matriarch. "You don't need to listen to her, and we will immediately attack that brat once we arrive at the Sky Dragon Realm in two months."
"Yeah." Zhu Shanning immediately replied to Zhu Hong's voice message and threatened her back.
"How did it go? Is Zhu Shanniang willing to listen to you?" Zhu Zhen asked.

Zhu Hong shook her head before she explained the situation to him. "Since she has made such a decision, I have decided to excommunicate her from our race, and she will no longer have any relationship with us."
"You should tell Zhu Jiang, Zhu Ning, and Zhu Lingyao about this matter, especially since they are Zhu Shanniang's family." The female ancestor of the vermilion bird spoke.

"I just told Zhu Jiang and Zhu Ning about this matter, Ancestor Danqing." Zhu Hong let out a soft sigh before continuing. "However, I have not been able to contact Zhu Lingyao because she has entered seclusion with Zhang Fei for the past few months, and I do not know how to contact her."

"Do they have a special relationship? Why did she enter into seclusion with him?" Zhu Hong immediately explained to the two about Zhang Fei's decision to bring many female beasts, including Zhu Lingyao, into seclusion with him. However, she did not explain to them about his ability to borrow the power of many beasts at once, especially since that would only intimidate them. "Try contacting him, especially since his clones often roam other realms."
Zhu Hong immediately followed Zhu Danqing's orders by contacting Zhang Fei. "He seems busy and hasn't responded to me, but I left him a voice message, so we can only wait for now."
"All right, you can leave and continue your seclusion."
"Yes, Ancestor Zhen."
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host's Heavenly Body Tempering Technique has been upgraded to the platinum body.]
[Congratulations! The host's lightning element has been upgraded to the advanced stage.]
[Congratulations! The host's lightning elemental law has been upgraded to the half-perfection stage.]
After a week had passed, the situation in the Raging Thunder Realm had calmed down again, and the sky had also become bright.

Behind the clouds, Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction after his breakthrough was complete and his Heavenly Body Tempering Technique reached its max level, making his physique fifteen percent stronger and his raw strength ten percent stronger.

Meanwhile, Lei Que and Long Jishan appeared disheveled because they lacked a regenerative healing factor like his. Although the healing pills they swallowed could restore their condition, his lightning tribulations fell non-stop for a week, making their effects impossible to catch up with their injuries.
However, they were fortunate because Zhang Fei and his five clones continued to assist them in recovering using their light elements; otherwise, they would have sustained serious injuries long ago.

Since the current Long Jishan was already strong enough, he had not experienced any significant improvements. On the other hand, Lei Que's cultivation increased significantly, and he had already reached the 10-Star Earth Realm, which was the fastest among all the beasts by Zhang Fei's side.

"You can rest now, Lei Que." Zhang Fei immediately sent the thunderbird and Long Jishan back to the beast space, and he himself returned to the pavilion with his four clones, leaving his fifth clone in that realm.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately landed in front of Hong Xinxin, who had been faithfully waiting for her for the past week. "See? I told you that I would be fine, right? Not only has my cultivation reached the 1-star Sovereign Realm now, but I also gained a lot from my crazy breakthrough this time."
"What benefits do you get?" Hong Xinxin curiously asked.

"My Heavenly Body Tempering Technique has reached the max level, and my lightning element and elemental law have reached the third stage." Hong Xinxin was shocked by the last two things, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained to her, especially about the Divine Qi inside all the lightning bolts that had struck her for a whole week. "I don't understand the reason behind the heavens' decision to use the Divine Qi, but I am grateful that they used it to attack me. This way, my body is much stronger than the cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms, and it will be easier for me to break through to that stage in the future."
Hong Xinxin nodded in agreement with that. "What are your plans next? Are you still going to train in this place?"

"I want to reach the max level in my lightning and elemental law soon, so I won't leave this realm before I achieve both." Zhang Fei [5] then looked into the distance. "Five enemies are looking for me now, and they are eager to kill me. Unfortunately, it will be quite some time before they arrive in the Sky Dragon Realm, so I can't face them yet."
"Those mythical beasts, right?"

"Since they want to kill me, I have to do something to them, right?" Zhang Fei [5] said with an evil smirk on his face, causing Hong Xinxin to helplessly shake her head. "Let's continue our seclusion while waiting for them to arrive in that realm."
"What about those people outside?" Hong Xinxin asked, pointing at the exit.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I don't mean to be arrogant, but they are not my opponents. Thus, we should not mind them and focus on ourselves, especially since Xereth could come out at any time to cause trouble."
"All right." Hong Xinxin then grabbed Zhang Fei [5]'s hand. "Let's check the deepest part of this place to prove the folklore about the existence of that powerful lightning beast."
"I'll join you two, Master." Lei, the lightning spirit, hurriedly followed Zhang Fei [5] and Hong Xinxin.

sentences.text: "Those ignorant beasts are starting to move, Xiuluo." Ye Zhiye, who was standing by the window, said this to Tian Shuixiang.

"They have been blinded by their pride, and they have ignored the fact that Zhang Fei has connections with many people who are on a higher level than us, such as the people in the Sun and Star Towers." Tian Shuixiang released a soft sigh, opened his eyes, and continued.
"They had heard from others about how he toyed with Xereth when they surrounded him in the Starry Sky Realm, and not even the demon could track his whereabouts, let alone those beasts."

"I think the ones who will suffer the most among them are that female golden fox and vermilion bird, especially since I experienced it myself several months ago." Ye Zhiye shivered as she recalled the events of that day.
"Huli Xianniang and Zhu Shanniang may be strong, but Zhang Fei's lust demon abilities can bypass their cultivation.
If he uses his abilities on them, they will completely submit to him and willingly surrender themselves to him."
Tian Shuixiang stood up and approached Ye Zhiye before hugging her waist.
"I don't like this situation because it can weaken us, especially if Zhang Fei kills Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, and Wang Wugui.
Unfortunately, they have already made up their minds to attack him, so we can only wait for the results."
"Yeah." Ye Zhiye leaned against his chest.
"What about your decision?
Have you thought about my idea back then?"
Tian Shuixiang gave a light nod.
"Once the matter regarding Xereth is resolved, we will go straight to the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and we will distance ourselves from the hustle and bustle."
"I'm glad you finally agreed to my idea." Ye Zhiye looked up at him.
"Honestly, I'm tired of hiding in the three mortal realms, and I want to return to the Paradise Realm.
Moreover, hundreds of thousands of years have passed there, so I think they have forgotten about us, and we should be able to stay safely there."
Tian Shuixiang fell into contemplation because of that.
"How about we wait until Zhang Fei is ready to go there?"
"Hmm?" Ye Zhiye raised an eyebrow.

"I don't know what that kid is doing now, but I believe it won't take him too long to go to the Paradise Realm, and he might be ready to go there much earlier than we thought." Ye Zhiye did not deny Tian Shuixiang's words, but he also doubted that Zhang Fei could go to that realm so quickly, especially since his cultivation had not yet broken through to the Seven Divine Realms.
"Are you in such a hurry to get back there?"
Ye Zhiye shook her head.
"Since you are confident in Zhang Fei, I will follow your plan, and we will return to that realm together with him."
"Let's continue our seclusion."
"Yeah."
Elsewhere, Lin Jingxia stood alone by the window with her hands behind her waist, staring into the distance in deep thought.

Unlike Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, Lin Jingxia knew that Zhang Fei and his five clones were busy with their isolation, so she wasn't too worried about the five mythical beasts leaving to capture him.
However, he disliked their decision to attack him, especially since they were much more senior than him.

"I hope that kid doesn't act as crazy as them, or the three mortal realms will lose some powerful cultivators, and we won't be able to do anything if an enemy stronger than Xereth suddenly appears." Lin Jingxia then turned towards the bedroom door, and a woman walked in.
"Why did you come to see me, Zhu Hong?"
"Do you have a way to contact Zhang Fei?" Zhu Hong immediately moved to Lin Jingxia's side.
Tian Jingxia shook her head slightly.
"If you are worried about Zhu Shanniang, I can assure you that nothing will happen to her for now, especially since Zhang Fei and his clones are in seclusion.
However, that kid is really cunning, and he already knows about their jealousy toward him, so he might have already prepared something in the Sky Dragon Realm to deal with them."

"In fact, Zhang Fei brought many female beasts from the Sky Dragon Realm into seclusion with him, one of whom was my cousin, Zhu Lingyao." Tian Jingxia already knew about it because Zhang Fei had told her a few months ago, but she was surprised to hear from Zhu Hong that he brought many people with him.
"He brought those from the Golden Crow, Qilin, Kunpeng, Phoenix, and Nian Clans.
From my Vermilion Clan, he only brought one member, who is my cousin.
He ignored the Dragon, Black Turtle, and White Tiger Clans."
Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding.
"Actually, Zhang Fei came here a few months ago to meet me and the Nameless One; he brought Zhi Yan and Xue Bao with him."
"Oh?" Zhu Hong was surprised to hear that.
"How do you think this matter will end?"
"The final result depends on both parties." Lin Jingxia exhaled softly and looked out the window again.
"Zhang Fei has already explained to me about his purpose of collecting those female beasts, and I can tell you that he is the strongest cultivator in the three mortal realms right now.
If those five beasts attack him, and if he is furious with them, then they will definitely die in his hands."
"What do you mean by that?
How can Zhang Fei be the strongest cultivator with his cultivation still at the ten mortal realms?" Zhu Hong asked in confusion.
Lin Jingxia released a soft sigh.
"For ordinary cultivators like us, the difference in our cultivation levels will determine many things.

However, we all know that Zhang Fei is different from us, and he has many things that we cannot understand in his possession; otherwise, the people from the Star Tower would not speak highly of him, right?
They were even willing to help him, despite considering him a weakling."
"You mean Zhang Fei is hiding his true strength?"
"No." Lin Jingxia shook her head before explaining.
"Zhang Fei's true strength is as we have known all this time, but he has a unique ability that allows him to borrow the power of other beasts."
"Hmm?" Zhu Hong raised an eyebrow slightly.
"I've heard of such an ability before, and my ancestor, Zhu Zhen, can also use it.
However, he can only borrow twenty percent of other beasts' power, and he can only do it for ten minutes."
"Zhang Fei's ability is on an entirely different level, and he can borrow the full power of other beasts indefinitely." Zhu Hong's eyes widened after Lin Jingxia said that.
"The most terrifying thing about his ability is that not only can he borrow power from one beast, but he can also borrow power from several beasts at once."
"Are you kidding me?" Zhu Hong asked with a scream.
"How—"
"I don't know how Zhang Fei did it, but he showed it to me in person." Zhu Hong was completely shocked to hear that from Lin Jingxia.
"Feng Yichen is already too strong for us, and he can borrow her full power.
Not to mention, there are many female beasts by his side now, so you should be able to imagine how strong he will be if he borrows their power, right?"
"If Zhang Fei does that, he will become unrivaled."
"That's right." Lin Jingxia nodded.
"Actually, I didn't want to tell anyone else about this, but I understand your worries about Zhu Shanniang, so I'm telling you.
I can't do anything about her, so you have to try to stop her yourself, or it will be too late once she reaches the Sky Dragon Realm."
Zhu Hong massaged her forehead.
"I have repeatedly warned Zhu Shanniang not to seek trouble with Zhang Fei, but her unreasonable hatred towards the Heavenly Fox Race has already blinded her.
Even after he said he wasn't one of them, she still wants to be his enemy.
By the way, thanks for the information; I will contact her now."
"It's okay." After that, Lin Jingxia continued her seclusion.
In various locations, individuals familiar with Zhang Fei discussed the decision made by the five beasts to hunt him down, including people from the Red Sun Realm and others.
They regretted those people's decision because they knew his character was good enough, and some of them sent him voice messages, persuading him not to kill the five beasts.

However, Zhang Fei did not reply to them because he and his clones were busy facing the lightning tribulations that continued to descend on the Raging Thunder Realm, causing them to sigh to themselves.
The ancestors of several mythical beast races were also disappointed with Long Qiang and the other four, and they decided to stay away from the Dragon, Black Turtle, and White Tiger Clans.
The most furious among them was Huli Zhishen, especially since Huli Jinhu made a unilateral decision, even though she had repeatedly opposed his idea of killing Zhang Fei.

She decided to leave the Xianjin Realm and return to the Wilderness Expanse Realm without caring about the situation in front of them, especially because she had a bad feeling that her partner's decision would endanger their race members.
On the flying artifact, Zhu Shanniang stood at the stern with a frown, listening to Zhu Hong's voice message asking her to immediately return to the Xianjin Realm. 'What's wrong with her?
Why would she go to such lengths just for that brat?
She even threatened to excommunicate me from our race if I joined these guys to attack that brat.'
"What happened to you?" Zhu Shanniang turned to Huli Xianniang and explained to her about Zhu Hong's voice message, causing her to frown.
"Did she tell you her reasons for that?"
Zhu Shanniang shook her head in response.
"Zhu Hong told me that Zhang Fei is extremely dangerous, but she didn't give me more details about him."
"I didn't expect that Zhu Hong was so cowardly now; she was so afraid of a snotty brat like Zhang Fei.

If I were her, I would step down from her position as the matriarch of your race, and I would hand it over to you, so your race would be more developed than it is now." Zhu Shanniang did not respond to Huli Xianniang, especially since she never had a dream of becoming the matriarch.
"You don't need to listen to her, and we will immediately attack that brat once we arrive at the Sky Dragon Realm in two months."
"Yeah." Zhu Shanning immediately replied to Zhu Hong's voice message and threatened her back.
"How did it go?
Is Zhu Shanniang willing to listen to you?" Zhu Zhen asked.
Zhu Hong shook her head before she explained the situation to him.
"Since she has made such a decision, I have decided to excommunicate her from our race, and she will no longer have any relationship with us."
"You should tell Zhu Jiang, Zhu Ning, and Zhu Lingyao about this matter, especially since they are Zhu Shanniang's family." The female ancestor of the vermilion bird spoke.
"I just told Zhu Jiang and Zhu Ning about this matter, Ancestor Danqing." Zhu Hong let out a soft sigh before continuing.
"However, I have not been able to contact Zhu Lingyao because she has entered seclusion with Zhang Fei for the past few months, and I do not know how to contact her."
"Do they have a special relationship?
Why did she enter into seclusion with him?" Zhu Hong immediately explained to the two about Zhang Fei's decision to bring many female beasts, including Zhu Lingyao, into seclusion with him.
However, she did not explain to them about his ability to borrow the power of many beasts at once, especially since that would only intimidate them.
"Try contacting him, especially since his clones often roam other realms."
Zhu Hong immediately followed Zhu Danqing's orders by contacting Zhang Fei.
"He seems busy and hasn't responded to me, but I left him a voice message, so we can only wait for now."
"All right, you can leave and continue your seclusion."
"Yes, Ancestor Zhen."

chapters.title: Chapter 918: Azure Emperor Roc
paragraphs: When the three of them arrived at the end of Thunderfall Gorge, they saw a deep and wide hole covered by lightning. However, the lightning prevented them from checking into it, and the system could not check the inside either. 'Can you detect any signs of life in it, Mei?'
[Not at all, Master. I think you should go into it yourself to check.]
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "Can you check inside, Lei?"
"Let me try it first, Master." Lei entered the hole straight away.
"Do you think that beast lives inside this deep hole?" Hong Xinxin asked.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "We can only find out by checking inside directly, but we should wait for Lei to come back first. If the beast referred to in folklore really exists, I don't think it's an ordinary one. So we must be cautious, especially since we don't know what kind of beast it is or its rank.
"Yeah, you're right."
After they waited for some time, Lei finally came out of the hole and informed them directly. "Master, the beast does exist, but it is dead."
"Dead?" Zhang Fei [5] and Hong Xinxin were shocked by that. "Do you know what kind of beast is in there, Lei?"

"That beast is the mythical Azure Emperor Roc, and its body is colossal." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding, as he had read about the Roc Bird in the myth. "Master, the beast is dead, but its corpse is still well preserved."

[Master, you should check the corpse of the beast. Since it is still well-preserved, there might still be its origin bloodline and beast core inside. Furthermore, the Azure Roc Emperor is a mythical beast, and it has the lightning element, so it is perfect for one of your wives who wants to transform into a beast.]

"Let's check the beast's corpse, Fei." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Hong Xinxin, who looked impatient. "Hehe! You can transform me into the Azure Emperor Roc, right? Since that beast is a mythical beast, I want to become one, unless you want to use it for your other woman."

"All of you are my women, okay? I thought about using it for Ye Lian, but since you want it, you can use it first, and I will find another beast for her in the future." Hong Xinxin smiled when she heard that, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately hugged her before taking her to jump into the hole, followed by Lei.
"Woah! This beast is truly huge!" Hong Xinxin exclaimed as soon as they arrived at the bottom.
The Azure Roc Emperor itself is the largest flying beast, and it is often regarded as the king of the sky. Its wingspan can stretch across mountains, and its feathers sparkle like sapphires.

In contrast to Hong Xinxin, who looked excited, Zhang Fei was more curious about how such a huge and powerful mythical beast could have died. He was curious about the killer and how the corpse was so well preserved. As a mythical beast, he could feel that the aura of the Azure Emperor Roc was lingering in the hole, which made all living creatures dare not approach the place.

[Master, I've scanned this corpse, and the Azure Emperor Roc's origin bloodline and beast core are still intact inside. This way, you can transform Hong Xinxin into this beast, and you can ask for a few drops of her origin bloodline later, which is very useful for increasing your lightning element.]

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement with that, but he immediately frowned as soon as smoke billowed out of the beast's corpse, forcing Hong Xinxin to move away from it. Soon, the smoke turned into a huge transparent bird figure, which was the beast's soul.
{How did you two get to this place? Why didn't my aura scare you?}

"Why should I be afraid of your aura?" Zhang Fei [5] then transformed into his half-fox form, with seven tails dancing behind him. "I am a mythical beast myself, and I'm not as weak as you think, so your aura is useless against me.
{A heavenly fox, huh? Did you come here to take my corpse?}

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] immediately admitted it. "I have too many powerful enemies out there, and I won't stay in the three mortal realms forever. One day in the future, I will ascend to a higher realm, and I need many powerful women by my side for that. Therefore, I am here to take your corpse, and I will use every part of your body to transform my wife into an Azure Emperor Roc like you."

The Azure Emperor Roc stared at Zhang Fei [5] in disbelief. {What do you mean by the higher realm? Is there another realm after the upper realms? Before I died, I had lived for hundreds of thousands of years, and I had never heard of it. Also, what do you mean by you want to transform your wife into my kin?}

"I won't waste time explaining it to you in detail, but I have the ability to transform humans into beasts. It's just that I need an intact beast corpse to be able to do it, and your corpse is perfectly intact." The Azure Roc Emperor couldn't believe Zhang Fei's explanation [5]. "It's up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but it's a fact. You may not have heard of a higher realm when you were alive in the past, but I can tell you that it does exist, and the people in that realm call it the Paradise Realm. Not only that, but there are also several other cultivation stages above the Seven Divine Realms, called the Five Celestial Realms."
{How do you know all that?}
Before Zhang Fei [5] could answer the Azure Emperor Roc, Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu had already emerged from his soul sea.

"Naturally, my master heard it from us, especially since we both came from that realm." The Azure Emperor Roc immediately looked at Nalan Yushu, and it could feel that her soul was much stronger than its own.

Ma Kuangyu then spoke to the beast. "I've met several Azure Emperor Rocs in the past, and they were truly powerful, especially when they were in the air. Moreover, their rank was not a mythical rank like yours, and their rank was an immortal rank."
{Huh? Are you serious? Are there really immortal rank beasts in this universe?}

"Do I need to lie to a dead soul like you?" Ma Kuangyu asked back with a shake of his head. "There are too many immortal rank beasts in the Paradise Realm, and one of them is Taotie, which is one of the four peril evil beasts. There is also the five-clawed golden dragon, Long Wuzhao. Since you are dead, your corpse is no longer useful to you, so you can hand it over to this kid. Once he turns his wife into your kin, she will become your heir and inherit all your abilities. I think that is the best choice rather than letting your corpse be wasted in this hole, right?"

The Azure Emperor Roc immediately observed Hong Xinxin; it could feel that her lightning element had reached the peak, and her lightning elemental law was also quite high. {All right, I will give my corpse to you, and I will use the remains of my soul to strengthen her soul.}
"Thank you." Zhang Fei [5] then asked. "How did you die? Did someone kill you? Could someone have preserved your corpse here?"

{I won't tell you about my death.} Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows at the Azure Emperor Roc, but the beast still didn't want to say it. {As for my corpse, I am a lightning-type beast, and the lightning in this place is filled with the Divine Qi, which preserved my corpse.}
The Azure Emperor Roc's instantly turned into a small transparent ball before entering Hong Xinxin's body, and it went straight into her soul space to merge with her soul.

After Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu entered his soul sea, Zhang Fei [5] sent Hong Xinxin and the Azure Emperor Roc's corpse into the pavilion. He didn't leave the hole, but instead, he started cultivating there, especially since no one would disturb him there.

Inside the pavilion, all the women living there lined up around the Azure Emperor Roc's corpse, especially since they had never seen such a gigantic flying beast before. Even female flying beasts such as Feng Yichen, Yan Jinwu, Feng Qingmeng, and Zhu Lingyao were amazed by their size.

Zhang Fei pulled Ye Lian into his embrace and spoke to her. "At first, I wanted to give it to you, Lian'er. However, Xinxin wants to transform into this beast, so I'll use it on her first, and I'll find you another beast in the future."
"I'm glad you thought of me, but I don't mind that, especially since we're all one big family here." Ye Lian said it with a sincere smile.
"Thank you for your understanding, Lian'er."
"Don't fret it."

Zhang Fei gave Ye Lian a brief and warm kiss before squatting beside the beast's corpse, and he carefully took the beast's core so as not to damage the corpse, especially since he wanted to use it for something else.
After Zhang Fei took the beast core, Feng Yichen helped him extract the beast's origin bloodline, and she cut off some parts from the corpse before handing them to him.
Zhang Fei immediately took out the capsule. "Lie down in it, Xinxin."

After Hong Xinxin lay down in the capsule, Zhang Fei immediately put all the body parts of the Azure Emperor Roc into each hole, including its origin bloodline and beast core. 'Are you sure this method will work, Mei? We usually use ten beast cores, but we are using a different method now.'

[Both methods are actually the same, Master. We usually use ten beast cores because you don't have the beast origin bloodline and body parts, so you don't have to worry about that, and Hong Xinxin will definitely become the Azure Emperor Roc after this.]
Zhang Fei gave a light nod. 'All right, I will leave the process to you, and you must succeed in turning Xinxin into the beast.'
[Leave it to me, Master.] Mei immediately started the process.
"Husband, you should ask Hong Xinxin's origin bloodline after she transforms into the Azure Emperor Roc, and your lightning will increase even higher." Boitata spoke to Zhang Fei.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled in response. "Naturally, I have thought about it, and I will have six mythical beast bloodlines after that."
"Oh." Boitata then grabbed his dick. "You left us hungry for a week, so you have to satisfy us now, and my sisters agree with me."

Zhang Fei turned to his other women, and most of them looked at him with lustful gazes, especially those with dragon bloodlines, such as Ru Xue, Zhang Lin, Zhong Yan, and Shen Yu. "Hahaha! You guys are this impatient, huh?"
"Yes!" They answered simultaneously.
Zhang Fei first sent the beast's corpse into the beast space before leading all his wives away. "Let's go to my bedroom, and I will satisfy you all while waiting for Xinxin to finish the process."

Inside her soul space, Hong Xinxin stared at the soul of Azure Emperor Roc, who was lost in thought. "What are you thinking? You can't back down anymore, especially since my husband has already taken some of your body parts, including your origin bloodline and core."
{I'm not thinking about going back down, and I'm just thinking about the past.}

The beast's answer piqued Hong Xinxin's curiosity. "How could you die back then? I'm sure that what preserved your corpse was not the Divine Qi in the hole, but someone deliberately preserved your body and left the remnants of your soul there, right?"

The Azure Emperor Roc nodded to her. {My name is Qing Peng, and I died because my lifespan ended. My master took me to that realm when I was nearing my death, and he deliberately dug that hole to keep my corpse. After I died, he preserved my corpse and helped me retain a bit of my soul for my heir.}
"Hmm?" Hong Xinxin raised an eyebrow slightly. "Does that mean your master already knew that someone would come to take your corpse? Is he still alive now?"

The Azure Emperor Roc let out a soft sigh. {Like me, my master never managed to break through to the next realm, so he should have died long ago. However, he did not die here, and he should have died in his home realm, the Sovereign Heaven Realm.}
"Huh?" Hong Xinxin was shocked by that. "Did your late master really come from that realm? What was his name?"

{My past master was Tian Kongquan, one of the founders of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and he was their first leader.} When Qing Peng said that, Hong Xinxin's jaw fell open. {When he was alive, my master had a unique ability, which allowed him to see a person's fate far into the future. However, his ability was not without risk, and he had to sacrifice his lifespan to use it. Therefore, he never used it again after knowing the risks, but he decided to use it when I almost died. At that time, he told me that someone would take my corpse in the future, and he wanted that person to be my heir. Thus, he helped me to preserve this soul, and he stored all my cultivation in it. All his guesses have come true now, and you are the person he meant at that time. Once you turn into my kin, I will merge this soul with yours, and you will inherit my cultivation in the 5-Divine Ascension Realm.}

Hong Xinxin was overjoyed after hearing the news, particularly because reaching the Divine Ascension Realm is a challenging achievement. If she cultivated normally, she would still need thousands or even tens of thousands of years to achieve it, even with the help of Zhang Fei's Yang Qi. "How did your master help you with that? I've heard that only those from the Paradise Realm can do that, not cultivators from the three mortal realms."

Qing Peng shook his head in response. {I never knew how he could do it, especially since he never explained it to me. Since you will be my heir, I have one request for you: I want you to go to the Sovereign Heaven Realm to visit my master's tomb.}

Naturally, Hong Xinxin had no problem with that, especially since Zhang Fei would go to that realm in the future. "I will do it without you asking me, but I can't do it anytime soon, and I will go to that realm after my husband is ready."
{Thank you.} Qing Peng replied with relief. {Your body has started to transform into my kin, so we have to start merging our souls, and you will become the true Azure Emperor Roc.}
"Yeah."

After a day had passed inside the pavilion, Mei informed Zhang Fei that Hong Xinxin's transformation process was nearing completion. He immediately left all his women and went to check the capsule, and several female beasts were also waiting there.
While waiting, Zhang Fei told Zhu Lingyao and the others about Long Qiang and the others' decision, which shocked them. 'What will you do to my sister?'

Following this, Long Xiaogang escorted his family onto the flying artifact, and they swiftly departed from the realm.
Long Zhenxia stood alone at the stern as she stared at the floating island, or rather the location of the Phoenix Clan.
"I wanted to learn many things about alchemy from you, but unfortunately, the situation does not allow it, especially with the problems between you and my clan.
Although we don't have any relationship, I hope for the best for you, especially since my bloodline now flows in your body."
Above the Blazing Phoenix Sect, Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng stood side by side, staring at the flying artifact.
"Why did Zhang Fei let them go?"
"Do you think Zhang Fei is that cruel?" Feng Yongheng nodded to Feng Xishui.
"Even though he is quite ruthless, he still has his humanity.
He doesn't have any problems with them, so you don't need to be confused by his decision to let them go."
"What about Long Zhenxia?"
"Ha ha." Feng Xishui laughed at that.
"You met Feng Yichen before, so you should already understand Zhang Fei's criteria for choosing women.
Long Zhenxia may be a dragon and beautiful, but she is still inferior to him or his other women."
"I have never met his other women, but Feng Yichen is indeed extraordinarily beautiful and powerful." Feng Yongheng paused for a while.
"Long Zhenxia pales in comparison to our princess, and Zhang Fei's connection with her enables me to comprehend his standards in matters concerning women."

"All of Zhang Fei's women are not inferior to our princess or Feng Yichen in terms of beauty, and I believe their strength will reach their level in the future." Feng Xishui released a heavy sigh before continuing.
"Long Qiang and the other four will arrive at this realm in two months, and a one-sided battle will occur at that time."

"Feng Yichen is stronger than Ancestor Shen and Ancestor Xueying, so Long Qiang and the others are simply courting death by coming to this realm to hunt Zhang Fei." Feng Yongheng then turned toward the Dragon Clan.
"This realm is their ancestral land, yet the impending battle will alter their destiny, likely leading to their marginalization after that day."
Feng Xishui nodded at him.
"We don't need to think about them because Zhang Fei already has plans for them, and we have to focus on ourselves, especially since he will take us to the Paradise Realm in the future.
With our current strength, we can't even face Long Qiang and the others, let alone if we have to face cultivators from that realm."
"Yeah, you're right."
Two weeks later, Zhu Lingyao arrived at the Vermilion Realm, and she went straight to see her parents, who had been waiting for her.
However, she only found her mother, and her father had gone to another realm.
"I've heard about you and Zhang Fei, but I didn't expect that you'd already done intimate things with him, Yao'er." Zhu Ning spoke as soon as her second daughter arrived.
Zhu Lingyao smiled at her mother. 'Isn't this what you've always hoped for, Mother?
I've already decided to accept Zhang Fei, and we'll get married someday.'
"Yeah." Zhu Ning nodded her head slightly.
"Unfortunately, our situation is not good, especially since your sister is too stubborn.
Your father and I have been trying to persuade her for the past two weeks, but she just ignored us."
Zhu Lingyao embraced Zhu Ning's shoulders and led her to sit with her. 'Mother, I know your worries, but Zhang Fei already told me that he wouldn't kill my sister.'
"What are his plans for your sister?" Zhu Lingyao immediately told Zhu Ning about Zhang Fei's plans for Zhu Shanniang, shocking her.
"Can... can you persuade him to abandon his plans?"
'No.' Zhu Lingyao answered with a shake of her head. 'Mother, you don't understand Zhang Fei's character, and he is much more ruthless than senior cultivators like our ancestors.
He will never spare his enemies, especially those who try to kill him.
He had warned my sister not to look for trouble with her, and he had also told her that he was not part of the Heavenly Fox Race, but she still insisted on looking for trouble with him.
Since she didn't listen to him, he already considered her an enemy.'
Zhu Ning's expression turned gloomy after hearing that news, and she was genuinely concerned about Zhu Shanniang's safety if she encountered Zhang Fei later.
"What do you mean by he's not part of the Heavenly Fox Race?"

'He was born as an ordinary mortal in a mortal realm, and he knew nothing about cultivation at that time.' Zhu Ning found it difficult to believe Zhu Lingyao's answer, considering Zhang Fei's cultivation level and all his previous actions. 'I can't explain the details to you, but he became a Heavenly Fox because of an accident that killed him, and he has been a cultivator ever since.
In fact, he intended to kill Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, especially since they repeatedly sent their younger generations to kill him.
He killed some of them, and he enslaved the rest.'
Zhu Ning looked at her daughter in shock.
"Do you know the reason they want to kill Zhang Fei?"

'Zhang Fei hasn't told me the truth, but I suspect that it has something to do with the ten-tailed fox.' As a mythical beast, Zhu Ning naturally knew that Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing were Hu Tianlang's direct descendants, but she was confused by Zhang Fei's connection to them, especially since Zhu Lingyao said that he turned into a Heavenly Fox due to an accident. 'Do you remember the prophecy?'
"You mean the prophecy left by the ten-tailed fox, right?"

'Zhang Fei is the man in the prophecy, especially since he is a human, a heavenly fox, and a demon.' Zhu Ning's eyes widened as she gasped in shock after Zhu Lingyao said that. 'By the way, no one can stop him now, including the Nameless One.
He has already surpassed all the ancestors of the mythical beasts by using his special ability, and he also has many powerful beasts by his side.'
"Then, what about your sister?
Are we really going to let her become Zhang Fei's wife's mount?
Is there no other way to save her?" Zhu Ning asked in a gloomy tone.

Zhu Lingyao let out a soft sigh and grabbed her mother's hands, rubbing them to calm her. 'Mother, I don't want something like that to happen to my sister, but we have no other way to save her, especially since Zhang Fei has already made his decision clear.
If we force him to let him go, he might kill him, and you definitely don't want that to happen, right?'
"Yes." Zhu Ning nodded slightly.
Zhu Lingyao continued immediately. 'Zhang Fei never treats women badly, even if they are his enemies, so I'm sure he won't treat her badly.
My sister might feel miserable if that happened to her, but I think it's the best punishment for her stupidity.
If one day she can change her character and get rid of her stupid thoughts from her mind, she might get a better place by his side.'
"You mean." Zhu Lingyao nodded at Zhu Ning.
"I hope you're right about that, especially since I don't want your sister to suffer because of her stupidity."
Zhu Lingyao smiled at her mother. 'Trust me, my sister won't suffer, and she'll probably enjoy herself once she gets used to the situation later.'
"Hmm?" Zhu Ning looked at her daughter with a suspicious look.
"How long will you stay here?
You haven't met your father yet, and I want to hear about your relationship with Zhang Fei."

'I can't stay here for too long, and I have to go back to Zhang Fei to help him.' Zhu Ning sighed in disappointment, and Zhu Lingyao immediately explained to him several things, including her relationship with him and his other women.
Zhu Ning was stunned for quite a while after she found out that Zhang Fei had dozens of women by his side, but she could see that her daughter didn't mind his relationship with those women.
Zhu Lingyao then told her about the situation in their residence, including the relationships between all the women who lived there.
"Is their relationship really that harmonious?"
'Hehe.' Zhu Lingyao giggled. 'I didn't expect it at first either, but their relationship is really harmonious, and there is almost no jealousy between them.'
Zhu Ning suddenly received a voice transmission and informed her daughter directly.
"Your father will be back soon, and since you haven't been home for a long time, we will have dinner together while discussing your sister's matter."
'Yes, Mother.'
Time passed quickly, and Zhu Lingyao decided to return to the Xianjin Realm after she spent some time with her parents.
Zhu Jiang and Zhu Ning asked her to try to persuade Zhang Fei about her sister, and she agreed to their request, even though she knew it wouldn't work.
Like her departure to the Vermilion Realm, it took Zhu Lingyao two weeks to arrive at the Xianjin Realm.
Upon arrival, she immediately contacted Zhang Fei through his clone, who was training in the Raging Thunder Realm.
Zhang Fei quickly picked Zhu Lingyao up and brought her back to the pavilion, where they spent some intimate time together.
As per her parents' request, Zhu Lingyao tried to talk to Zhang Fei about Zhu Shanniang, but he firmly rejected her request.
She did not persuade him further, especially since she herself wanted her sister to be punished for her stupidity.
In the Demon Purgatory Realm, Zhang Fei [1] stood side by side with Serpentera, Tian Kui, and Wang Yin.
The four of them stared at the moon that was getting redder, and its color was increasingly like blood.
"This phenomenon has started to kill the demons in this realm, so I think the Blood Flame will appear in the near future." Wang Yin spoke gloomily.
Tian Kui then asked Zhang Fei [1].
"Are you sure you can overcome your bloodthirst when you absorb the Blood Flame, kid?
If you fail to control it and fall into its grip, you will turn into a bloodthirsty killer.
At that time, you will kill everyone in front of you, regardless of whether they are friends or foes."
"I know your worries, but I'm confident I can control it." Zhang Fei [1] then extended his fist upwards.
"I hope this phenomenon will end soon so I can get the Blood Flame, which will make my flame much stronger."
"Do you need our help, kid?"
Zhang Fei [1] turned to Serpentera and shook his head.
"Those mythical beasts are indeed powerful, but they are not as strong as Feng Yichen.
I've been preparing to face them for months, so I'll handle them with some of my women."
"I see." Serpentera nodded in understanding.
"What exactly did you do for your partners who live in this realm?
I've been watching them for months, and their progress has been incredible; even their demon rank has risen quickly."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed softly.
"I didn't do anything for them, and I only dual cultivate with them every day.
Furthermore, given that my cultivation has already surpassed all of theirs, it's only logical for theirs to grow exponentially, right?
Although my demon rank is still not as high as the two of you, my demon rank is already high enough for the three mortal realms, and my demon power has significantly increased their demon rank."
"Yeah, you're right." Serpentera patted his shoulder.
"I don't know what your future holds, but I think you might make it to the Primordial Demon level one day, and I will always look forward to that day."
"Hahaha!" Tian Kui laughed loudly as he slapped Zhang Fei [1]'s shoulder.

"If you manage to reach the Celestial God realm in your cultivation and achieve the Primordial Demon rank, I'm sure you can face all the cultivators in the Paradise Realm, including immortal evil beasts like Taotie and others."

"Even if I manage to achieve both in the future, I still won't be strong enough to face the Primordial Nihility Beast, right?" Tian Kui and Serpentera released heavy sighs as they nodded to Zhang Fei [1].
"Haha!
Why are you guys sighing so heavily?
Have you two forgotten that I still have one more identity?
According to the information I got, the old ten-tailed fox has strength equivalent to that primordial beast, so we still have a chance to defeat it.
However, evolving into the ten-tailed form is quite difficult, and I still need to collect the other souls."
"Don't worry about the future; just focus on the road ahead." Tian Kui nodded in agreement with Serpentera.
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to leave.
"I'll continue my seclusion now."
In the pavilion, Zhang Fei fully devoted his attention to all his women, both official and unofficial.
He always helped them in their normal cultivation, body cultivation, and soul cultivation.
He didn't forget to visit the two sword spirits, Jian Hei'an and Jian Guang'an.
Besides, he also dual-soul cultivated with Nalan Yushu and Huli Yaohu.
Naturally, Zhang Fei also continued to visit the female beasts in the beast space, especially the half-breed of Qilin and Golden Crow, Lei Huoting.
Besides all that, Zhang Fei also decided to break through to the 2-Star Sovereign Realm after he stabilized his cultivation using one advanced-grade true foundation pill.

Feltia [2], Zhang Xiaolong [3], and Zhang Fei [4] not only dual cultivated with their respective partners, but whenever their partners were tired, they busied themselves with other things, such as blacksmithing, alchemy, and body tempering.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was fully dedicated to his cultivation in the Raging Thunder Realm, but he also continued to enhance his mastery of the Nine Heavens Lightning Art, despite having already mastered all nine sub-techniques.
Zhang Fei [5] was a little disappointed after Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie told him that they had not managed to find Mo Zhuo, especially since he was eager to absorb his demon power.
He ordered them to continue tracking the last of Xereth's men.
A month had passed.
[Ding]
[Congratulations!
The host's body cultivation has broken through to the Bone Forging Stage.]
[The host's raw strength has increased by 20 percent, and endurance by 20 percent.]
Zhang Fei [5], who was cultivating in the hole in the Thunderfall Gorge, immediately opened his eyes.
He clenched both fists.
"I have reached the 3-Star Sovereign Realm in my cultivation, and I have also made another breakthrough in my body cultivation.
This way, I am even more prepared to face Long Qiang and the others.
Only five true foundation pills are left, but they are enough to help me break through to the eighth stage.
I hope Huoyun Zhiyan and the others will succeed in concocting more of the pill so I can quickly reach the Quasi Divine Realm."
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly received a voice transmission, and he turned to Hong Xinxin, who was also cultivating there in her beast form.
"Xinxin, they've arrived, so we're going there now."

chapters.title: Chapter 921: Facing His Enemies
paragraphs: On the Sky Dragon Island, the five mythical beasts had just landed on the floating island, and their arrival caused quite a commotion in the place. The five of them ignored those people, and they went straight to their respective clans.

People from the Golden Crow, Nian, Qilin, and Phoenix Clans noticed their arrivals. However, none of them made a move, but Feng Xishui had already informed Zhang Fei of their arrival, and he was waiting for his arrival.
In addition, Feng Xishui had prepared the strongest members of the Phoenix Clan to help Zhang Fei if the other clans decided to gang up on him.

Long Qiang was completely shocked once he arrived at the Dragon Clan, especially after he witnessed the craziness of his clan members, including the two men he sent to capture Zhang Fei a few months ago.
Long Qiang tried to use all means to awaken Long Aotian and two subordinates, but they still acted like horny dragons, and they continued to fuck their partner without paying any attention to him.
Since the pink gas lingered in the Dragon Clan, Long Qiang slowly began to be affected by it, and he hurriedly left the clan to avoid further influence.
At the Black Tortoise Clan, Wang Wugui immediately ordered people to capture and lock up Wang Guzhe and his entire family, especially since he refused his order to capture Zhang Fei.
Wang Guzhe did not put up any resistance to Wang Wugui, and he also ordered their clan members not to go against their patriarch.
A similar incident occurred in the White Tiger Clan, and Dai Hubai decided to imprison Dai Baihu and his family, which caused quite a commotion in the clan.
Many of Dai Baihu's supporters put up resistance, but Dai Hubai effortlessly paralyzed them all, and he ordered the others to imprison them as well.

Huli Xianniang, who went to the Golden Fox Clan, was furious because she could not find Huli Haohao there. She decided to excommunicate her from their clan, which sparked a debate with the other members.
Huli Xianniang wasn't concerned about their opinions, and she threatened to punish them severely if they continued to defy her orders, including excommunicating them from their Golden Fox Clan.

Zhu Shanniang encountered a challenging circumstance when the elders of the Vermilion Clan prevented her from entering their clan. She was shocked when they informed her that Zhu Hong had excommunicated her from their clan, and their matriarch ordered them to cripple her cultivation if she forced her way into their clan.

Zhu Shanniang was not completely stupid, and she was aware that she would not be able to fight the elders of the Vermilion Clan by herself. There were quite a lot of them, and some of them had strengths that were almost on par with hers.

In the end, Zhu Shanniang decided to retreat, and she wanted to go to the Golden Fox Clan to meet Huli Xianniang. However, Feng Yichen suddenly appeared and attacked her, and it was too easy for the dark phoenix to knock her unconscious and seal her cultivation with the vast difference in theirs.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Hong Xinxin stood behind the clouds in an invisible state, watching the movements of Long Qiang and the others.

"Wang Wugui and Dai Hubai are really unreasonable; they treat their clan members like that just because they would rather not do anything to you." Hong Xinxin spoke as she narrowed her eyes toward the residences of the two clans.

Zhang Fei gave a light nod. "Their arrogance, pride, and fear of my progress have blinded them, and they can no longer differentiate between good and bad. Since they are so eager to kill me, I will tear down their arrogance and pride."
"Master." Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yichen, who handed the unconscious Zhu Shanniang over to him.
Zhang Fei smiled in satisfaction as he looked at Zhu Shanniang, but he immediately sent her into the pavilion so that one of his clones could do something about her.
"Shall we move now, Master?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Feng Yichen. "We'll wait for them to gather in one place, and we'll deal with them all at once."
In the pavilion, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was squatting beside Zhu Shanniang, with Qing Yi and Zhu Lingyao standing behind him.

Qing Yi felt sorry for Zhu Shanniang, especially since her son had told her about his plans for the female vermilion bird. She would rather not do that, but he asked her not to think about her feelings, especially since she was an enemy.

Zhu Lingyao also felt sorry for her sister, but she felt that Zhu Shanniang was too stupid, and she wanted her sister to suffer because of her stupidity in the hope that she would change for the better in the future.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] forcefully pulled Zhu Shanniang's soul out of her body, and he merged her replicate soul with his. "Release your soul, Mom."
Qing Yi let out a soft sigh and released her soul, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately connected her soul with Zhu Shanniang's, so the female vermilion bird would be bound to her as well.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then used the soulbinding curse on Zhu Shanniang's soul to increase her own soul power. He assisted Qing Yi in forming a force contract with her, ultimately transforming the female vermilion bird into her contract beast.
"I'll do something else, and you can wake her up."
'All right.' After Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, Zhu Lingyao immediately woke up her sister.

Before long, Zhu Shanniang opened her eyes, but her head was dizzy because Feng Yichen hit her so hard. Her expression changed as soon as she saw Zhu Lingyao and Qing Yi, but she felt that her cultivation had been sealed by the dark phoenix, forcing her to stagger to her feet. "You traitor!"

'Everyone warned you, remember?' Zhu Lingyao replied with a shake of her head. 'Unfortunately, you are too stupid, and your unreasonable grudge blinded your heart to the point that you forgot Zhang Fei's strength and abilities. Do you think the person who can provide our seniors with so much extraordinary information is an ordinary cultivator? Do you think the people at the Star and Sun Tower would help him if he was mediocre? Remember, even with his low cultivation, he can fool Xereth. Who are you compared to that powerful demon?'
Zhu Shanniang opened her mouth to refute Zhu Lingyao, but not a single word came out of her; instead, she clenched her fists until her palms turned red.

'For your information, you no longer have your freedom.' Zhu Shanniang stared at her sister with a shocked gaze, thinking that Zhang Fei had enslaved her. Zhu Lingyao embraced Qing Yi's shoulders and continued. 'He didn't enslave you, so you don't need to worry about that. However, he made a forced contract between you and Qing Yi, and you have become her contract beast now.'

"What?" Zhu Shanniang screamed in shock as her body trembled violently, and she staggered backwards. For a mythical beast like her, becoming a contract beast for a human is the most humiliating experience of her life. "Are... are you serious about that? Why... why did Zhang Fei do that to me? Why... why didn't you stop him? I... I am your sister, but you let him do such a cruel thing to me."

'Why should I stop Zhang Fei? Our parents and I have already forbidden you to find trouble with him, but you are an idiot, and you didn't listen to us! Since you are his enemy, it's natural for him to do something to you, right?' Zhu Lingyao turned to Qing Yi. 'Try ordering him to do something.'

Qing Yi seemed hesitant to do that because Zhu Shanniang was a senior, and she was much stronger than her. In the end, she still followed Zhu Lingyao's wishes and ordered the female vermilion bird to do something.

Zhu Shanniang was shocked as her body moved on its own, and she was forced to kneel on one leg against her will, making her feel so humiliated. Moreover, she knew that the contractual relationship between master and beast could not go that far, and she was aware that Zhang Fei had already done something else to her.

Zhu Lingyao shook her head slightly at her sister's expression. 'Have you forgotten that Zhang Fei is Senior Hun Di's disciple? He is an expert soul cultivator, and he has already bound your soul to Qing Yi's soul. This way, you will not be able to betray her or refuse her orders, and your life will also be bound to her for the rest of your life.'
*Thud*

Zhu Shanniang fell on her butt and trembled violently, and her face turned pale at the thought of her fate of being Qing Yi's contract beast for the rest of her life. She looked at her sister with a pleading gaze, and tears fell from her eyes.
However, Zhu Lingyao ignored Zhu Shanniang and walked away directly. 'You can do whatever you want to her, Qing Yi.'
Qing Yi let out a soft sigh before lifting Zhu Shanniang to her feet and taking her to one of the empty rooms, allowing the female vermilion bird to think about her situation.
After Qing Yi left, Zhu Shanniang sat on the bed and hugged her legs tightly, and her sobs could be heard from outside the room, but no one paid any attention to her.
After some time, the mythical beasts had gathered, but they were confused by Zhu Shanniang's absence. "Where is she? Why isn't she here?"

Huli Xianniang immediately checked the Vermilion Clan with her senses, and she found that their clan was covered by a formation; even the elders of the clan were tightly guarding their residence. However, she could not find Zhu Shanniang there, confusing her. "She is not in her clan, and the situation there is very tense."

Dai Hubai, Wang Wugui, and Long Qiang also checked the Vermilion Clan, finding the same situation there. "This is strange. Did something happen to her? Why are those people closely guarding their residence?"

"Zhu Hong has already prohibited Zhu Shanniang from joining us, and she seems to have ordered her clan members to do something against her. However, she was obviously not there, which confused me." As soon as she finished saying that, Huli Xianniang and the others saw Zhang Fei standing in the air a little far away from them, but he just smiled and flew away. "Follow him!"

The four mythical beasts quickly chased after Zhang Fei, but they could never really get close to him. Every time they got close to him, he immediately accelerated his flying speed, which shocked them.
After some time, Zhang Fei landed on the slope of the mountain, which is the entrance area to the five-clawed golden dragon shrine and the seal of the Calamity Demon Dragon.

Soon, the four mythical beasts landed in that area, and they surrounded Zhang Fei instantly. However, Long Qiang frowned after he realized their location. 'How did this kid find this place? Could it be that there really is a traitor in my Dragon Clan?'
Zhang Fei crossed his arms in front of his chest and looked at them one by one. "Are you guys confused about Zhu Shanniang's disappearance?"
"Did you kidnap Zhu Shanniang?" Huli Xianniang asked in an angry tone.

"Asking the obvious, aren't you?" Zhang Fei replied in a casual manner. "I've helped you so much with the matter regarding Xereth, yet you guys want to kill me. Thus, I have to retaliate against your evil intentions, right?"
"Do you think you can defeat the four of us alone?" Dai Hubai released his 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and both his hands and feet became white tiger claws.

Meanwhile, Long Qiang took out a white spear, and Wang Wugui took out two black clubs. Huli Xianniang, in her half-golden fox form, stood a short distance away from them and gave Zhang Fei a menacing look.

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei burst into laughter at their actions. "I've met so many idiots since I became a cultivator, but you guys are far more idiotic than them. All of you already know a lot about me, but your arrogance has clouded your common sense, and you've forgotten everything."
After he said that, Zhang Fei activated the Soul Link and borrowed the power of all the beasts living inside, causing his strength and aura to surpass the four of them.

'How is this possible? His strength has already surpassed us!' Huli Xianniang and the other three were shocked when they sensed the change in Zhang Fei, but he immediately released his killing intent to the maximum, which caused the four of them to tremble violently and feel a chill down their spines.
"Are you guys still feeling arrogant now?" Zhang Fei instantly disappeared from their sight, forcing them to raise their guard.
"Xianniang!"
Huli Xianniang spun around and thrust her right claw behind her, but Zhang Fei casually grabbed it and turned his back on her before lifting her up and slamming her to the ground.
*Bam*

"Arghh!" Huli Xianniang screamed in pain as her back hit a large rock below her, causing pain to radiate throughout her body from her spine. In the next second, her body jerked and convulsed violently, accompanied by a loud moan. "Ahhhh!"
[You gained 350,000 Beast Essence from Huli Xianniang.]
"Xianniang!"
Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai moved towards them. However, three of Zhang Fei's clones appeared before them and punched them right in their faces, bouncing all three back.
"Argh!"
"Gahh!"
"Fuck!"

Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Hubai landed on the ground, staggering backwards before stabilizing themselves. They stared at Zhang Fei's three clones, who were casually standing in the sky with mocking smiles on their faces.

Zhang Fei sealed the cultivation of Huli Xianniang, who had just finished her orgasm. He lifted her and brought her before his three clones, staring at Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Mubai. "You may be stronger than me, but I am not a weak person that you can trample on as you please."
"Save... save me!" Huli Xianniang called out to her three friends.
Zhang Fei gave a slight smirk, groped Huli Xianniang's body, and used his enhanced demon touch on her again. "Do you think they can save you from me, little fox?"
"Ahhh! Stop! Please! Stop it!" Huli Xianniang begged as she moaned in pleasure; even her body writhed in response to the pleasure.
"Damn it!" Long Qiang and the other two immediately summoned their clan members to help them.

In a few minutes, hundreds of people from the Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Clans had surrounded the place. Zhang Fei and his three clones were unfazed by their presence, and he enjoyed touching the body of Huli Xianniang, who was increasingly lost in pleasure.
"Attack—" Long Qiang stopped his words once a gigantic Azure Emperor Roc descended from the sky, and Hong Xinxin's giant body covered the entire area, causing it to turn dark.

Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, Dai Hubai, and the members of their three clans were shocked by the appearance of Hong Xinxin. They then looked back, and Feng Yichen flew towards them in her giant Dark Phoenix form.

'Fuck! Two 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm beasts!' Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Hubai cursed in their hearts. They were even more shocked when hundreds of golden crows, phoenixes, and vermilion birds flew to surround the members of their three clans.

The people of the three clans were already afraid of Hong Xinxin and Feng Yichen, and they were even more afraid of the appearance of those beasts. They looked at Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Hubai, waiting for their orders. However, many of them decided to run away, especially since they had no chance to fight Zhang Fei and the others.

Zhang Fei did not intend to stop them because they had no immediate problems with him, and they were just following the orders of their three leaders. As for those who did not intend to leave, he directly spoke to them. "Since you guys don't want to leave, I give you all two choices: Beat your three leaders or die."
