Zhu Shanniang encountered a challenging circumstance when the elders of the Vermilion Clan prevented her from entering their clan.
She was shocked when they informed her that Zhu Hong had excommunicated her from their clan, and their matriarch ordered them to cripple her cultivation if she forced her way into their clan.
Zhu Shanniang was not completely stupid, and she was aware that she would not be able to fight the elders of the Vermilion Clan by herself.
There were quite a lot of them, and some of them had strengths that were almost on par with hers.
In the end, Zhu Shanniang decided to retreat, and she wanted to go to the Golden Fox Clan to meet Huli Xianniang.
However, Feng Yichen suddenly appeared and attacked her, and it was too easy for the dark phoenix to knock her unconscious and seal her cultivation with the vast difference in theirs.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Hong Xinxin stood behind the clouds in an invisible state, watching the movements of Long Qiang and the others.

"Wang Wugui and Dai Hubai are really unreasonable; they treat their clan members like that just because they would rather not do anything to you." Hong Xinxin spoke as she narrowed her eyes toward the residences of the two clans.
Zhang Fei gave a light nod.
"Their arrogance, pride, and fear of my progress have blinded them, and they can no longer differentiate between good and bad.
Since they are so eager to kill me, I will tear down their arrogance and pride."
"Master." Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yichen, who handed the unconscious Zhu Shanniang over to him.
Zhang Fei smiled in satisfaction as he looked at Zhu Shanniang, but he immediately sent her into the pavilion so that one of his clones could do something about her.
"Shall we move now, Master?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Feng Yichen.
"We'll wait for them to gather in one place, and we'll deal with them all at once."
In the pavilion, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was squatting beside Zhu Shanniang, with Qing Yi and Zhu Lingyao standing behind him.
Qing Yi felt sorry for Zhu Shanniang, especially since her son had told her about his plans for the female vermilion bird.
She would rather not do that, but he asked her not to think about her feelings, especially since she was an enemy.

Zhu Lingyao also felt sorry for her sister, but she felt that Zhu Shanniang was too stupid, and she wanted her sister to suffer because of her stupidity in the hope that she would change for the better in the future.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] forcefully pulled Zhu Shanniang's soul out of her body, and he merged her replicate soul with his.
"Release your soul, Mom."
Qing Yi let out a soft sigh and released her soul, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately connected her soul with Zhu Shanniang's, so the female vermilion bird would be bound to her as well.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then used the soulbinding curse on Zhu Shanniang's soul to increase her own soul power.
He assisted Qing Yi in forming a force contract with her, ultimately transforming the female vermilion bird into her contract beast.
"I'll do something else, and you can wake her up."
'All right.' After Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, Zhu Lingyao immediately woke up her sister.
Before long, Zhu Shanniang opened her eyes, but her head was dizzy because Feng Yichen hit her so hard.
Her expression changed as soon as she saw Zhu Lingyao and Qing Yi, but she felt that her cultivation had been sealed by the dark phoenix, forcing her to stagger to her feet.
"You traitor!"

'Everyone warned you, remember?' Zhu Lingyao replied with a shake of her head. 'Unfortunately, you are too stupid, and your unreasonable grudge blinded your heart to the point that you forgot Zhang Fei's strength and abilities.
Do you think the person who can provide our seniors with so much extraordinary information is an ordinary cultivator?
Do you think the people at the Star and Sun Tower would help him if he was mediocre?
Remember, even with his low cultivation, he can fool Xereth.
Who are you compared to that powerful demon?'
Zhu Shanniang opened her mouth to refute Zhu Lingyao, but not a single word came out of her; instead, she clenched her fists until her palms turned red.
'For your information, you no longer have your freedom.' Zhu Shanniang stared at her sister with a shocked gaze, thinking that Zhang Fei had enslaved her.
Zhu Lingyao embraced Qing Yi's shoulders and continued. 'He didn't enslave you, so you don't need to worry about that.
However, he made a forced contract between you and Qing Yi, and you have become her contract beast now.'
"What?" Zhu Shanniang screamed in shock as her body trembled violently, and she staggered backwards.
For a mythical beast like her, becoming a contract beast for a human is the most humiliating experience of her life.
"Are... are you serious about that?
Why... why did Zhang Fei do that to me?
Why... why didn't you stop him?
I am your sister, but you let him do such a cruel thing to me."
'Why should I stop Zhang Fei?
Our parents and I have already forbidden you to find trouble with him, but you are an idiot, and you didn't listen to us!
Since you are his enemy, it's natural for him to do something to you, right?' Zhu Lingyao turned to Qing Yi. 'Try ordering him to do something.'
Qing Yi seemed hesitant to do that because Zhu Shanniang was a senior, and she was much stronger than her.
In the end, she still followed Zhu Lingyao's wishes and ordered the female vermilion bird to do something.
Zhu Shanniang was shocked as her body moved on its own, and she was forced to kneel on one leg against her will, making her feel so humiliated.
Moreover, she knew that the contractual relationship between master and beast could not go that far, and she was aware that Zhang Fei had already done something else to her.
Zhu Lingyao shook her head slightly at her sister's expression. 'Have you forgotten that Zhang Fei is Senior Hun Di's disciple?
He is an expert soul cultivator, and he has already bound your soul to Qing Yi's soul.
This way, you will not be able to betray her or refuse her orders, and your life will also be bound to her for the rest of your life.'
*Thud*
Zhu Shanniang fell on her butt and trembled violently, and her face turned pale at the thought of her fate of being Qing Yi's contract beast for the rest of her life.
She looked at her sister with a pleading gaze, and tears fell from her eyes.
However, Zhu Lingyao ignored Zhu Shanniang and walked away directly. 'You can do whatever you want to her, Qing Yi.'
Qing Yi let out a soft sigh before lifting Zhu Shanniang to her feet and taking her to one of the empty rooms, allowing the female vermilion bird to think about her situation.
After Qing Yi left, Zhu Shanniang sat on the bed and hugged her legs tightly, and her sobs could be heard from outside the room, but no one paid any attention to her.
After some time, the mythical beasts had gathered, but they were confused by Zhu Shanniang's absence.
"Where is she?
Why isn't she here?"
Huli Xianniang immediately checked the Vermilion Clan with her senses, and she found that their clan was covered by a formation; even the elders of the clan were tightly guarding their residence.
However, she could not find Zhu Shanniang there, confusing her.
"She is not in her clan, and the situation there is very tense."
Dai Hubai, Wang Wugui, and Long Qiang also checked the Vermilion Clan, finding the same situation there.
"This is strange.
Did something happen to her?
Why are those people closely guarding their residence?"
"Zhu Hong has already prohibited Zhu Shanniang from joining us, and she seems to have ordered her clan members to do something against her.

However, she was obviously not there, which confused me." As soon as she finished saying that, Huli Xianniang and the others saw Zhang Fei standing in the air a little far away from them, but he just smiled and flew away.
"Follow him!"
The four mythical beasts quickly chased after Zhang Fei, but they could never really get close to him.
Every time they got close to him, he immediately accelerated his flying speed, which shocked them.
After some time, Zhang Fei landed on the slope of the mountain, which is the entrance area to the five-clawed golden dragon shrine and the seal of the Calamity Demon Dragon.
Soon, the four mythical beasts landed in that area, and they surrounded Zhang Fei instantly.
However, Long Qiang frowned after he realized their location. 'How did this kid find this place?
Could it be that there really is a traitor in my Dragon Clan?'
Zhang Fei crossed his arms in front of his chest and looked at them one by one.
"Are you guys confused about Zhu Shanniang's disappearance?"
"Did you kidnap Zhu Shanniang?" Huli Xianniang asked in an angry tone.
"Asking the obvious, aren't you?" Zhang Fei replied in a casual manner.
"I've helped you so much with the matter regarding Xereth, yet you guys want to kill me.
Thus, I have to retaliate against your evil intentions, right?"
"Do you think you can defeat the four of us alone?" Dai Hubai released his 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and both his hands and feet became white tiger claws.
Meanwhile, Long Qiang took out a white spear, and Wang Wugui took out two black clubs.
Huli Xianniang, in her half-golden fox form, stood a short distance away from them and gave Zhang Fei a menacing look.
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei burst into laughter at their actions.
"I've met so many idiots since I became a cultivator, but you guys are far more idiotic than them.
All of you already know a lot about me, but your arrogance has clouded your common sense, and you've forgotten everything."
After he said that, Zhang Fei activated the Soul Link and borrowed the power of all the beasts living inside, causing his strength and aura to surpass the four of them.
'How is this possible?

His strength has already surpassed us!' Huli Xianniang and the other three were shocked when they sensed the change in Zhang Fei, but he immediately released his killing intent to the maximum, which caused the four of them to tremble violently and feel a chill down their spines.
"Are you guys still feeling arrogant now?" Zhang Fei instantly disappeared from their sight, forcing them to raise their guard.
"Xianniang!"
Huli Xianniang spun around and thrust her right claw behind her, but Zhang Fei casually grabbed it and turned his back on her before lifting her up and slamming her to the ground.
*Bam*
"Arghh!" Huli Xianniang screamed in pain as her back hit a large rock below her, causing pain to radiate throughout her body from her spine.
In the next second, her body jerked and convulsed violently, accompanied by a loud moan.
"Ahhhh!"
[You gained 350,000 Beast Essence from Huli Xianniang.]
"Xianniang!"
Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai moved towards them.
However, three of Zhang Fei's clones appeared before them and punched them right in their faces, bouncing all three back.
"Argh!"
"Gahh!"
"Fuck!"
Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Hubai landed on the ground, staggering backwards before stabilizing themselves.
They stared at Zhang Fei's three clones, who were casually standing in the sky with mocking smiles on their faces.
Zhang Fei sealed the cultivation of Huli Xianniang, who had just finished her orgasm.
He lifted her and brought her before his three clones, staring at Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Mubai.
"You may be stronger than me, but I am not a weak person that you can trample on as you please."
"Save... save me!" Huli Xianniang called out to her three friends.
Zhang Fei gave a slight smirk, groped Huli Xianniang's body, and used his enhanced demon touch on her again.
"Do you think they can save you from me, little fox?"
"Ahhh!
Stop!
Please!
Stop it!" Huli Xianniang begged as she moaned in pleasure; even her body writhed in response to the pleasure.
"Damn it!" Long Qiang and the other two immediately summoned their clan members to help them.
In a few minutes, hundreds of people from the Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Clans had surrounded the place.
Zhang Fei and his three clones were unfazed by their presence, and he enjoyed touching the body of Huli Xianniang, who was increasingly lost in pleasure.
"Attack—" Long Qiang stopped his words once a gigantic Azure Emperor Roc descended from the sky, and Hong Xinxin's giant body covered the entire area, causing it to turn dark.
Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, Dai Hubai, and the members of their three clans were shocked by the appearance of Hong Xinxin.
They then looked back, and Feng Yichen flew towards them in her giant Dark Phoenix form.
'Fuck!
Two 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm beasts!' Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Hubai cursed in their hearts.
They were even more shocked when hundreds of golden crows, phoenixes, and vermilion birds flew to surround the members of their three clans.
The people of the three clans were already afraid of Hong Xinxin and Feng Yichen, and they were even more afraid of the appearance of those beasts.
They looked at Long Qiang, Wang Fugui, and Dai Hubai, waiting for their orders.
However, many of them decided to run away, especially since they had no chance to fight Zhang Fei and the others.
Zhang Fei did not intend to stop them because they had no immediate problems with him, and they were just following the orders of their three leaders.
As for those who did not intend to leave, he directly spoke to them.
"Since you guys don't want to leave, I give you all two choices: Beat your three leaders or die."

chapters.title: Chapter 922: Defeat The Enemies
paragraphs: The members of the three clans froze immediately after Zhang Fei spoke, as they believed it was impossible to act against their leaders. Long Qiang and the other two glared at their people with threatening expressions.
"Yichen."
*Screee*

Feng Yichen released a loud screech before shooting three small black fireballs toward the crowd of people from the three clans, causing them to flee in panic. However, Hong Xinxin immediately restricted their movements, causing the three fireballs to hit their front row before exploding and incinerating some of them.
*Boom... Boom... Boom...*
Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai were shocked by Zhang Fei's cruelty. Moreover, Feng Yichen carried out his orders without hesitation, causing quite a number of their clan members to die.
Even though they were on Zhang Fei's side, the people from the Vermilion Bird, Golden Crow, and Phoenix Clans were also horrified by Feng Yichen's actions just now.
Zhang Fei's evil smile caused the people from the Dragon, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger Clans to tremble so violently that some of them urinated in their pants.
"Release them, Xinxin." After Hong Xinxin withdrew her aura, Zhang Fei spoke to them again. "Last chance! Beat them or die!"
"If you dare follow his orders, you will all die!" Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai shouted threateningly at the members of their three clans.
"Yichen!"

Feng Yichen immediately returned to his human form, but Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai had already made a move first by summoning their ancestors. Despite this, she moved behind them and sealed their cultivation instantly, making their faces turn deathly pale.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei relaxedly looked up at the darkening sky, waiting for the appearance of the ancestors of the Dragon, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger Clans.
Hong Xinxin transformed back into her human form and joined Feng Yichen, and together they brought the three patriarchs of their respective clans to Zhang Fei and his clones.
After a few minutes, a gigantic white dragon with two large wings descended from the sky, which was Long Jiuxiao.

A giant whirlpool emerged from the lower land, and it quickly moved towards the mountain slope, which immediately turned into a gigantic black tortoise with a gigantic green snake behind it. It was the ancestor of the Black Tortoise Clan, Wu Yitao.
Soon, a metal pole shot towards the mountain slope, with a gigantic white tiger wearing golden armor on top of it, which was none other than Dai Yishu.

"I've been waiting for you three." Zhang Fei stretched out both hands forward. The Hellflame Frost Lotus appeared on his left palm, and the Annihilation Flame appeared on his right palm. "Since you guys want to kill me, you have to bear the consequences."
After saying this, Zhang Fei threw the Hellflame Frost Lotus towards Long Jiuxiao and the Annihilation Flame towards the other two ancestors.
"You overestimate yourself, brat!" Long Jiuxiao's avatar shot his dragon flame toward the Hellflame Frost Lotus.
Wu Yitao's avatar shot a waterball at the Annihilation Flame, and Dai Yishu's avatar launched several metal poles at it.
"Master."
"No need." Zhang Fei rejected Feng Yichen directly. However, his third clone created another Annihilation Flame, and he threw it toward Dai Jinhu's avatar.

Long Jiuxiao's avatar panicked as his dragon flame froze and shattered, forcing him to flee while shooting several more dragon flames toward it. 'What the hell is this ability? How can it freeze my dragon flame?'

Wu Yitao's avatar panicked because his waterball evaporated before it collided with Zhang Fei's Annihilation Flame. No matter how many times he attacked the flame with waterballs, his attacks continued to evaporate.

Dai Yishu's avatar was shocked because his metal poles were melted by Zhang Fei's Annihilation Flame, but he immediately realized that he had the Golden Crow Flame, and he infused it into his flame. "Run, Yitao! That brat has the Golden Crow Flame!"

"Do you guys think you can escape from me?" Zhang Fei moved above Wu Yitao's avatar and beheaded the snake, causing the black turtle to suffer immense pain. He then summoned the demon extermination sword, channeled his lightning element and elemental law into it, and stabbed it into the turtle neck. "Lightning Judgment!"
"Arghhh!" Zhang Fei's actions genuinely tormented Wu Yitao's avatar. After he cut off his tail and stabbed his neck, he still electrocuted him with his lightning.
Zhang Fei immediately pulled his sword out and jumped away from Wu Yitao's avatar, especially since one of the Annihilation Flames was so close to him.
"Fuck!" Wu Yitao's avatar cursed as the flame hit him before exploding.
*Boom*
In that instant, Wu Yitao's avatar disappeared from that realm, and Zhang Fei looked at Dai Yishu's avatar, who was being beaten by Zhang Xiaolong [3], causing his avatar to fade.
Just like Wu Yitao's avatar, another Annihilation Flame slammed into Dai Yishu's avatar before exploding, and the white tiger instantly disappeared.
Boom
Zhang Fei observed Feltia [2] and Zhang Fei [4] attacking Long Jiuxiao's avatar, which forced him to fly backward toward the Hellflame Frost Lotus that was steadily approaching the dragon.
"Shit!" Zhang Fei's Hellflame Frost Lotus struck Long Jiuxiao's avatar, freezing it before the lotus exploded. "Gahhh!"
Long Jiuxiao's avatar instantly disappeared from everyone's sight, terrifying Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, Dai Hubai, and the people from their clans.

"Heh! This way, those three old idiots will suffer heavy injuries, and they won't dare to come looking for trouble with me, at least not in the near future." Zhang Fei then sent his three clones back and moved in front of the three patriarchs, whose faces had gone deathly pale. "Honestly, I wanted to kill the three of you, but I still need sacrifices to deal with Xereth. Therefore, I will let you guys live for now, and you will receive your punishment after the demon dies."

Zhang Fei pulled the souls of the three out of their bodies, replicated them, and merged them with his. Thereafter, he implanted his demon slave mark into their souls to prevent them from bringing him other problems.

"Release their cultivation." Feng Yichen immediately unsealed their cultivation, and Zhang Fei spoke to them again. "All of you are my slaves now, so behave yourselves accordingly, or you will face consequences far more severe than this. Besides, let Senior Xishui and Senior Yongheng handle your three clans' affairs here; they will now be my subordinates."
After saying that, Zhang Fei brought Huli Xianniang, Hong Xinxin, and Feng Yichen back to the pavilion.

In contrast to the gloomy appearance of Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai, the members of their three clans exhaled with relief, particularly because they were spared the fate of many of their previous comrades.

Meanwhile, the people from the Vermilion Bird, Golden Crow, and Phoenix Clans cheered with joy. However, Feng Xishui and the other leaders immediately ordered them to return, and they ordered them to spread the news about the three clans' defeat to Zhang Fei.

The people of the Dragon, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger clans did not wait for their patriarchs' decisions; instead, they hurriedly returned to their respective clans, with many considering leaving the Sky Dragon Realm. However, they threw that intention out of their minds, especially since they were afraid that Zhang Fei would hunt them down if they ran away.

Without saying anything, Long Qiang took out their flying artifacts; he and the other two left the Dragon Sky Realm, especially after they conveyed some instructions to the members of their three clans according to Zhang Fei's orders just now.
In their secluded location, Long Jiuxiao, Wang Yitao, and Dai Yishu were lying on the floor in a terrible state, with blood from their injuries soaking the ground.

Among the three, Wang Yitao suffered the most serious injury, which made him almost lose consciousness. The ancestor of the golden fox, Huli Jinhu, immediately helped him recover from his injuries. "How did all three of you sustain such severe injuries?"
Long Jiuxiao wiped the blood on his mouth, swallowed a few pills, and sat on the floor. "That brat's strength far surpasses our previous estimation, and his speed also surpasses ours."

"I don't know how he managed to do it, but that brat's cultivation has surpassed 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm." Dai Yishu struggled to sit up before swallowing some pills. "I sensed several types of flames from his technique, and one of them was the golden crow flame. Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to melt my metal, and his other flames should be phoenix, vermilion, and dragon flames."
"Are you sure that brat has the dragon flame?"

Long Jiuxiao spoke straightaway. "Yishu told you the truth, and that brat's dragon flame convinced me that there was a traitor within my dragon clan. Whoever the traitor was, that person had already given his or her flame dragon bloodline to that brat, or he wouldn't have been able to use the dragon flame. I wanted to order my clan members in the Sky Dragon Realm to investigate, but I thought it was impossible, especially since that brat must have done something to them."
"That's true." Huli Jinhu nodded in agreement. "I will order my clan members in that realm to investigate this matter."
"All right." Long Jiuxiao then released a heavy sigh. "That brat's technique made my injury really heavy, and I can't possibly recover in a short time."
"Me too." Dai Yishu then looked at Wang Yitao. "His injury was worse than ours, and he was lucky not to die."
Huli Jinhu nodded at him. "You two can focus on your injuries, and I will help Wang Yitao recover from his injury."
"Yeah."
In the pavilion, Huli Xianniang was embarrassed after seeing so many naked women there, and Feng Yichen also tore off her dress, leaving her naked like them. 'Damn it! My fate is truly unlucky!'

"Haha." Huli Haohao chuckled as she looked at Huli Xianniang. "I told you not to overestimate yourself, but you were too arrogant, and you actually insulted me as a coward. You are just like the other women here, and your clan matriarch status won't help you now."
"Shut up!" Huli Xianniang shouted at Huli Haohao in frustration. "I will kill you later, traitor!"

"No... No..." Huli Haohao waved her index finger in front of Huli Xianniang's face. "How can you call me a traitor if our race has not yet decided to be friends or enemies with Zhang Fei? I have always been on the side of Ancestor Zhishen, and he has never agreed with your actions today. Instead, you and Ancestor Jinhu used your status to decide unilaterally, so you two are the traitors, especially since your decision has brought significant risk to our clan."
"You—" Huli Xianniang immediately stopped and glared at Zhang Fei, who walked out of one of the rooms together with Hu Lili and Hu Yue. "Two moon foxes?"
"Can you feel anything familiar from any of them?"
Huli Xianniang frowned as she observed both moon foxes, and she immediately realized that Hu Yue had a faint golden fox bloodline. "Tch! What a disgusting mixed breed!"
"You made a mistake by saying that."

After Huli Haohao said that, several tree roots shot out from the ground, binding Huli Xianniang's legs and arms. The tree roots on both of her hands immediately moved upwards, lifting her slightly high off the ground.

"You— Mmm—" Three tree roots shot out, and one of them gagged Huli Xianniang's mouth. The other two wrapped around her massive breasts and squeezed them, causing her face to turn red with anger and humiliation. 'This bastard! I will kill him one day!'
"You have already made a mistake by becoming my enemy, and you have made a second mistake by insulting my wife like that." Zhang Fei turned to Hu Yue, who immediately released her soul.
Zhang Fei then pulled Huli Xianniang's soul out of her body, replicated it, and merged the original with Hu Yue's soul. He merged her soul replica with his, making his soul power increase again.

After Zhang Fei returned her soul to her body and removed the tree root from her mouth, Huli Xianniang looked at him with fury and horror at the same time. However, she was even more horrified when she pulled her toward Hu Yue, who immediately pressed their foreheads together. "No! Don't do this! Please don't do this to me!"
"Too late." Zhang Fei immediately made a forced contract between the two women, forcing Huli Xianniang to become Hu Yue's beast contract.
"No!" Huli Xianniang screamed hysterically after the contract between them was completed.
Zhang Fei grabbed Huli Xianniang's cheeks and stared into her watery eyes. "How do you feel about becoming a beast contracted to a mixed breed?"
"You bastard! I will kill you!" Huli Xianniang tried to punch and kick Zhang Fei, but the tree roots restrained both her hands and feet tightly.
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed evilly as he released Huli Xianniang. He then took out the science capsule. "Yue'er."
"Yes." Hu Yue then ordered Huli Xianniang. "Give me ten drops of your origin bloodline and some of your body parts."
Huli Xianniang wanted to reject her, but her body moved on its own, following Hu Yue's order. "No! What have you done to me?"

"Your soul has merged with Yue'er's soul, so the two of you are one now, and you will obey her for the rest of your life." Huli Xianniang's face turned pale after Zhang Fei said that, especially since it was no different from her being Hu Yue's slave.
After Huli Xianniang handed over her origin bloodline and some of her body parts, Hu Yue immediately lay down into the capsule, and Zhang Fei hurriedly put them into each tube to start the process.

Huli Xianniang sat limp on the ground with a pale face, and her tears flowed freely from the corners of her eyes, lamenting her fate. After all, she was a mythical beast and the matriarch of her golden fox race, but she was already Hu Yue's contract beast, and she also couldn't refute her orders.
Huli Haohao smiled faintly. 'What a fool! If she didn't look for trouble with Zhang Fei, she would never have experienced an incident like this, and she could live freely like before.'
"What will happen to Yue'er? Will she still be a moon fox or a new fox race?" Hu Lili asked, looking at her sleeping daughter.

Zhang Fei rubbed his chin. "Since Yue'er already has the golden fox bloodline in her body, I suspect she will become a new fox race, which is a combination of the moon fox and the golden fox races. Not only that, I believe her rank will rise to become a mythical beast, and she will become truly strong in the future."

"Yeah." Hu Lili nodded slightly, and a relieved smile spread across her face. "Back then, the two of you didn't know each other, and the two of you met by chance in the Heavenly Sword City. She has changed a lot because of you, and she has been thinking about you and waiting for you to pick her up. Although she had to wait for so long, you finally fulfilled your promise to pick her up, and you have continued to help her since then. She has become quite strong now, and her cultivation has surpassed mine. After this, she will become much stronger, and I will never be able to catch up to her."

"Why are you so pessimistic?" Zhang Fei pulled Hu Lili into his arms and kissed her. "After you become my wife, I will help you like I helped Yue'er, and I will look for another mythical beast bloodline for you, which can help you become a mythical beast like her."
Hu Lili shook her head. "I would rather not become another beast, and I want to remain a moon fox forever, not the divine one but the mythical one."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Don't worry, I will help you evolve into a mythical beast, and you will be the first moon fox to achieve it."
"I believe in you."

Naturally, he brought Huli Zhishen to join them, especially since her beast essence would be useful to help him evolve to the eight tails.
In the Demon Purgatory Realm, Zhang Fei [1] looked at all his partners, who had already transformed into their demon forms.
He rubbed his chin while reading Gu Yan's status. 'She turns into an infernal demon, and all her abilities are related to the fire element, or specifically lava.
Her best ability is her Undying Infernal Flame, which is similar to the Phoenix Nirvana.
As long as her soul still exists, she will come back to life after coming into contact with lava, even if her body has been completely destroyed.'
"Yan'er."
"Hmm?" Gu Yan immediately approached Zhang Fei [1].
"What is it?"
Zhang Fei [1] reached out her hand and tried to imitate her Undying Infernal Flame, but she failed to do so, causing her to sigh in disappointment.
"I wanted to mimic your ability, but I couldn't do it, and it seemed only you could use it."
"Which one?"
"Your Undying Infernal Flame."
"Oh." Gu Yan nodded in understanding.
"That ability is indeed extraordinary, and I am truly fortunate to have obtained it after becoming an infernal demon."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her.
"Even though your Undying Infernal Flame is extraordinary, you still have to be careful and don't get too excited about it, especially since you will still die if your soul is destroyed."
"Got it." Gu Yan immediately shifted to the side.

Zhang Fei [1] then asked Shi Yue, the former elder of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, to stand in front of him. 'I didn't expect that she would become a demon beast, an abyssal draconid serpent, to be precise.
All her abilities are based on water, shadow, and illusion.'
"Do you want to mimic one of my abilities, Fei?" Shi Yue asked.
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head.
"Your abilities are good, but I already have several similar abilities, so I won't imitate them."
"I see." Shi Yue nodded in understanding and moved to the side with Gu Yan.
Zhang Fei [1] then called Dan Qingying, who immediately came to him.
"Are you interested in any of my abilities, Fei?"

"Let me read them first." Dan Qingying nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. 'She transformed into a snow demon, and her best ability is the Absolute Zero Domain, which lowers the temperature in a large area to near absolute zero, causing the surroundings to freeze and draining the strength of all living beings except herself.
If I think about it, her ability is similar to my big sister's ice phoenix domain, but Yue'er's ability is much colder than hers.'
[Master, you have the ice element, so I think Dan Qingying's Absolute Zero Domain will suit you.]
Zhang Fei [1] gave a light nod and mimicked Dan Qingying's Absolute Zero Domain directly.
[You succeeded in mimicking the Absolute Zero Domain of a snow demon named Dan Qingying.]
"Hmm?" Dan Qingying raised an eyebrow when the temperature in the room dropped rapidly.
"Did you imitate my Absolute Zero Domain?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] immediately withdrew his new ability.
"As you know, I have the ice element, and your Absolute Zero Domain suits me best."
"Well, that's true."
After Dan Qingying joined Gu Yan and Shi Yue, Huan Ya walked to Zhang Fei [1], who looked at her seriously. 'A fallen demon?
What kind of race is this?
Moreover, her abilities combine traits from several types of demons, including blood demons, devourer demons, and others.
Even so, her abilities are well-suited for her role as an assassin, and she still retains her domain.'
"Are you interested in one of my demon abilities, Master?"
Huan Ya's question woke Zhang Fei [1] from his thoughts.
"Your abilities suit you best, but it seems like only you can use them, so I won't mimic them."
"Oh." Huan Ya then walked to the side.
"In that case, you can check out my other sisters' abilities, and who knows, their abilities might suit you."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded and called out to Yue Qingya, reading her abilities one by one.
However, she smiled mischievously and used one of her tentacles to tease his dick.
He grabbed it and bit it, causing her to scream.
"Ahh!
Don't bite my tentacle, perverted fox!"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed at that.
"I didn't expect that you would also become a demon beast, the abyssal kraken to be precise.
Unfortunately, none of your abilities are suitable for me, even though I have the water element."
Yue Qingya wore a disappointed look and pouted her lips.
"Honestly, I hoped to turn into a powerful demon, but instead, I turned into such an ugly demon beast."
"Who dares to say you are an ugly demon beast?" Zhang Fei [1] pulled Yue Qingya into his lap.
"Other people might think you're ugly, but you're unique in my eyes, and I like your demon form so much."
Yue Qingya wrapped her arms around his neck.
"Is that true?
Do you really like my demon form?"
"I liked it so much." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a firm nod.
"Moreover, the abyssal kraken demon beast is powerful, especially in the water.
Once your demon rank and demon beast rank increase, I'm sure no demon will be able to defeat you in the water."
"Wouldn't Zhang Lin and Serpentera be much stronger than me?" Yue Qingya asked in a disappointed tone.
Zhang Fei [1] sighed softly and rubbed her cheek.
"You don't have to compare yourself to them, okay?
Serpentera is an ancient beast that has lived for over a million years, and Lin'er is his successor, so it's natural that they are stronger than you.
Moreover, the abyssal kraken demon beast is also not an ordinary demon beast, so I believe you can reach their level in the future, and I will always help you with that."
"Uhm." Yue Qingya immediately got off Zhang Fei [1]'s lap and joined the others.
Zhang Fei [1] looked at Ning Xiang, who was walking towards him.
Her butterfly wings and the massive insect-like tail indicated that she was not a normal demon. 'Another demon beast, the nightmare moth demon beast.
Moreover, her abilities are related to dreams, making her like a dream demon.'
"Are you interested in my abilities, Fei?" Ning Xiang softly asked.
Zhang Fei [1] grabbed Ning Xiang and gave her a brief kiss.
"Your abilities are related to dreams, and I already have the dream manipulation ability, which is similar to yours.
Therefore, I will not mimic your abilities, and I will help you to increase your demon rank and demon beast rank after this."
"All right." Ning Xiang replied with a smile before going to the side.
"Fei!" Du Yuan called out softly, climbed onto Zhang Fei [1]'s lap, wrapped her arms around his neck, and gave him a deep kiss.
"I think most of my abilities are similar to your demon abilities, and you won't be able to use some of the others, especially since they are related to my midnight throne."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with her.
"You're right about that; some of your demon abilities are indeed exclusive to you.
However, your siphon touch is fascinating, especially since it can not only siphon other people's life force but also their memories and emotions.
Using it on foes makes them lose all memories and become emotionless dolls."
"That's true." Du Yuan then asked.
"Do you want to mimic my siphon touch?"
"Yes."
[You succeeded in mimicking the Siphon Touch of a midnight demon named Du Yuan.]
"It's done."
"Hehe." Du Yuan giggled, kissed Zhang Fei [1], and ran to the others.
"Come here, Qianqian." Xia Qianqian jumped towards Zhang Fei [1] and sat on his lap.
"You seem to like your demon form, huh?"
Xia Qianqian nodded her head repeatedly.
"Even though my demon form is a bit against my character, I still like it, Brother Fei.
Unfortunately, I can no longer go out during the day, and I can only go out at night because I am a nocturnal demon.
If I go out during the day, my strength will decrease drastically, and I will be vulnerable to enemy attacks."
"That's true." Zhang Fei [1] replied as he cared for his body.
"I think that's fine, and you don't need to fight during the day.
Instead, you can help me do something to my enemies at night, especially with your oblivion mark and dreamstalker abilities."
"Haha." Xia Qianqian softly laughed.
"My dreamstalker ability depends on my mental and soul strength, and both are still weak now.
Therefore, I must continue to improve both, and naturally you must help me."
Zhang Fei [1] smiled at that.
"You are my woman, so you don't need to ask me for that.
Once your mental and soul strength reaches a high level, you can use your dreamstalker ability to kill our enemies through their dreams."
"Do you want to mimic my ability?"
Zhang Fei [1] refused with a shake of his head.
"Most of your abilities are also similar to some of mine, so there's no point in me mimicking them."
"All right, then."
After that, Xi Zihua walked towards Zhang Fei [1], but every time he walked, the floor beneath him froze.
'A crysalith ice demon, huh?' Zhang Fei [1] immediately pulled Xi Zihua and kissed her, but her cold instantly spread through his body.
Fortunately, he possessed the ice element and had engaged in dual cultivation with Zhang Yue, who was the coldest woman by his side, on numerous occasions.
"Your cold suits you the best, Zihua."
Xi Zihua smiled at that.
"Some of my demon abilities are similar to Dan Qingying's, but I have some abilities that are superior to hers.
Unfortunately, most of my abilities are only useful in the ice area, so I can't show them to you now."
"Try using your glacier armor."
Xi Zihua nodded and used it immediately, and his naked body was immediately covered by a light blue dress made of ice, enchanted with layered ice demonic sigils.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately touched her body.
"Pretty!
You are lovely, like an ice queen."
"Hehe." Xi Zihua giggled and explained.
"This armor looks soft like an ordinary dress, but I can harden it and turn it into a weapon at will, and it will continue to repair itself as long as my ice qi doesn't run out."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding.
"This armor suits you best, and you can protect yourself better by wearing it.
However, I prefer to see you naked."
"Pervert!" Xi Zihua exclaimed softly and removed her dress.
"Are you satisfied now?"
"Satisfied!
I'm satisfied!" Zhang Fei [1] nodded repeatedly.
"I'll fuck you after this."
"Humph." Xi Zihua snorted softly before joining the others.
"Do you like my demon form, Fei?" Yan Luan'er asked as she approached Zhang Fei [1].
Zhang Fei [1] had to look up to see her, especially since her demon form was quite big.
"You are the second spider demon by my side after Zilvora, Luan'er.
However, your demon form is bigger than hers, even though she is a spider queen."
"Hey!
I'm also a spider queen, okay?" Yan Luan'er immediately protested.
"However, I'm not completely a spider like Zilvora, and my demon race is the Abyssal Widow Queen.
As for my abilities, you are definitely not interested in them, especially since you are a close combat fighter, and all my abilities are support and long-range type."
"You're right." Zhang Fei [1] then summoned Cheng Yu, who transformed into a Blood Moon Demon.
Most of her abilities are related to the blood element, which is the opposite of her original element.
"Master, you don't have the blood element, so I think my abilities won't be useful for you." Cheng Yu said regretfully.
Zhang Fei [1] grabbed her cheek and rubbed it.
"You don't have to be like this, okay?
Although I can't mimic your abilities, it's not a problem for me.
However, you must control your thirst for blood, or you will go berserk, which will be detrimental to yourself."
"I understand, master."
After that, Gu Hanshuang approached Zhang Fei [1], who was groping her wings.
"Even though you have become a crimson demon with demon horns and crimson wings, your form is the most normal among them."
"I'm actually annoyed by this." Zhang Fei [1] smiled in amusement in response to Gu Hanshuang.
"All my sisters have demon forms, but I don't have one, and I don't have a demon aura either."
Zhang Fei [1] then rubbed her horns.
"Isn't this good?
You don't have to worry about people finding out about your identity as a demon, and you can live a more normal life than them."
"No!" Gu Hanshuang exclaimed.
"Fei, you have to find a strong demon beast for me, and I will transform into that demon beast."
"Sure." Zhang Fei [1] immediately agreed.
"However, finding powerful demon beasts is not easy, so you have to be patient, okay?"
"Yeah."
Zhang Fei [1] then approached the last woman, Tang Ruo.
He already had several female beasts and demon beasts by his side, but she was the first Lamia.
"Such a pretty snake!
If Boitata is a dragon-serpent, you are a Lamia, half human-half snake."
"I'm glad you like my demon form, Master." Zhang Fei [1] was amused by Tang Rou's snake tongue.
"Unfortunately, my abilities are also useless to you, Master."
"It's okay, you don't have to think about that." Zhang Fei [1] then looked at Tang Ruo's lower snake body while rubbing his chin.
"What are you looking for, Master?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] observed her body seriously.
"I wonder how you would have sex with me in this form."
"Pfft!
Hahaha." Tang Ruo laughed out loud.
"Are you serious about having sex with me in this form, Master?"
"I'm just curious about that." Zhang Fei [1] then spoke to the others.
"Return to your human form, and I will take you all to the pavilion to focus on your cultivation."
In the outside world, Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie finally managed to find Mo Zhuo after searching for him for so long, but Xereth had long informed him that the two had fallen into enemy hands.
Therefore, he immediately fled upon seeing them, but the two quickly chased after him.
As he evaded the pursuit of Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie, Mo Zhuo informed his leader about them, and Xereth ordered him to lure them to his nearby statue.
Since they were both former Xereth's subordinates, Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie were naturally aware of Mo Zhuo's intentions.
They immediately used their maximum strength and surrounded him before he could escape, and a fight immediately broke out between them.
Two against one, Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie managed to injure Mo Zhuo and capture him.
One of them directly contacted Zhang Fei through his fifth clone, and he ordered them to bring the demon to him in the Raging Thunder Realm.
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 930 930: Six Month (A Year)
paragraphs: *Boom*
A huge explosion occurred on a rail, and Xereth stood up with a furious look after Mo Zhuo told him that he failed to escape from Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie.

"Fuck! This situation is entirely due to that little bastard! I have to find him and kill him soon." After he thought about it, Xereth deactivated his artifact, and he left the realm to look for new subordinates first. "After I successfully get new subordinates, I will hunt down that little bastard even though my injury is only 50% recovered."
In his seclusion, Huli Jinhu wore a furious look, especially after one of his followers told him that his wife decided to leave with Zhang Fei.
Moreover, Huli Zhishen's loyal followers also decided to side with Zhang Fei, which made Huli Jinhu even more furious.

"Is there something wrong?" Huli Jinhu immediately explained to Long Jiuxiao and the other two about the situation in his golden fox race, causing all of them to frown. "I think you should hold back for now, especially since you won't be able to fight that little bastard by yourself. If you force yourself to fight him, you will definitely lose miserably, and you will also fall into his hands like Long Qiang and the others."
"I agree with him, Jinhu." Wang Yitao also spoke. "You should wait for our injuries to recover, and we will help you fight that little bastard."
*Crack... Crack...*
Dai Yishu clenched both fists until his bones made a sound. "At that time, I will tear his body into pieces."
"You guys are right." Huli Jinhu contacted several of his loyal followers and asked them to do something about Huli Zhishen's loyal followers. "Let's continue."
"Yeah."

In the Ragging Thunder Realm, Zhang Fei [5] decided to temporarily stop his training. He rushed to Earth to restock all Earth items, and he then distributed them to all his shops in the various realms, except the Xianjin Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] then went to the residence of the Meng Clan in the Xian Kingdom, and he was quite satisfied with their development, especially the development of Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu. Since he brought them to the realm a little over a year ago, the two women have improved quite significantly because he has been continuously supplying them with his Yang Qi.
"Your cultivation has reached the 3-Star Sovereign Realm." Meng Qi muttered in surprise.
Meng Guanqiu asked him. "Why did you suddenly come here? I thought you were busy in the upper realms."

"My affairs in the upper realms have reduced a lot now. By the way, it's time for your clan members to train for the next stage, so I'll take them to a special place, and they will focus on their physical training for the next few months." Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu were surprised by Zhang Fei [5]'s sudden decision. "Once they complete their training, not many cultivators in the middle realms will be able to harm them. At that time, I will send them to various realms that are not familiar with the Demon Fox Group, and they will establish relationships with people in those realms."
"Are you sure it's okay for them to go to those realms?" Meng Qi asked.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "You two haven't seen my training place, so you guys might still be hesitant now. However, you won't be hesitant anymore after you train there, and I dare to guarantee that they will be fine if they go to those realms."
"I see." Meng Qi nodded her head lightly. "Since your progress is so frightening, there is no reason for me to doubt you. Guanqiu, tell them to prepare."
"Yes, Big Sis."
Zhang Fei [5] then handed many bottles of Yang Qi to Meng Qi. "Your stock should be almost gone, right?"
"A year ago, you gave me two years' worth of supplies. However, I also distributed them to my clansmen, so my supplies were dwindling rapidly." Meng Qi accepted and stored them.

"That's not a problem since I can produce as much Yang Qi as I want." Meng Qi felt awkward talking about such a thing with Zhang Fei [5]. "Moreover, they are part of my Demon Fox Group, so I am happy if they become stronger."
Meng Qi smiled faintly. "Are you going to take us to the upper realms after we finish our training?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] looked into the distance. "The Sky Dragon Realm is at the border of the middle and upper realms, and the majority of the people in that realm are my allies. Therefore, I will bring all of them there later, and they will develop faster."
"What about me and Guanqiu?"

"You two will continue to train in my private place." Meng Qi looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion. "Although your clansmen are my subordinates now, they are not qualified to enter that place, and you will know the reason after this."
Meng Qi was curious about it. "All right, I will follow your plan."
After the people from the Meng Clan were ready, Zhang Fei [5] sent them all there, and he asked one of his women to bring Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu to the pavilion, which shocked them.

Back then, Feng Jiu asked Zhang Fei [5] to keep Meng Qi by his side because there was something special about her, but the phoenix empress did not say it clearly. Moreover, his system also couldn't find out what was special about her, and her physique was still too weak at that time, so he kept delaying taking her with him.
Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu did not live there immediately, and Zhang Fei [5] asked him to focus on the training ground until they could adapt to level four gravity.

Zhang Fei [5] then met Nanfeng Yunxi and Luo Xuejia on the small island, especially since he had moved all his shops and restaurants there several months ago. He sent both women to the training space to join the Meng Clan, especially since he would take them to the Paradise Realm in the future.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Huangfu Kingdom to meet Li Tiannan and Gu Jinling, whom he had tasked to create the Gu Heart since eleven months ago. Unfortunately, the two of them still had not succeeded in creating it, and they still needed several months to create it.

Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet Long Huang and Long Baiyun in the Beast Kingdom, and he offered them to go to the Sky Dragon Realm, which they agreed to. However, they couldn't just leave right away, and he needed time to prepare their replacements.

Since Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling had been living in the Phoenix Realm since several months ago, and Xian Jinglan was also in closed-door seclusion, Zhang Fei [5] did not go to the Natural Race Kingdom.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] only sent one person from the Demon Kingdom to his training space, which was Ximen Yueliang. As for her parents and the other demons, he doesn't really care about them, and he leaves them behind.

Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Sky Dragon Realm to meet Feng Xishui, and he handed many items, both earth items and alchemy items, to him to sell in his new shop in the realm. As for his restaurant, he didn't have another chef yet, and he decided to send a woman from the Phoenix Clan to learn cooking from Zhang Chen and Zhu Yan.

"I've already selected several women from the Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Clans." Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows at Feng Xishui. "I know those three clans are still hostile towards you, but I'm sure those young women don't have the same intentions as their leaders. If you have any doubts about them, I will summon them here, and you can check them out for yourself."
"Please summon them, Senior Xishui."
"All right."

A few minutes later, three female dragons, two female black turtles, and two female white tigers arrived at the Blazing Phoenix Sect. Zhang Fei [5] used his demon eyes to check their souls, and he found nothing negative about them. In the end, he sent them to his beast space, especially since their quality and cultivation were indeed the best among the younger generation of their three clans.

Zhang Fei [5] then contacted Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai. He forbade them to return to the Xianjin Realm, especially since he was sure that their three ancestors would kill them. Instead, he asked them to visit all the realms in the upper realms to open his shops in all those realms so he could obtain abundant cultivation resources in preparation for him and his family to go to the Paradise Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Phoenix Realm, and he convinced Feng Xueying to train in his training space. The ice phoenix was hesitant about it at first, but she ultimately accepted his offer. He secretly went to the Xianjin Realm, and he managed to convince Lin Jingxia to join Hun Di and the others. Apart from her, he also sent people from the Hong, Yan, and Wang clans there, mainly because they were Hong Xinxin's and Wang Yourou's families.

Then, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Gong Ren and bought quite a lot of teleportation devices from him. He then entered the beast space, and he asked Feng Shanxi to concoct the true foundation pill as well, which would help him reach his seclusion target, the Quasi Divine Realm, or even the Seven Divine Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] then returned to the Raging Thunder Realm, where he used the remaining five true foundation pills to break through from the 3-Star Sovereign Realm to the 8-Star Sovereign Realm.
A month passed, and Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie finally arrived at the Raging Thunder Realm, and they handed Mo Zhuo over to Zhang Fei [5].

At first, Zhang Fei [5] wanted to kill Mo Zhuo like Xereth's other subordinates, but he changed his mind and enslaved him. He used his body modification ability to alter their physical appearance and turned them into humans. He then ordered them to roam all the realms in the upper realms to spread his Demon Fox Group and open shops.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] continued his training in the Thunderfall Gorge to reach the peak stage lightning element and the perfection stage lightning elemental law.
Another two months passed; Zhang Fei's lightning element and lightning elemental law had reached the final stage, and his fifth clone immediately left the Raging Thunder Realm.

In the past three months, Zhang Fei's first clone repeatedly checked the situation in the Demon Purgatory Realm, and the demons dying in the realm were increasing every day as the intensity of the blood moon phenomenon increased. Unfortunately, the Blood Flame still had not appeared, disappointing him.

Zhang Fei [5] went to the beast space to meet all the beasts living there, just like what he had been doing for the past few months. He was elated when Feng Shanxi told him that she had concocted three superior-grade true foundation pills, which was due to the time flow inside being two times faster than the outside world.

Although Feng Shanxi only managed to refine three pills, Zhang Fei [5] was satisfied with it, especially since his cultivation had long been stable at the 8-Star Sovereign Realm. This way, he could use all three pills immediately, and his cultivation would be able to break through to the Saint Realm directly.

Afterwards, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Yin-Yang Space, and he absorbed the Qi in the tub. Once his cultivation broke through, he went straight to the Starry Sky Realm, where no one would bother him there.

After his cultivation broke through to the 2-Star Saint Realm, Zhang Fei [5] entered the pavilion and focused on his body cultivation to reach the fifth stage, the Bone Forging Stage. Moreover, Huoyun Zhiyan and the other two would finish refining the second batch of the true foundation pill in the next three months, so he had plenty of time to take care of other things.
As for Zhang Fei [5]'s beast and demon forms, both were still quite far from reaching the next stage, but he and his clones were still trying hard to improve them as soon as possible.

Since his cultivation had reached the 2-Saint Realm, Zhang Fei and his four clones decided to use the harem sharing to help their respective women, which allowed their cultivation to increase tremendously.
After traveling around the demon realms for the past three months, Xereth finally gained three new subordinates, but they were not as powerful as his former subordinates.

Unlike his former subordinates, Xereth did not let them have their own consciousness, and he enslaved them before sending one of them to Earth. He sent the other two to the Netherworld Realm and also to search for the whereabouts of the Heavenly Fox Races.

Xereth realized that his efforts might be in vain, but he sent them there anyway. After that, he went to other demon realms to find some more new subordinates, especially since time was ticking and his deadline was decreasing.

Since Zhang Fei brought Huli Zhishen with him, six months had passed in the outside world and a year in the pavilion. His cultivation had not yet moved from the 2-Star Saint Realm because the Qi he needed was constantly increasing, but he was also not far from breaking through to the third stage. Meanwhile, his body cultivation had reached the Bone Forging Stage, which increased his physical strength by another 20%. Additionally, his skeleton becomes stronger and more resilient to physical attacks.

During his seclusion, Zhang Fei's Scarlet Furnace Body Method also successfully reached the Infernal Body Stage, which was thanks to the female fire mythical beasts. This way, his body strength was strengthened by another 40% and his fire element by another 80%.

As for his soul cultivation, Zhang Fei's soul level is still at the perfection stage of the heavenly soul level, but Hun Di told him that he will probably break through to the ancestral soul level in the next few months.

Zhang Fei's beast form had not yet evolved to eight tails, but the beast essence he needed to evolve had already reached three-quarters thanks to the presence of Huli Zhishen and the other female mythical beasts, and he only needed to catch up with another quarter.

Unfortunately, the increase in demon essence that Zhang Fei needed to reach the emperor rank was not as fast as his beast essence, mainly because the demon rank of all the female demons on his side was too low. Even so, he wasn't disappointed by that, especially since he still had a lot of time before ascending to the Paradise Realm.
In addition to focusing on his cultivation, Zhang Fei did not forget to seduce the three women who were still unwilling to become his women, such as Xian Changyue, Tantai Lingyan, and Jiang Tingxi.

Zhang Fei also did not forget to seduce some female beasts in the beast space, but they had not yet fallen for him, such as Yuwen Xingyuan from the Kunpeng Clan, Nu Qichen from the Nian Clan, and Lei Huoting from the Qilin Clan. As for the other female beasts, he had no interest in them, so he had never seduced them even once.

Meanwhile, everyone Zhang Fei brought to the training space had completed their training, and most of them had perfectly adapted to the level four gravity feature, especially cultivators from the upper realm such as Hun Di, Lin Jingxia, and others.

Although the cultivators from the upper realms had completed their training, they had not thought about returning to the Xianjin Realm, especially since Zhang Fei's training space was more beneficial to them.

As he had originally planned, Zhang Fei [1] brought the people from the Meng Clan back to the Nine Stars Realm, and he bought some flying artifacts for them before ordering them to go to other realms to carry out his plans. He did not bring Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu back to the realm, but instead, he asked them to cultivate in the pavilion.
After that, Zhang Fei [1] went to the Demon Purgatory Realm, and that realm was almost completely empty.
"It looks like your wait is about to end, Kid." Serpentera spoke to him.
- To Be Continued -

*Crack...
