Dai Yishu clenched both fists until his bones made a sound.
"At that time, I will tear his body into pieces."
"You guys are right." Huli Jinhu contacted several of his loyal followers and asked them to do something about Huli Zhishen's loyal followers.
"Let's continue."
"Yeah."
In the Ragging Thunder Realm, Zhang Fei [5] decided to temporarily stop his training.
He rushed to Earth to restock all Earth items, and he then distributed them to all his shops in the various realms, except the Xianjin Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] then went to the residence of the Meng Clan in the Xian Kingdom, and he was quite satisfied with their development, especially the development of Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu.
Since he brought them to the realm a little over a year ago, the two women have improved quite significantly because he has been continuously supplying them with his Yang Qi.
"Your cultivation has reached the 3-Star Sovereign Realm." Meng Qi muttered in surprise.
Meng Guanqiu asked him.
"Why did you suddenly come here?
I thought you were busy in the upper realms."
"My affairs in the upper realms have reduced a lot now.

By the way, it's time for your clan members to train for the next stage, so I'll take them to a special place, and they will focus on their physical training for the next few months." Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu were surprised by Zhang Fei [5]'s sudden decision.
"Once they complete their training, not many cultivators in the middle realms will be able to harm them.
At that time, I will send them to various realms that are not familiar with the Demon Fox Group, and they will establish relationships with people in those realms."
"Are you sure it's okay for them to go to those realms?" Meng Qi asked.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"You two haven't seen my training place, so you guys might still be hesitant now.
However, you won't be hesitant anymore after you train there, and I dare to guarantee that they will be fine if they go to those realms."
"I see." Meng Qi nodded her head lightly.
"Since your progress is so frightening, there is no reason for me to doubt you.
Guanqiu, tell them to prepare."
"Yes, Big Sis."
Zhang Fei [5] then handed many bottles of Yang Qi to Meng Qi.
"Your stock should be almost gone, right?"
"A year ago, you gave me two years' worth of supplies.
However, I also distributed them to my clansmen, so my supplies were dwindling rapidly." Meng Qi accepted and stored them.
"That's not a problem since I can produce as much Yang Qi as I want." Meng Qi felt awkward talking about such a thing with Zhang Fei [5].
"Moreover, they are part of my Demon Fox Group, so I am happy if they become stronger."
Meng Qi smiled faintly.
"Are you going to take us to the upper realms after we finish our training?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] looked into the distance.
"The Sky Dragon Realm is at the border of the middle and upper realms, and the majority of the people in that realm are my allies.
Therefore, I will bring all of them there later, and they will develop faster."
"What about me and Guanqiu?"
"You two will continue to train in my private place." Meng Qi looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion.
"Although your clansmen are my subordinates now, they are not qualified to enter that place, and you will know the reason after this."
Meng Qi was curious about it.
"All right, I will follow your plan."
After the people from the Meng Clan were ready, Zhang Fei [5] sent them all there, and he asked one of his women to bring Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu to the pavilion, which shocked them.
Back then, Feng Jiu asked Zhang Fei [5] to keep Meng Qi by his side because there was something special about her, but the phoenix empress did not say it clearly.
Moreover, his system also couldn't find out what was special about her, and her physique was still too weak at that time, so he kept delaying taking her with him.
Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu did not live there immediately, and Zhang Fei [5] asked him to focus on the training ground until they could adapt to level four gravity.
Zhang Fei [5] then met Nanfeng Yunxi and Luo Xuejia on the small island, especially since he had moved all his shops and restaurants there several months ago.
He sent both women to the training space to join the Meng Clan, especially since he would take them to the Paradise Realm in the future.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Huangfu Kingdom to meet Li Tiannan and Gu Jinling, whom he had tasked to create the Gu Heart since eleven months ago.
Unfortunately, the two of them still had not succeeded in creating it, and they still needed several months to create it.
Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet Long Huang and Long Baiyun in the Beast Kingdom, and he offered them to go to the Sky Dragon Realm, which they agreed to.
However, they couldn't just leave right away, and he needed time to prepare their replacements.

Since Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling had been living in the Phoenix Realm since several months ago, and Xian Jinglan was also in closed-door seclusion, Zhang Fei [5] did not go to the Natural Race Kingdom.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] only sent one person from the Demon Kingdom to his training space, which was Ximen Yueliang.
As for her parents and the other demons, he doesn't really care about them, and he leaves them behind.
Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Sky Dragon Realm to meet Feng Xishui, and he handed many items, both earth items and alchemy items, to him to sell in his new shop in the realm.
As for his restaurant, he didn't have another chef yet, and he decided to send a woman from the Phoenix Clan to learn cooking from Zhang Chen and Zhu Yan.
"I've already selected several women from the Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Clans." Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows at Feng Xishui.
"I know those three clans are still hostile towards you, but I'm sure those young women don't have the same intentions as their leaders.
If you have any doubts about them, I will summon them here, and you can check them out for yourself."
"Please summon them, Senior Xishui."
"All right."
A few minutes later, three female dragons, two female black turtles, and two female white tigers arrived at the Blazing Phoenix Sect.
Zhang Fei [5] used his demon eyes to check their souls, and he found nothing negative about them.
In the end, he sent them to his beast space, especially since their quality and cultivation were indeed the best among the younger generation of their three clans.
Zhang Fei [5] then contacted Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and Dai Hubai.
He forbade them to return to the Xianjin Realm, especially since he was sure that their three ancestors would kill them.

Instead, he asked them to visit all the realms in the upper realms to open his shops in all those realms so he could obtain abundant cultivation resources in preparation for him and his family to go to the Paradise Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] then went to the Phoenix Realm, and he convinced Feng Xueying to train in his training space.
The ice phoenix was hesitant about it at first, but she ultimately accepted his offer.
He secretly went to the Xianjin Realm, and he managed to convince Lin Jingxia to join Hun Di and the others.
Apart from her, he also sent people from the Hong, Yan, and Wang clans there, mainly because they were Hong Xinxin's and Wang Yourou's families.
Then, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Gong Ren and bought quite a lot of teleportation devices from him.

He then entered the beast space, and he asked Feng Shanxi to concoct the true foundation pill as well, which would help him reach his seclusion target, the Quasi Divine Realm, or even the Seven Divine Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] then returned to the Raging Thunder Realm, where he used the remaining five true foundation pills to break through from the 3-Star Sovereign Realm to the 8-Star Sovereign Realm.
A month passed, and Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie finally arrived at the Raging Thunder Realm, and they handed Mo Zhuo over to Zhang Fei [5].
At first, Zhang Fei [5] wanted to kill Mo Zhuo like Xereth's other subordinates, but he changed his mind and enslaved him.
He used his body modification ability to alter their physical appearance and turned them into humans.
He then ordered them to roam all the realms in the upper realms to spread his Demon Fox Group and open shops.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] continued his training in the Thunderfall Gorge to reach the peak stage lightning element and the perfection stage lightning elemental law.
Another two months passed; Zhang Fei's lightning element and lightning elemental law had reached the final stage, and his fifth clone immediately left the Raging Thunder Realm.

In the past three months, Zhang Fei's first clone repeatedly checked the situation in the Demon Purgatory Realm, and the demons dying in the realm were increasing every day as the intensity of the blood moon phenomenon increased.
Unfortunately, the Blood Flame still had not appeared, disappointing him.
Zhang Fei [5] went to the beast space to meet all the beasts living there, just like what he had been doing for the past few months.
He was elated when Feng Shanxi told him that she had concocted three superior-grade true foundation pills, which was due to the time flow inside being two times faster than the outside world.
Although Feng Shanxi only managed to refine three pills, Zhang Fei [5] was satisfied with it, especially since his cultivation had long been stable at the 8-Star Sovereign Realm.
This way, he could use all three pills immediately, and his cultivation would be able to break through to the Saint Realm directly.
Afterwards, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Yin-Yang Space, and he absorbed the Qi in the tub.
Once his cultivation broke through, he went straight to the Starry Sky Realm, where no one would bother him there.
After his cultivation broke through to the 2-Star Saint Realm, Zhang Fei [5] entered the pavilion and focused on his body cultivation to reach the fifth stage, the Bone Forging Stage.
Moreover, Huoyun Zhiyan and the other two would finish refining the second batch of the true foundation pill in the next three months, so he had plenty of time to take care of other things.
As for Zhang Fei [5]'s beast and demon forms, both were still quite far from reaching the next stage, but he and his clones were still trying hard to improve them as soon as possible.

Since his cultivation had reached the 2-Saint Realm, Zhang Fei and his four clones decided to use the harem sharing to help their respective women, which allowed their cultivation to increase tremendously.
After traveling around the demon realms for the past three months, Xereth finally gained three new subordinates, but they were not as powerful as his former subordinates.
Unlike his former subordinates, Xereth did not let them have their own consciousness, and he enslaved them before sending one of them to Earth.
He sent the other two to the Netherworld Realm and also to search for the whereabouts of the Heavenly Fox Races.
Xereth realized that his efforts might be in vain, but he sent them there anyway.
After that, he went to other demon realms to find some more new subordinates, especially since time was ticking and his deadline was decreasing.
Since Zhang Fei brought Huli Zhishen with him, six months had passed in the outside world and a year in the pavilion.
His cultivation had not yet moved from the 2-Star Saint Realm because the Qi he needed was constantly increasing, but he was also not far from breaking through to the third stage.
Meanwhile, his body cultivation had reached the Bone Forging Stage, which increased his physical strength by another 20%.
Additionally, his skeleton becomes stronger and more resilient to physical attacks.
During his seclusion, Zhang Fei's Scarlet Furnace Body Method also successfully reached the Infernal Body Stage, which was thanks to the female fire mythical beasts.
This way, his body strength was strengthened by another 40% and his fire element by another 80%.

As for his soul cultivation, Zhang Fei's soul level is still at the perfection stage of the heavenly soul level, but Hun Di told him that he will probably break through to the ancestral soul level in the next few months.

Zhang Fei's beast form had not yet evolved to eight tails, but the beast essence he needed to evolve had already reached three-quarters thanks to the presence of Huli Zhishen and the other female mythical beasts, and he only needed to catch up with another quarter.

Unfortunately, the increase in demon essence that Zhang Fei needed to reach the emperor rank was not as fast as his beast essence, mainly because the demon rank of all the female demons on his side was too low.
Even so, he wasn't disappointed by that, especially since he still had a lot of time before ascending to the Paradise Realm.
In addition to focusing on his cultivation, Zhang Fei did not forget to seduce the three women who were still unwilling to become his women, such as Xian Changyue, Tantai Lingyan, and Jiang Tingxi.

Zhang Fei also did not forget to seduce some female beasts in the beast space, but they had not yet fallen for him, such as Yuwen Xingyuan from the Kunpeng Clan, Nu Qichen from the Nian Clan, and Lei Huoting from the Qilin Clan.
As for the other female beasts, he had no interest in them, so he had never seduced them even once.

Meanwhile, everyone Zhang Fei brought to the training space had completed their training, and most of them had perfectly adapted to the level four gravity feature, especially cultivators from the upper realm such as Hun Di, Lin Jingxia, and others.

Although the cultivators from the upper realms had completed their training, they had not thought about returning to the Xianjin Realm, especially since Zhang Fei's training space was more beneficial to them.

As he had originally planned, Zhang Fei [1] brought the people from the Meng Clan back to the Nine Stars Realm, and he bought some flying artifacts for them before ordering them to go to other realms to carry out his plans.
He did not bring Meng Qi and Meng Guanqiu back to the realm, but instead, he asked them to cultivate in the pavilion.
After that, Zhang Fei [1] went to the Demon Purgatory Realm, and that realm was almost completely empty.
"It looks like your wait is about to end, Kid." Serpentera spoke to him.
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 931: Blood Flame
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [1] nodded at Serpentera. "I've been waiting for the Blood Flame for so long, so I must succeed in getting it."

"Hey, kid, you used shortcuts too often, or else you wouldn't have been able to reach the 2-Star Saint Realm in just eight months." Zhang Fei [1] turned to Tian Kui, showed him a true foundation pill, and explained it to him. "Oh? I didn't expect an alchemist in the three mortal realms to have such a pill, but does this pill really not leave any sequelae?"

"Not at all." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a shake of his head. "Back then, I used the nine revolutions pill to stabilize my cultivation, but it left behind sequelae. Fortunately, Lin Jingxia gave me the recipe for the true foundation pill, and its effects were close to perfect. Unfortunately, concocting the pill took half a year, and the process was extremely complicated. The ingredients were also rare, but I was lucky because I had two dryads by my side, and one of them could clone herbs."

Tian Kui nodded in understanding. "You are indeed lucky to have them, kid. Dryads are the most sought after by alchemists because of their abilities with plants, but not many have managed to find them, especially since they always live in complicated places."
"Yeah, you're right."

Serpentera then informed Zhang Fei [1]. "Kid, in the last half year, I detected Xereth's movements, and he has already gained several new subordinates to replace those who fell into your hands. He ordered two of them to go to the lower and middle realms, and the others were busy looking for something in the upper realms."

Zhang Fei [1] was shocked to learn that Serpentera could detect anything from such a long distance, which made him realize how terrifying the strength of the cultivators in the Five Celestial Realms truly was. "Those two demons are likely heading towards my home realm and the Netherworld Realm, and the rest of them are probably looking for the Heavenly Fox Race, or maybe they are also aiming for the Abyssal Realm. Since that demon once fought with you, he wouldn't dare to send his new subordinates to you."
"Hahaha! He's too much of an idiot if he dares to send his subordinates to me." Serpentera laughed loudly. "Do you need our help to sort them out?"
"I don't have time for other matters, and I want to focus on my cultivation more. Therefore, I would appreciate your assistance in sorting them out." Zhang Fei [1] didn't need to think to decide.

"They are small fries; we can deal with them easily." Tian Kui said confidently. "However, we will not help you fight Xereth, especially since Taotie will know of our presence here. If he sends his avatar here to hunt us down, the three mortal realms will be doomed."

Zhang Fei [1] also did not expect Taotie's avatar to descend into the three mortal realms, which would be troublesome for everyone. "It's okay, you two don't need to deal with Xereth. Moreover, his injuries should still be severe, especially since a winged race's avatar from the Paradise Realm injured him a year ago."

"Oh?" Serpentera and Tian Kui were surprised to hear that, prompting Zhang Fei [1] to explain to them. "In that case, you don't need to think about that demon, and I'm sure his injuries won't be able to recover in just a year."
"Let's go now, Old Kui! The sooner we go, the sooner we get home."

After the two ancient demon beasts disappeared, Zhang Fei [1] went to see Wang Yin, who was monitoring the situation in the realm. "Congratulations! Your cultivation has gotten closer to the Seven Divine Realms."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei [1] looked at the demons below them. "If my calculations are correct, all these demons will die within a month, and the Blood Flame will appear then."
"I think so too." Wang Yin then sighed softly. "Even though many of these demons are my old enemies, I feel sorry for them having to die because of this phenomenon."

"Life and death are predestined, and not everyone has the ability to change fate." Wang Yin nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [1], especially since she herself had already died once. "Like you, I also died once, but I was luckier than you because the killer brought me back to life even though my identity became different. Since I've experienced it once, I would rather not experience it again. I will strive hard to become strong, and I will defy fate."
"Defy the fate, huh?" Wang Yin muttered to herself. "If I could think like you, I would have left this realm long ago and searched for that mysterious person."

"Your main mistake is that you are too clingy to your past, and the past always holds you back from moving forward." Wang Yin did not refute Zhang Fei [1]. "I know you don't want to be an undead demon like now, but you have already become one, so you must accept that reality and move on with your life. Unlike you, I accepted my changes from the first time, and I chose to embrace the reality, which eventually brought many changes in my life."
"How can you accept reality so easily?"

"What can I do?" Zhang Fei [1] clenched his fists in front of him. "Unlike you, who were born and lived as a cultivator in the past, I was born as an ordinary human without any power. Even if I wanted to mourn my death and change, I didn't have the power to change anything. Moreover, I had nothing to lose because my family abandoned me, and the only person who kept me moving forward was my grandmother. Without her, I would have probably given up on my life long ago. At that time, I realized that my death and the changes in my life could shape my future, so I chose to accept everything instead of mourning both. Since then, I have been through a lot; many beautiful and awful things have come and gone, all of which made me who I am now. Although there are many obstacles ahead, this life is too beautiful to miss, so I think you should leave your past behind. If you can do that, you will find many interesting things out there, and your life will no longer be as dull as it is now."

After hearing that, Wang Yin fell into deep thought as her eyes moved to scan the entire area of the realm. A while later, she spoke to Zhang Fei [1]. "There is almost nothing in this realm now, so I will leave, and I will look for the purpose of my life."

"If you think that is best for you, you can do so." Zhang Fei [1] grabbed her hand. "You must keep in touch with me so I can help you if you encounter any trouble out there, and I will take you with me to the Paradise Realm in the future."
Wang Yin smiled when she heard that. "Don't worry, I will keep in touch with you."
After that, Wang Yin returned to her palace, gave instructions to her undead subordinates, and subsequently left the Demon Purgatory Realm.
Morgana was quite surprised by Wang Yin's decision, but she was also happy that she finally had the courage to move forward in her life.
After she lived in the Demon Purgatory Realm for the past year, Morgana decided to leave that realm, and she brought Oz the First back to the Abyssal Realm.

Not only them, but the wolf demon, Alder, also decided to leave the realm. He told Zhang Fei [1] to take excellent care of Tasha, and he himself planned to return to the Blackthorn Abyss Realm to save his family.

Since Ju Yingzhi had fully recovered, Zhang Fei [1] decided to send her and Xin Yanluo to the training space, and they began their rigorous physical training. This way, only Wang Yin's subordinates and his subordinates from the Diyu and Netherworld Realms lived in the palace.
[Master, you were too focused on your cultivation, and you forgot your three gift boxes from the last three quests.]
"Open them, Mei."
[Yes.]
[Obtained the Key to Fox Mysterious Realm. Grade: Unknown.]
[Obtained the Fox Spirit Orb. Grade: Unknown.]
[Obtained the Lightning Compass. Grade: Unknown.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] momentarily raised an eyebrow. "I definitely got the two fox items from quests in the golden fox's realm, and the last one from the quest got the lightning element."
[That's right, Master.]
"Show their details, Mei."

[The Key to Fox Mysterious Realm: According to legend, all fox races gathered and lived in a beautiful realm before they were scattered to all corners of the universe due to attacks by other mythical beasts. They lock their realm with a seal made from their origin bloodlines, and this key functions to open it.]
[The Fox Spirit Orb: This orb contains the essence of the first fox born in this universe, but it requires a special method to extract it.]

[The Lightning Compass: Originally crafted by the Ancient Lightning Dao Sect, this compass will lead its owner to the strongest lightning source in this universe, where the lightning veins of this universe are formed.]

Zhang Fei [1] was sure that the key and the orb were related to each other, so he didn't take them from the inventory, but he was confused about the first fox born in the universe. According to the will of the universe, the ten-tailed fox is a primordial beast, so he should be the first fox born in the universe.

Zhang Fei [1] then took out the lightning compass, which was purple with lightning flashes around it. He tried to inject his lightning element and elemental law into it, but it didn't show any reaction. "I guess this compass will only be active in the Paradise Realm."

[I think so too, Master. By the way, why don't you ask Zhe Wuming to send you to that place? If you meet the will of the universe, you might be able to get information about the fox mysterious realm.]

"I think it's useless, Mei. The mysterious realm and the orb are related to the first fox born in this universe, so I'm sure the location of that place is not in the three mortal realms but in the Paradise Realm." Zhang Fei [1] then stored the lightning compass again. "Instead of thinking about that, I'll go to the alchemy union. Huoyun Zhiyan and the others should have finished concocting the second batch of true foundation pills, and I can break through to the Quasi Divine Realm or even the Seven Divine Realm depending on the number of their pills."
[Well, that's true. Go there now and check on them, Master.]

A while later, Zhang Fei [1] had arrived at the Alchemy Union, and the three old alchemists handed over nine foundation pills to him. "Oh? Unlike before, you managed to concoct three superior-grade pills, huh?"
"Yes, Master." Huoyun Zhiyan then asked. "Can we take a break first, Master? We've been concocting pills for over a year, and we won't be able to if you ask us to concoct a third batch."
"Rest for a month, and I want you to concoct the third batch after that, especially since all my women need the pill." Zhang Fei [1] immediately left the Alchemy Union and went elsewhere.

Huoyun Zhiyan released a sigh of relief. "His cultivation speed is too terrifying! The last time he met us was half a year ago, and his cultivation was still at the 6-Star Heaven Realm at that time, but he has already reached the 2-Star Saint Realm now."

"How do you think he did it?" Sun Jianming asked. "Even if he could stabilize his cultivation with the pill, he needs so much Qi to break through sixteen stages, and it is impossible to achieve it in just six months."

"Why should you care about him?" Xiu Hanyu asked in an angry tone, especially since he was still annoyed that Zhang Fei [1] had enslaved him and treated him as a slave. "I'll go back to rest now before that bastard comes here again."

Huoyun Zhiyan then answered his friend. "I don't know how he managed to do all that, but since he was able to gather so much Qi in six months, I think he will break through to the Seven Divine Realms soon using our pills."
"That's right." Sun Jianming replied with a nod of approval. "Let's go back; I'm really tired and want to rest."
Zhang Fei [1] stood in front of the glass tube, thinking about the qi inside. "Do you think the qi inside is enough for me to break through to the Quasi Divine Realm, Mei?"

[I don't think this is enough, Master. You already used up all the Yin Qi inside three months ago, and the addition in the past three months hasn't been much. If you absorb it all now, I think you'll only reach the 6-Star Saint Realm, especially since the amount of Qi you need increases by fifty million with each level. Since the outside world is still calm, I think you can continue your seclusion for the next few months, and you can break through to the Seven Divine Realms when you come out again.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with that. "What about my beast form?"

[You only need about five hundred million more beast essence to be able to evolve to eight tails, and you have all seven female mythical beasts by your side. By the way, you haven't done anything to Zhu Shanniang in the past six months, so I think it's time, and your evolution will happen faster.]

Zhang Fei [1] let out a soft sigh after Mei mentioned Zhu Shanniang. He could have forced the female vermilion bird to serve him a long time ago, but he preferred to wait for her to willingly submit herself to him. However, her mental strength was extraordinary, and she was able to hold herself back for the past six months, even though she had sex with Huli Xianniang in front of her too many times.

Zhang Fei [1] then thought about his demon rank and spoke. "Ever since I registered them in my partner list, Xia Qianqian's and the others' cultivation has improved significantly. Unfortunately, their demon rank is still too low now, so I think I'll bring them back to the Demon Purgatory Realm."

[Unfortunately, this tube can only absorb Qi but not demon essence, Master. If this can also absorb demon essence, you can turn your ten female prisoners into demons, and they will give you a lot of demon essence.]

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed at that. "Why are you greedier than me, Mei? Of course, I hope for that too, but nothing is perfect in this world, and not everything can be achieved easily. Although I couldn't get the demon essence from them, I have gained a lot of Qi from them, so I am quite satisfied with that. Sigh! I will wait until the amount of Qi in the tube is enough to break through to the Seven Divine Realms, so I won't waste too much time and break through to that stage all at once."
Zhang Fei [1] had brought all his partners to the Demon Purgatory Realm, but the situation in the realm suddenly changed drastically, and the temperature increased significantly.
"Brother! Over there!" Xia Qianqian exclaimed as she pointed at a faint object in the sky.

"The Blood Flame is starting to appear." Zhang Fei [1] then opened the map, and the number of demons in the realm decreased significantly, making the flame slowly become clearer. "You guys can go to our room now, and I will join you soon."
Zhang Fei [1] then flew before the Blood Flame, but he felt a surge within him. His blood was boiling, and he felt a strong sense of bloodlust.
[Master, you better be careful in absorbing this Blood Flame, or your bloodlust will go out of control.] Mei warned him.

"If I can't control my bloodlust, I will go to another demon realm to vent it." After Zhang Fei [1] waited for some time, the Blood Flame was already very clear before him. He grabbed the flame, which made his bloodlust skyrocket. "Damn it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 934: Quasi Divine Realm
paragraphs: Six months have passed again in the outside world and a year in the training space, and Zhang Fei's cultivation has reached the 10-Star Saint Realm thanks to all his and his clones' partners, combined with the Qi he got from his ten prisoners.

Zhang Fei's soul power broke through to the early stage of the Ancestral Soul Level, and his body cultivation also broke through to the fifth stage, the Organ Strengthening Stage, which strengthened all his internal organs and increased his Qi absorption rate by 20%.

Zhang Fei's beast form finally evolved into eight tails, aided by the female mythical beasts beside him, while his demon rank nearly reached the emperor rank; however, this progress was much slower than that of his cultivation and beast form. This delay was particularly notable because most of the women had low demon ranks, with Feng Yichen being the only one capable of providing him with a significant amount of demon essence.

Besides all that, Zhang Fei's alchemy rank has reached the venerable rank, but his blacksmith rank only reached the grandmaster rank due to limited materials. As for his formation array, he repeatedly neglected it, making him stagnant at rank 5.

Zhang Fei stood in front of the glass tube, pressed his palm against it, and checked the Qi inside. All his official and unofficial women stood behind him, and the majority of them experienced significant improvements in their cultivation, especially those who were still in the ten mortal realms.
Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "Unfortunately, this Qi won't be enough to help me break through to the Seven Divine Realms, but I think the Quasi Divine Realm is good enough."
"Husband, no other cultivator can cultivate as fast as you, okay?" Hong Xinxin spoke to him.

Murong Qianying nodded in agreement with her. "In just six months, you have broken through from the 2-Star Saint Realm to the tenth stage, and you will break through to the Quasi Divine Realm after this, so you should be satisfied with this."

"How can he be satisfied with this?" Shang Yumei asked with a shake of her head. "He is impatient to eat us all, so we shouldn't be surprised if he is disappointed that he cannot break through to the Seven Divine Realms immediately."

"Haha." Shang Yaolin laughed softly. "Your cultivation won't be far from the Seven Divine Realms after this, and you have us by your side. Therefore, you don't have to be disappointed and break through to the Quasi-Divine Realm first. We'll go into seclusion again if you can't wait to break through to that stage."
Liu Qingyu and the others also encouraged Zhang Fei, and none of them minded entering into seclusion once again to help him break through to the Seven Divine Realms.

Zhang Fei turned to them and looked at them one by one. "I never imagined this kind of situation before I became a cultivator, but I am truly fortunate that I have all of you by my side. You guys are right; I should be satisfied with my current cultivation. Once I finish breaking through to the Quasi Divine Realm, we will enter into seclusion once again until I break through to the Seven Divine Realms."
"Send us to the Starry Sky Realm now, Fei'er." Liu Hua spoke.
Hu Yue also spoke. "We have never accompanied you on a breakthrough before, so we want to accompany you this time."
"Me too, Big Brother!" Zhang Lin said, as did Zhang Yue and the others. Although they were still not as strong as Zhang Fei, they were much stronger now, so they wanted to accompany him.
Zhang Fei first summoned Lei Que, Long Jishan, and the lightning spirit. Afterwards, he opened the gate to the Starry Sky Realm, and all of them disappeared into it.
"Phew." Zhang Fei touched the glass tube again. "Let's do it then."
[You gained 100,000,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to the Quasi Divine Realm.]
*Rumble...Rumble...*

Zhang Fei, his five clones, Lei Que, Long Jishan, and Lei flew into the sky to face the lightning tribulation. This time, Hong Xinxin also joined them by using her Azure Emperor Roc form, especially since his lightning tribulation would be useful to her as a lightning beast.

Zhang Fei activated the natural awareness ability, and countless Qi threads appeared before him. He noticed that many of the Qi threads were different from the others, similar to what he had observed in the bodies of several of his women, particularly those who had reached the Seven Divine Realms. "So, this is the Divine Qi, huh?"

Fortunately, the heavens had already started using the Divine Qi in Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation since he broke through to the sovereign realm, and it continued until he reached the 10-Star Saint Realm.
*Rumble...Rumble...*

Zhang Fei looked up at the sky and smiled. "Back then, I couldn't differentiate between normal Qi and the Divine Qi, but you've been using the Divine Qi to punish me since I broke through to the sovereign realm. Therefore, I have to thank you for that, especially since I wouldn't have been able to understand it this easily if you hadn't used it on me."
As usual, Zhang Fei took out his seven cultivation cores and three souls. He then closed his eyes and began to absorb the Divine Qi before spreading it throughout his body, cores, and souls.

Hong Xinxin, Lei, Lei Que, and Long Jinshan were intently observing Zhang Fei. They could feel that he was absorbing the Divine Qi at a rapid pace, and his absorption rate continued to increase as time passed, making the Divine Qi quickly accumulate in his body.

Far below, all of Zhang Fei's women were waiting anxiously, and some of them were tightly gripping their fists, especially those who had never broken through to the Quasi Divine Realm, such as Zhang Yue, Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, and a few others.

Compared to them, the women from the middle and upper realms looked calmer, especially since they had already broken through to that stage in the past. Although the aura and pressure above the sky were terrifying, and lightning bolts kept striking down there, they could feel that Zhang Fei was much calmer than usual, and there were no negative symptoms happening to him.
"Back then, I failed dozens of times before I managed to break through to the Quasi-Divine Realm." Xian Xianqin muttered as her eyes looked up at the sky.
Yun Xingyue nodded at that. "Just like you, I also failed over and over again, and it took me several years to break through to that level."
"Haha." Ling Long laughed at that. "Unlike you two, it only took me three months to break through to that stage, and my breakthrough only lasted ten minutes."
"Me too." Zhou Shenxin joined in. "My breakthrough at that time also didn't take too long, only about ten minutes."
"You two are lucky." Shang Xinyu sighed softly as she spoke. "Yifen and I are more focused on body cultivation, so our breakthrough was much slower than yours back then."
"It took me a year before I managed to break through to that stage." Shang Yifen spoke with a bitter smile.

"I think Zhang Fei wouldn't have taken too long either if he hadn't accumulated too much bad karma." Huli Zhishen pointed at the sky. "The heavens are still brewing his lightning tribulation, and I don't think it will come down anytime soon."

"I agree with you, Ancestor." Huli Xianniang spoke with a serious expression. "I have witnessed powerful lightning tribulation too many times, but I have never witnessed one as powerful as Zhang Fei's. Although his lightning tribulation has not yet descended, I can already feel the terrifying pressure from the sky. If I were in his position, I would probably immediately run away and hide."
"Do you think you can escape from the heavens?" Huli Haohao asked with a shake of her head, making Huli Xianniang narrow her eyes at her.
Feng Qingmeng then spoke. "If the heavens want to kill us, there is no place for us to hide."
'Fortunately, we have never encountered such a terrifying lightning tribulation, or we would have died long ago.' Zhu Lingyao softly spoke.

Zhu Shanniang remained silent and looked up at the sky, secretly hoping that Zhang Fei would not succeed in his breakthrough. Despite their frequent intimacy over the past six months or a year in the training space, she still longed for freedom from him.

Murong Qianying smiled, listening to them. "If Zhang Fei was still the old him, his lightning tribulation this time would be very terrifying for him. However, we don't need to worry about him because his lightning element and elemental law have reached their peak, and he also did not break through alone but with the help of his clones and others."

"Zhang Fei has gone through thousands of lightning tribulations since he broke through to the Earth Realm, and he has changed a lot since then, so I believe he will be able to survive today." Murong Mengxin spoke confidently.

Wang Yourou raised an eyebrow at that. "Zhang Fei is indeed abnormal! Normally, lightning tribulation will only fall when we break through to the sovereign realm, but he has been facing it since the earth realm."
'Master, you must succeed in your breakthrough, or they will be sad.' Xi Yinying silently prayed while clasping her hands together.

"Hey! Look at that! Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation is starting to gather together!" All of them immediately noticed those lightning bolts, and the aura descending from the sky became increasingly heavy, making the women with cultivation below the Seven Divine Realms short of breath.

Huli Zhishen and Feng Yichen immediately enveloped Zhang Yue and the others with their auras, but they still had difficulty breathing, and their faces turned pale. Huli Xianniang and the other women also enveloped them with their aura, which greatly helped them to withstand the increasingly intense pressure.
All of them frowned as the lightning bolts fused and started to form something else. "The heavens really want to kill Zhang Fei."
Inside Zhang Fei's soul sea, Nalan Yushu and Ma Kuangyu were paying attention to his breakthrough, and they were also preparing to absorb the power of his lightning tribulation.
"Hey, Old Ma! Have you ever seen tribulation lightning merge and form another form like that?"

Ma Kuangyu shook his head in response. "Everything about Zhang Fei is nothing ordinary, and his lightning tribulation this time is enough to frighten any cultivator in the Five Celestial Realms. Even though his lightning tribulation this time is this strong, I believe he will successfully pass it."
"I am also confident that he will be successful." Nalan Yushu responded by nodding. "Let's get ready; we have to rush to absorb the lightning bolts once they attack him."
"Yeah."

In an area a little far from Zhang Fei's location, Serpentera and Tian Kui stood side by side. They were previously in a distant realm, but they suddenly felt the power of his lightning tribulation, and both of them rushed towards that realm.
"Are you able to withstand such a powerful lightning tribulation, old friend?"

"Yes." Serpentera nodded to Tian Kui. "This kid's lightning tribulation, while powerful, pales in comparison to my late master's lightning tribulation. Once, I accompanied my late master in his breakthrough, during which I sustained severe injuries. This lightning tribulation is indeed powerful, but it won't be able to hurt me."
"Do you think that kid will survive?"

"Hahaha!" Serpentera responded to Tian Kui with a loud laugh. "Old Kui, you have lived with that kid for quite a long time, so you should already be aware of his strength, right? After his lightning tribulation ends, he may sustain heavy injuries, but they won't be enough to kill him. Instead, his lightning tribulation this time will make him stronger, and he won't have any more trouble when he breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms."

Tian Kui let out a soft sigh. "A year and a half ago, that kid's cultivation was still at the early stage of the heaven realm, but he is breaking through to the quasi-divine realm now, and I have never met a cultivator with such a rapid cultivation speed as him. If he can defeat and subdue the two primordial beasts, he may become the ruler of this universe."

"The ruler of this universe, huh?" Sepentera muttered under his breath. "Throughout my life, I have met countless cultivators, and many of them aspire to become the ruler. Unfortunately, no one has ever succeeded in doing so, and no one will ever succeed as long as the two primordial beasts still exist. However, this kid is different from them, and he is the main heir of the ten-tailed fox, so I think he has a great chance of becoming the ruler."
Tian Kui nodded in agreement. "I hope he can really subdue the two beasts so he can stop the chaos in this universe, and I will enjoy a leisurely life when it is safe."
"I also have the same hopes as you, Old Kui."
*Rumble...Rumble...*

Unlike them, Zhang Fei sat on Lei Que's shoulders, still calm, even though he was aware of the power of those lightning bolts. Instead of being afraid, he looked forward to it, and he hoped that the heavens would bring down the most powerful lightning tribulation for him this time.
Unlike his master, Lei Que was frightened when he saw the lightning bolts gathered together, and his body trembled violently. Even the lightning dragon, Long Jishan, also felt fear in his heart.
"Master, the heavens are no longer holding back, and they intend to kill you during your breakthrough this time." Lei, the lightning spirit, spoke.
Hong Xinxin asked him. "Are you sure you can face everything, Fei'er?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei pulled all his cores and soul back before standing up. "Actually, I'm excited for this, and I'll use it to comprehend the last sub-technique of the Nine Heavens Lightning Art, the Nine Tribulation Descent. If I can successfully master that sub-technique, I might be able to injure or even kill Xereth. Since you have also learned that technique, you should take advantage of my breakthrough to master the last sub-technique as well."
Hong Xinxin nodded to him. "All right, I'll give it a try."
"Follow me, Lei."
"Eh? Where are we going, Master?"

"Up there." Lei was surprised by that, but he immediately followed Zhang Fei to fly even higher until they almost reached the outer boundary of the realm, where a ball of lightning was floating and emitting many lightning bolts. "Oh? This is the core of your lightning tribulation, Master."
"As expected." Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "Do you think I can absorb its power, Lei?"

Lei floated around the lightning ball before telling Zhang Fei. "Master, its power is too high for you to handle alone, but I can help. However, I won't transmit all the power at once because it would burden your body; instead, I will send the power of this lightning ball to you gradually so that you won't experience too much pain."
"Please help me, Lei."
"Yes, Master." Lei immediately entered the lightning ball, and he began to channel power from it to Zhang Fei.
*Zap... Zap...*
"Gahhh!" Zhang Fei screamed. "Fuck! It's only a little, but it's causing me so much pain."
[Master, this lightning ball contains all the power of your lightning tribulation, so it's natural that you're in pain from it.]
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as he noticed the lightning bolts converging faster, which he guessed was due to Lei's actions.
After a while, those lightning bolts had merged and formed a giant figure like a gatekeeper, but his body was made of lightning, and there was a lightning spear in his hand.
Lei, who was previously in the lightning ball, immediately came out and entered Zhang Fei's body. 'Master, that creature is your true lightning tribulation, and it is the embodiment of the heavens.'

'The embodiment of the heavens, huh?' Zhang Fei immediately used his strengthening technique, took out his two swords, and floated in front of the figure. "You are strong, but you will not be able to kill me. Instead, I will prove to you that humans like me are not weak, and I have the ability to defy you."

He noticed that many of the Qi threads were different from the others, similar to what he had observed in the bodies of several of his women, particularly those who had reached the Seven Divine Realms.
"So, this is the Divine Qi, huh?"

Fortunately, the heavens had already started using the Divine Qi in Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation since he broke through to the sovereign realm, and it continued until he reached the 10-Star Saint Realm.
*Rumble...Rumble...*
Zhang Fei looked up at the sky and smiled.
"Back then, I couldn't differentiate between normal Qi and the Divine Qi, but you've been using the Divine Qi to punish me since I broke through to the sovereign realm.
Therefore, I have to thank you for that, especially since I wouldn't have been able to understand it this easily if you hadn't used it on me."
As usual, Zhang Fei took out his seven cultivation cores and three souls.
He then closed his eyes and began to absorb the Divine Qi before spreading it throughout his body, cores, and souls.
Hong Xinxin, Lei, Lei Que, and Long Jinshan were intently observing Zhang Fei.
They could feel that he was absorbing the Divine Qi at a rapid pace, and his absorption rate continued to increase as time passed, making the Divine Qi quickly accumulate in his body.

Far below, all of Zhang Fei's women were waiting anxiously, and some of them were tightly gripping their fists, especially those who had never broken through to the Quasi Divine Realm, such as Zhang Yue, Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, and a few others.
Compared to them, the women from the middle and upper realms looked calmer, especially since they had already broken through to that stage in the past.

Although the aura and pressure above the sky were terrifying, and lightning bolts kept striking down there, they could feel that Zhang Fei was much calmer than usual, and there were no negative symptoms happening to him.
"Back then, I failed dozens of times before I managed to break through to the Quasi-Divine Realm." Xian Xianqin muttered as her eyes looked up at the sky.
Yun Xingyue nodded at that.
"Just like you, I also failed over and over again, and it took me several years to break through to that level."
"Haha." Ling Long laughed at that.
"Unlike you two, it only took me three months to break through to that stage, and my breakthrough only lasted ten minutes."
"Me too." Zhou Shenxin joined in.
"My breakthrough at that time also didn't take too long, only about ten minutes."
"You two are lucky." Shang Xinyu sighed softly as she spoke.
"Yifen and I are more focused on body cultivation, so our breakthrough was much slower than yours back then."
"It took me a year before I managed to break through to that stage." Shang Yifen spoke with a bitter smile.
"I think Zhang Fei wouldn't have taken too long either if he hadn't accumulated too much bad karma." Huli Zhishen pointed at the sky.
"The heavens are still brewing his lightning tribulation, and I don't think it will come down anytime soon."
"I agree with you, Ancestor." Huli Xianniang spoke with a serious expression.
"I have witnessed powerful lightning tribulation too many times, but I have never witnessed one as powerful as Zhang Fei's.
Although his lightning tribulation has not yet descended, I can already feel the terrifying pressure from the sky.
If I were in his position, I would probably immediately run away and hide."
"Do you think you can escape from the heavens?" Huli Haohao asked with a shake of her head, making Huli Xianniang narrow her eyes at her.
Feng Qingmeng then spoke.
"If the heavens want to kill us, there is no place for us to hide."
'Fortunately, we have never encountered such a terrifying lightning tribulation, or we would have died long ago.' Zhu Lingyao softly spoke.
Zhu Shanniang remained silent and looked up at the sky, secretly hoping that Zhang Fei would not succeed in his breakthrough.
Despite their frequent intimacy over the past six months or a year in the training space, she still longed for freedom from him.
Murong Qianying smiled, listening to them.
"If Zhang Fei was still the old him, his lightning tribulation this time would be very terrifying for him.
However, we don't need to worry about him because his lightning element and elemental law have reached their peak, and he also did not break through alone but with the help of his clones and others."

"Zhang Fei has gone through thousands of lightning tribulations since he broke through to the Earth Realm, and he has changed a lot since then, so I believe he will be able to survive today." Murong Mengxin spoke confidently.
Wang Yourou raised an eyebrow at that.
"Zhang Fei is indeed abnormal!
Normally, lightning tribulation will only fall when we break through to the sovereign realm, but he has been facing it since the earth realm."
'Master, you must succeed in your breakthrough, or they will be sad.' Xi Yinying silently prayed while clasping her hands together.
"Hey!
Look at that!

Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation is starting to gather together!" All of them immediately noticed those lightning bolts, and the aura descending from the sky became increasingly heavy, making the women with cultivation below the Seven Divine Realms short of breath.
Huli Zhishen and Feng Yichen immediately enveloped Zhang Yue and the others with their auras, but they still had difficulty breathing, and their faces turned pale.
Huli Xianniang and the other women also enveloped them with their aura, which greatly helped them to withstand the increasingly intense pressure.
All of them frowned as the lightning bolts fused and started to form something else.
"The heavens really want to kill Zhang Fei."
Inside Zhang Fei's soul sea, Nalan Yushu and Ma Kuangyu were paying attention to his breakthrough, and they were also preparing to absorb the power of his lightning tribulation.
"Hey, Old Ma!
Have you ever seen tribulation lightning merge and form another form like that?"
Ma Kuangyu shook his head in response.
"Everything about Zhang Fei is nothing ordinary, and his lightning tribulation this time is enough to frighten any cultivator in the Five Celestial Realms.
Even though his lightning tribulation this time is this strong, I believe he will successfully pass it."
"I am also confident that he will be successful." Nalan Yushu responded by nodding.
"Let's get ready; we have to rush to absorb the lightning bolts once they attack him."
"Yeah."
In an area a little far from Zhang Fei's location, Serpentera and Tian Kui stood side by side.
They were previously in a distant realm, but they suddenly felt the power of his lightning tribulation, and both of them rushed towards that realm.
"Are you able to withstand such a powerful lightning tribulation, old friend?"
"Yes." Serpentera nodded to Tian Kui.
"This kid's lightning tribulation, while powerful, pales in comparison to my late master's lightning tribulation.
Once, I accompanied my late master in his breakthrough, during which I sustained severe injuries.
This lightning tribulation is indeed powerful, but it won't be able to hurt me."
"Do you think that kid will survive?"
"Hahaha!" Serpentera responded to Tian Kui with a loud laugh.
"Old Kui, you have lived with that kid for quite a long time, so you should already be aware of his strength, right?
After his lightning tribulation ends, he may sustain heavy injuries, but they won't be enough to kill him.
Instead, his lightning tribulation this time will make him stronger, and he won't have any more trouble when he breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms."
Tian Kui let out a soft sigh.

"A year and a half ago, that kid's cultivation was still at the early stage of the heaven realm, but he is breaking through to the quasi-divine realm now, and I have never met a cultivator with such a rapid cultivation speed as him.
If he can defeat and subdue the two primordial beasts, he may become the ruler of this universe."
"The ruler of this universe, huh?" Sepentera muttered under his breath.
"Throughout my life, I have met countless cultivators, and many of them aspire to become the ruler.
Unfortunately, no one has ever succeeded in doing so, and no one will ever succeed as long as the two primordial beasts still exist.
However, this kid is different from them, and he is the main heir of the ten-tailed fox, so I think he has a great chance of becoming the ruler."
Tian Kui nodded in agreement.
"I hope he can really subdue the two beasts so he can stop the chaos in this universe, and I will enjoy a leisurely life when it is safe."
"I also have the same hopes as you, Old Kui."
*Rumble...Rumble...*
Unlike them, Zhang Fei sat on Lei Que's shoulders, still calm, even though he was aware of the power of those lightning bolts.
Instead of being afraid, he looked forward to it, and he hoped that the heavens would bring down the most powerful lightning tribulation for him this time.
Unlike his master, Lei Que was frightened when he saw the lightning bolts gathered together, and his body trembled violently.
Even the lightning dragon, Long Jishan, also felt fear in his heart.
"Master, the heavens are no longer holding back, and they intend to kill you during your breakthrough this time." Lei, the lightning spirit, spoke.
Hong Xinxin asked him.
"Are you sure you can face everything, Fei'er?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei pulled all his cores and soul back before standing up.
"Actually, I'm excited for this, and I'll use it to comprehend the last sub-technique of the Nine Heavens Lightning Art, the Nine Tribulation Descent.
If I can successfully master that sub-technique, I might be able to injure or even kill Xereth.
Since you have also learned that technique, you should take advantage of my breakthrough to master the last sub-technique as well."
Hong Xinxin nodded to him.
"All right, I'll give it a try."
"Follow me, Lei."
"Eh?
Where are we going, Master?"

"Up there." Lei was surprised by that, but he immediately followed Zhang Fei to fly even higher until they almost reached the outer boundary of the realm, where a ball of lightning was floating and emitting many lightning bolts.
"Oh?
This is the core of your lightning tribulation, Master."
"As expected." Zhang Fei muttered to himself.
"Do you think I can absorb its power, Lei?"
Lei floated around the lightning ball before telling Zhang Fei.
"Master, its power is too high for you to handle alone, but I can help.
However, I won't transmit all the power at once because it would burden your body; instead, I will send the power of this lightning ball to you gradually so that you won't experience too much pain."
"Please help me, Lei."
"Yes, Master." Lei immediately entered the lightning ball, and he began to channel power from it to Zhang Fei.
*Zap...
Zap...*
"Gahhh!" Zhang Fei screamed.
"Fuck!
It's only a little, but it's causing me so much pain."
[Master, this lightning ball contains all the power of your lightning tribulation, so it's natural that you're in pain from it.]
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as he noticed the lightning bolts converging faster, which he guessed was due to Lei's actions.
After a while, those lightning bolts had merged and formed a giant figure like a gatekeeper, but his body was made of lightning, and there was a lightning spear in his hand.
Lei, who was previously in the lightning ball, immediately came out and entered Zhang Fei's body. 'Master, that creature is your true lightning tribulation, and it is the embodiment of the heavens.'
'The embodiment of the heavens, huh?' Zhang Fei immediately used his strengthening technique, took out his two swords, and floated in front of the figure.
"You are strong, but you will not be able to kill me.
Instead, I will prove to you that humans like me are not weak, and I have the ability to defy you."

chapters.title: Chapter 935: Pass The Tribulation
paragraphs: *Rumble... Rumble...*
The sky rumbled after Zhang Fei issued his challenge, and the lightning guardian immediately thrust his lightning spear at him.

Zhang Fei deflected the spear with his sword, but the lightning guardian tried to electrocute him. Fortunately, his lightning elemental had reached the perfection stage, and Lei also helped him, making the lightning insignificant to him.

Zhang Fei's five clones surrounded the lightning guardian, and they used different techniques to attack him. They shot the hellflame frost lotus, the annihilation flame, the tempest spear, the ethereal demon claw, and the black hellflame towards the lightning guardian.

Zhang Fei himself did not remain silent, and he flew backwards before channeling all his elements into his sword, swinging it toward the lightning guardian. In that instant, a sword Qi combined from all his elements shot toward him.
*Boom... Boom...*

Several consecutive explosions sounded from the air, and the lightning guardian's body partially disappeared. However, it quickly recovered again, especially since his body was made from Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation, which meant his body would never be destroyed as long as his lightning tribulation was still ongoing.

Seeing that, Lei Que, Long Jishan, and Hong Xinxin immediately helped Zhang Fei and his clones. They used their abilities to attack the lightning guardian, but he absorbed their attacks and used them to strengthen himself, especially since they were lightning possessors.
"Foolish people." The three of them turned to Tian Kui and Serpentera, who suddenly appeared beside them. "Only a fool will attack the lightning guardian with lightning attacks."

"Old Kui is right, you guys." Serpentera looked at the lightning guardian. "That thing is not an ordinary creature, but he is the embodiment of the heavens who deliberately descended by using that kid's lightning tribulation. If you attack him with lightning elements, he will not weaken and will become strong instead. Therefore, you guys should stop trying to help him, but instead, you should help him by absorbing this lightning to strengthen yourselves."
"How should we do it, Senior?"

"There." Serpentera pointed to Zhang Fei and his clones, who had already started fighting fiercely with the lightning guardian, but their attacks had no effect on him at all, especially since he was constantly recovering his body. "You guys should go to their side, but you all must be careful because the lightning guardian's attacks are not easy to handle, and you will be injured if you carelessly absorb them."

"Let's go there!" Hong Xinxin immediately flew away, leading Lei Que and Long Jishan toward Zhang Fei and his clones. As Serpentera instructed, they did not attack the lightning guardian, but instead, they helped them by absorbing his lightning to weaken him.
Serpentera nodded in satisfaction as she watched the actions of Hong Xinxin and the two beasts. "I never dreamed I would witness such a phenomenon during a breakthrough."

"If this kind of phenomenon occurred in the Paradise Realm, those old fogeys would immediately notice it, and they would flock to hunt him down." Tian Kui spoke with a solemn expression. "This kid is overpowered for the three mortal realms, but he is just a speck of dust in the vastness of that realm. If he were to face one of them one day, he wouldn't even have the chance to blink and have his head chopped off instantly."

Serpentera nodded in agreement. "You are right about that, but this kid is not a weak persimmon, and he is mature enough to face the worst situations. Moreover, he has many tricks up his sleeve, so I believe he will be able to adapt to the situation in that realm more easily. Perhaps we will hear his name from all corners of the Paradise Realm in the future, and the leaders of all domains will bow their heads before him."

"Hahaha! If I hadn't witnessed all of his actions and this phenomenon, I would definitely laugh at your confidence in him." Tian Kui then asked. "What do you think if we acknowledge him as our master?"
Serpentera looked at Tian Kui with a shocked expression. "Are you really thinking about recognizing him as your master?"

"Why not?" Tian Ku looked at Zhang Fei with a light smirk. "This kid is not inferior to your late master, and he should be able to surpass him in the future. Furthermore, he is the successor of the ten-tailed fox, so I think recognizing him as our master is not a shameful choice, but instead, we will be proud to choose him as our master, and we will help him deal with those people."
"You're right." Serpentera gave a light nod. "Let's wait for him to ascend to the paradise realm, and we will decide this matter after he arrives there."
"Yeah."

Time passed quickly, but Zhang Fei was frustrated because he and his clone had not yet succeeded in defeating the lightning guardian, mainly because his body kept regenerating. Even after Hong Xinxin, Lei Que, and Long Jishan absorbed his lightning repeatedly, he was still as strong as before.
"Master, you will never win if you keep fighting him like this." Lei spoke as he observed the lightning guardian.
"What do you think I should do, Lei?"

Lei immediately conveyed his idea. "Let your clones and the others deal with this lightning guardian, and I will help you absorb the power from the source of your lightning tribulation, which will weaken him quickly."
[Master, I think you should follow Lei's method and absorb that power, but it would be better if you absorbed a large amount at once, even though it will cause you extreme pain.]
"Let's go, Lei!"

Seeing Zhang Fei go to the source of his lightning tribulation, the lightning guardian immediately flew after him, but his five clones swiftly blocked him and used their respective techniques to attack him. Around them, Hong Xinxin and the two beasts continued to absorb the lightning power released from his body, and they used it to strengthen themselves.

Zhang Fei's first clone suddenly did the unexpected by entering the lightning guardian's body, especially since his body was not a real body but a lightning body. His actions caused him to be shocked by lightning strikes repeatedly, which made him quite painful, and he vomited a little blood.

Fortunately, Zhang Fei's regenerative healing factor immediately kicked in, and it quickly healed his injury. Without delay, he absorbed the lightning power from within the body of the lightning guardian, who continued to attack him with lightning shocks.

Zhang Fei's four other clones also directly attacked the lightning guardian to preoccupy him, so he wouldn't be able to go to his real body. Meanwhile, Hong Xinxin and the two beasts also speed up their absorption rate, and they relentlessly absorb the lightning from the lightning guardian.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the source of his lightning tribulation, and Lei once again entered the lightning ball. "Lei! Don't do it one at a time! Do it as much as possible at once!"
"But, master, you—"
Zhang Fei immediately interrupted. "It's okay, don't worry about me, and I'll endure the pain."
"Yes, Master."
*Zap... Zap...*
"Hiss!" Zhang Fei hissed in pain as the lightning struck him, but he would rather not waste time with the lightning guardian, and he endured the pain with all his might. "Do it again! Don't stop!"
*Zap... Zap...*
"Hiss!"

"That lightning guardian is truly troublesome." Huli Zhishen spoke with a frown. "Zhang Fei was too reckless in absorbing the lightning from the source of his lightning tribulation, and he also used one of his clones to weaken his opponent from within."
"Do you think he will last long, Ancestor?" Huli Xianniang asked.

Instead of Huli Zhishen, Liu Qingyu answered Huli Xianniang. "Fei'er has his regenerative healing factor that he copied from Ashreth. All this time, his recovery speed has always been good, and all his injuries have always healed quickly. Moreover, he also has a special technique that he created from his light element, so I believe he will be able to survive his lightning tribulation until the end."
"Hmm?" Huli Xianniang turned to Zhang Lin and the others, and none of them doubted Zhang Fei's ability to withstand his lightning tribulation. "Let's wait until the end."

"Haha." Liu Hua softly laughed. "Rather than thinking about that, you should prepare yourself, Sister Xianniang. Once his lightning tribulation is over, Fei'er will definitely want to dual cultivate with us right away to speed up his recovery."
"What do you mean by that? Why does he want to dual cultivate after passing such a powerful lightning tribulation?" Huli Zhishen asked in confusion.
Zhang Lin explained to them directly. "Grandma Zishen, my big brother is a lust demon, remember? Some time ago, he obtained a new technique, which is healing through sex."
"Hmm?" Huli Zhishen and the others turned to Zhang Lin with surprise, especially since Zhang Fei didn't tell them about it.

"Hehe." Zhang Lin giggled in response. "His ability allows him to recover from his injuries through sex, and the effect will be faster if he has sex with a strong woman. In fact, his ability does not only apply to himself, but he can also use it on others. He never discusses or uses this ability, especially since none of us have ever suffered a serious injury. Even though he has gone through many lightning tribulations before, he has not suffered serious injuries from any of them."
"I see." Huli Zhishen nodded in understanding. "Zhang Fei's three identities give him too many advantages, especially his identity as a lust demon lord."

Lillea then spoke to them. "Zhang Fei is still a lust demon lord now, but his demon rank will reach the emperor rank soon. Once he reaches that rank, he will transform into a transcendent lust demon. At that time, he will gain many new abilities related to sex and charm, and the effects of his old abilities will also increase significantly."
"What will happen if the effect of his touch ability increases?" Huli Haohao asked.

Feng Qingmeng and the others shivered at the thought of it, especially since Zhang Fei's enhanced demon touch was already too potent against them. Every time he uses it on them, their lust becomes uncontrollable, and they will immediately be carried away by sexual pleasure.

"If the ability to touch increases again, we probably won't be able to think rationally anymore, and we might become slaves to our lust." Qing Yi and the others nodded in agreement with Janette. "However, his most frightening ability is not his ability to touch, but his ability to manipulate our sexual hormones, especially since almost no one can resist its effects, except for Big Sis Yao and Jiang Yinghua."

Ru Xue smiled bitterly as she remembered the beginning of her relationship with Zhang Fei. "Back then, Fei'er had just risen from the dead, and he was in the process of his awakening to become a lust demon. He unknowingly used his hormone manipulation on me, and it caused me to only think about sex, which eventually led to me having sex with him without realizing it."
"Who among you has experienced his hormone manipulation besides Ru Xue?"
Ye Lian and the others shook their heads because Zhang Fei never used his hormone manipulation on them, but he only used his demon charm and demon touch on them.

However, Murong Qianying and Shang Yumei raised their hands, especially since Zhang Fei repeatedly used his hormone manipulation on them when he intruded into the Wasteland Realm. "His ability is truly terrifying; I don't remember anything once he used it on me, and I only realized it after I came back to my senses."
"Me too." Shang Yumei said with a nod. "Back then, I wanted to seduce and subdue him, but instead, he subdued me using his hormone manipulation, and I was completely powerless to resist its effects."
"Hey! What do you think will happen if our husband's demon charm increases again?" Boitata suddenly asked.

Liu Qingyu let out a soft sigh, especially since she herself had experienced the effects of Zhang Fei's demon charm, which lured her into having an affair with him. "Back when we first met, his demon charm was already terrifying, and I quickly fell for his temptation, even though I had a husband at the time."

"Me too." Zhong Yan, Zhao Ziqin, Ye Lian, Qing Yi, and Lian Xing said in unison. "We quickly fell for his charm once he used it on us, even though he was still an ordinary lust demon at the time. After he was transformed into a lust demon lord, its effects became even more terrifying."

"If he evolves into a transcendent lust demon, all women will probably fall prey to his charm without them realizing it." Liu Hua then pointed at Chu Qing. "She's the only woman who wasn't affected by Fei'er's demon charm, but she was attracted to her little fox form."
"Hehehe." Chu Qing giggled at that. "Fei's little fox form is too cute, and I fell in love with him the first time I saw him."
"You even kissed him when he was in his little fox form." Chu Ying said with a shake of her head.
"Big Sis, kissing Zhang Fei while he's in his little fox form isn't bad, and it's quite fun." All of them turned to Chu Qing with looks of astonishment. "Actually, I—"
"She fantasized about having sex with Big Brother in his fox form." Zhang Lin hurriedly continued Chu Qing's words, causing the jaws of the women to drop, especially the human women.
Chu Qing shrugged slightly. "Whether he uses his human, demon, or beast form, Fei is still himself, so I have no problem with that."
"You really are a crazy young girl, Qing'er." Lian Xing commented with a shake of her head.
Instead, Chu Qing put on a proud smile. "Honestly, I want to transform into a beast, and I can experience that kind of thing with Fei."

Chu Qing's words made them all facepalm, but Huli Zhishen immediately said. "That kind of thing might be strange for humans and demons like you, but it's very common for beasts like me, especially before we can change into our human form."
"Did you guys hear that?" They decided to ignore Chu Qing, especially since she was too crazy to think about such things. Even the most perverted Zhang Lin had never thought like that.
*Boom*

A few hours later, a huge explosion suddenly sounded from the sky, and they all turned their heads there, finding the lightning guardian's body in disarray. "Apparently, he will soon complete his lightning tribulation."

Up in the sky, Zhang Fei's condition was not good as he continued to absorb the power from the source of his lightning tribulation, and his first clone also unexpectedly absorbed the lightning power from the lightning guardian's body.
Their actions made the lightning guardian continue to weaken, and his body's recovery was not as fast as before, allowing the other clones to deal with him more freely.
Zhang Fei turned to the lightning guardian. "How much do you have left, Lei?"
"Fifty percent, Master. Thus, you must hold on for the next few hours."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Don't mind me and do it faster than this."
"Yes, Master."
When night fell, the lightning ball looked weak and almost faded, as did the lightning guardian, whose body was no longer intact.
Since it had weakened a lot, Zhang Fei immediately touched the lightning ball and used his absorption technique, and he absorbed the remaining power inside.
On the other hand, Lei continued to push the remaining power into Zhang Fei's body to speed up the process, and the lightning ball disappeared completely sometime later.

Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief after the lightning ball and lightning guardian disappeared, but he was sure that the heavens would not stop trying to kill him, and they would definitely try again when he broke through to the Seven Divine Realms.
Hong Xinxin immediately flew toward Zhang Fei, returned to her human form, and supported him. "Congratulations! You have successfully passed your lightning tribulation."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately swallowed some healing pills and used his light element to heal himself. "Let's go back."
