His actions caused him to be shocked by lightning strikes repeatedly, which made him quite painful, and he vomited a little blood.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei's regenerative healing factor immediately kicked in, and it quickly healed his injury.
Without delay, he absorbed the lightning power from within the body of the lightning guardian, who continued to attack him with lightning shocks.
Zhang Fei's four other clones also directly attacked the lightning guardian to preoccupy him, so he wouldn't be able to go to his real body.
Meanwhile, Hong Xinxin and the two beasts also speed up their absorption rate, and they relentlessly absorb the lightning from the lightning guardian.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the source of his lightning tribulation, and Lei once again entered the lightning ball.
"Lei!
Don't do it one at a time!
Do it as much as possible at once!"
"But, master, you—"
Zhang Fei immediately interrupted.
"It's okay, don't worry about me, and I'll endure the pain."
"Yes, Master."
*Zap...
Zap...*
"Hiss!" Zhang Fei hissed in pain as the lightning struck him, but he would rather not waste time with the lightning guardian, and he endured the pain with all his might.
"Do it again!
Don't stop!"
*Zap...
Zap...*
"Hiss!"
"That lightning guardian is truly troublesome." Huli Zhishen spoke with a frown.
"Zhang Fei was too reckless in absorbing the lightning from the source of his lightning tribulation, and he also used one of his clones to weaken his opponent from within."
"Do you think he will last long, Ancestor?" Huli Xianniang asked.
Instead of Huli Zhishen, Liu Qingyu answered Huli Xianniang.
"Fei'er has his regenerative healing factor that he copied from Ashreth.
All this time, his recovery speed has always been good, and all his injuries have always healed quickly.
Moreover, he also has a special technique that he created from his light element, so I believe he will be able to survive his lightning tribulation until the end."
"Hmm?" Huli Xianniang turned to Zhang Lin and the others, and none of them doubted Zhang Fei's ability to withstand his lightning tribulation.
"Let's wait until the end."
"Haha." Liu Hua softly laughed.
"Rather than thinking about that, you should prepare yourself, Sister Xianniang.
Once his lightning tribulation is over, Fei'er will definitely want to dual cultivate with us right away to speed up his recovery."
"What do you mean by that?
Why does he want to dual cultivate after passing such a powerful lightning tribulation?" Huli Zhishen asked in confusion.
Zhang Lin explained to them directly.
"Grandma Zishen, my big brother is a lust demon, remember?
Some time ago, he obtained a new technique, which is healing through sex."
"Hmm?" Huli Zhishen and the others turned to Zhang Lin with surprise, especially since Zhang Fei didn't tell them about it.
"Hehe." Zhang Lin giggled in response.
"His ability allows him to recover from his injuries through sex, and the effect will be faster if he has sex with a strong woman.
In fact, his ability does not only apply to himself, but he can also use it on others.
He never discusses or uses this ability, especially since none of us have ever suffered a serious injury.
Even though he has gone through many lightning tribulations before, he has not suffered serious injuries from any of them."
"I see." Huli Zhishen nodded in understanding.
"Zhang Fei's three identities give him too many advantages, especially his identity as a lust demon lord."
Lillea then spoke to them.
"Zhang Fei is still a lust demon lord now, but his demon rank will reach the emperor rank soon.
Once he reaches that rank, he will transform into a transcendent lust demon.
At that time, he will gain many new abilities related to sex and charm, and the effects of his old abilities will also increase significantly."
"What will happen if the effect of his touch ability increases?" Huli Haohao asked.
Feng Qingmeng and the others shivered at the thought of it, especially since Zhang Fei's enhanced demon touch was already too potent against them.
Every time he uses it on them, their lust becomes uncontrollable, and they will immediately be carried away by sexual pleasure.
"If the ability to touch increases again, we probably won't be able to think rationally anymore, and we might become slaves to our lust." Qing Yi and the others nodded in agreement with Janette.

"However, his most frightening ability is not his ability to touch, but his ability to manipulate our sexual hormones, especially since almost no one can resist its effects, except for Big Sis Yao and Jiang Yinghua."
Ru Xue smiled bitterly as she remembered the beginning of her relationship with Zhang Fei.
"Back then, Fei'er had just risen from the dead, and he was in the process of his awakening to become a lust demon.
He unknowingly used his hormone manipulation on me, and it caused me to only think about sex, which eventually led to me having sex with him without realizing it."
"Who among you has experienced his hormone manipulation besides Ru Xue?"
Ye Lian and the others shook their heads because Zhang Fei never used his hormone manipulation on them, but he only used his demon charm and demon touch on them.
However, Murong Qianying and Shang Yumei raised their hands, especially since Zhang Fei repeatedly used his hormone manipulation on them when he intruded into the Wasteland Realm.
"His ability is truly terrifying; I don't remember anything once he used it on me, and I only realized it after I came back to my senses."
"Me too." Shang Yumei said with a nod.
"Back then, I wanted to seduce and subdue him, but instead, he subdued me using his hormone manipulation, and I was completely powerless to resist its effects."
"Hey!
What do you think will happen if our husband's demon charm increases again?" Boitata suddenly asked.
Liu Qingyu let out a soft sigh, especially since she herself had experienced the effects of Zhang Fei's demon charm, which lured her into having an affair with him.
"Back when we first met, his demon charm was already terrifying, and I quickly fell for his temptation, even though I had a husband at the time."
"Me too." Zhong Yan, Zhao Ziqin, Ye Lian, Qing Yi, and Lian Xing said in unison.
"We quickly fell for his charm once he used it on us, even though he was still an ordinary lust demon at the time.
After he was transformed into a lust demon lord, its effects became even more terrifying."
"If he evolves into a transcendent lust demon, all women will probably fall prey to his charm without them realizing it." Liu Hua then pointed at Chu Qing.
"She's the only woman who wasn't affected by Fei'er's demon charm, but she was attracted to her little fox form."
"Hehehe." Chu Qing giggled at that.
"Fei's little fox form is too cute, and I fell in love with him the first time I saw him."
"You even kissed him when he was in his little fox form." Chu Ying said with a shake of her head.
"Big Sis, kissing Zhang Fei while he's in his little fox form isn't bad, and it's quite fun." All of them turned to Chu Qing with looks of astonishment.
"Actually, I—"
"She fantasized about having sex with Big Brother in his fox form." Zhang Lin hurriedly continued Chu Qing's words, causing the jaws of the women to drop, especially the human women.
Chu Qing shrugged slightly.
"Whether he uses his human, demon, or beast form, Fei is still himself, so I have no problem with that."
"You really are a crazy young girl, Qing'er." Lian Xing commented with a shake of her head.
Instead, Chu Qing put on a proud smile.
"Honestly, I want to transform into a beast, and I can experience that kind of thing with Fei."
Chu Qing's words made them all facepalm, but Huli Zhishen immediately said.
"That kind of thing might be strange for humans and demons like you, but it's very common for beasts like me, especially before we can change into our human form."
"Did you guys hear that?" They decided to ignore Chu Qing, especially since she was too crazy to think about such things.
Even the most perverted Zhang Lin had never thought like that.
*Boom*
A few hours later, a huge explosion suddenly sounded from the sky, and they all turned their heads there, finding the lightning guardian's body in disarray.
"Apparently, he will soon complete his lightning tribulation."

Up in the sky, Zhang Fei's condition was not good as he continued to absorb the power from the source of his lightning tribulation, and his first clone also unexpectedly absorbed the lightning power from the lightning guardian's body.
Their actions made the lightning guardian continue to weaken, and his body's recovery was not as fast as before, allowing the other clones to deal with him more freely.
Zhang Fei turned to the lightning guardian.
"How much do you have left, Lei?"
"Fifty percent, Master.
Thus, you must hold on for the next few hours."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Don't mind me and do it faster than this."
"Yes, Master."
When night fell, the lightning ball looked weak and almost faded, as did the lightning guardian, whose body was no longer intact.
Since it had weakened a lot, Zhang Fei immediately touched the lightning ball and used his absorption technique, and he absorbed the remaining power inside.
On the other hand, Lei continued to push the remaining power into Zhang Fei's body to speed up the process, and the lightning ball disappeared completely sometime later.

Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief after the lightning ball and lightning guardian disappeared, but he was sure that the heavens would not stop trying to kill him, and they would definitely try again when he broke through to the Seven Divine Realms.
Hong Xinxin immediately flew toward Zhang Fei, returned to her human form, and supported him.
"Congratulations!
You have successfully passed your lightning tribulation."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately swallowed some healing pills and used his light element to heal himself.
"Let's go back."

chapters.title: Chapter 936: Blackthorn Abyss Realm
paragraphs: Upon their arrival at the pavilion, Zhang Fei immediately took Ru Xue and Zhang Lin to his room, where he engaged in dual cultivation with both of them. The two women were the strongest in bed among all his women, mainly due to their demon dragon races, even though they hadn't yet broken through to the Seven Divine Realms.
Ru Xue is the Celestial Demon Dragon, and Zhang Lin is the Abyssal Leviathan Dragon; not even Feng Yichen and Huli Zhishen can match them in terms of stamina when having sex with Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei asked his other women to prepare, and he would dual-cultivate with them after he finished with Zhang Lin and Ru Xue. His five clones were also busy with their respective partners, especially since he couldn't wait for his demon rank to reach emperor rank and evolve into a transcendent lust demon.
In hiding, Xereth suddenly opened his eyes and listened to the incoming voice message from one of his subordinates, who had managed to find Alder's hideout after hunting him for the past six months.

"I can't leave this matter to those foolish demons anymore, or I will really die. Moreover, my strength has been recovered by three-quarters, so I must capture that wolf demon myself." After getting Alder's location, Xereth immediately deactivated the barrier and flew out of the realm. "Once I succeed in capturing him, I will go to the lower realms to look for those demon seeds."
Serpentera and Tian Kui, who were still in the Starry Sky Realm, immediately noticed Xereth's movements. "What is the demon planning now?"

"Hmm?" Serpentera raised his eyebrows as he continued to monitor Xereth's movements. "It seems he is targeting that little wolf, especially since one of his subordinates has been hunting him for months."
"Are you going to save that wolf?"

Serpentera nodded at him. "From what I heard, his daughter is Zhang Fei's future wife, so I can't let him die. Moreover, he is hiding in a realm not far from here, so it's not a difficult matter for me."
"Let's go then."

In less than an hour, Serpentera and Tian Kui had arrived in another realm, and they paralyzed Xereth's subordinate without killing him. They found Alder recovering from his injuries, which he had received from the demons of the Blackthorn Abyss Realm six months ago.
"Hey!" Startled, Alder looked up at Serpentera and Tian Kui. "What a foolish weakling!"
Alder smiled bitterly hearing Tian Kui say that. "How did you two find me in this realm, Seniors?"

"The three mortal realms are too small for our senses; it's too easy for us to check the entire area from end to end." Serpenter then landed in front of Alder. "You shouldn't force yourself, and you can ask Zhang Fei for help. I'm sure that he wouldn't mind helping you, especially with his relationship with your daughter."
"I know that, Senior." Alder replied with a soft sigh. "However, Zhang Fei is still focused on his cultivation, so I would rather not bother him with my problems."

Serpentera nodded in understanding. "That kid has just completed his breakthrough to the Quasi Divine Realm, and he should be resting right now. Moreover, he won't be breaking through anytime soon, so you should discuss your problems with him, and he can help you solve them."

"By the way, we should leave now because Xereth will arrive in this realm soon." Alder was shocked to hear that from Tian Kui, but Serpentera immediately grabbed his shoulder, and the three of them quickly left the realm.
Before long, they were back in the Starry Sky Realm, and Serpentera immediately helped Alder recover from his injuries. "What exactly is Xereth looking for from you?"
"My daughter." Alder's answer surprised Serpentera and Tian Kui, especially since neither of them had ever met Tasha. "My daughter is the ancient sun wolf demon, and she—"
"What?" Serpentera and Tian Kui were shocked to hear that. "Is it true that your daughter is the ancient sun wolf demon?"

Alder nodded at them. "Originally, my wife was not a wolf demon, and she was a descendant of the ancient sun wolf. I met her when I wandered to other demon realms, and she lost her memory at that time. Since she didn't remember her origin, I took her on an adventure until we fell in love with each other. In the end, she turned into a demon wolf, and she regained her memories after she gave birth to our daughter. After she remembered everything, she told me that she was a descendant of that wolf race."
"Then, why do they want to capture your daughter?"

Alder released a soft sigh. "When our daughter was born, she was already different from other wolf demons, and her demon form was similar to my wife's form before she became a demon. At first, we didn't have any problems, but the situation changed after she grew up and started cultivating, which awakened the ancient sun wolf bloodline within her."
"Her awakening caused an unusual phenomenon in your home realm, right?"

"That's right." Alder then shared his memories of when Tasha awakened her bloodline with Serpentera and Tian Kui. "A month after the phenomenon, my demon emperor ordered his subordinates to capture our daughter, and we were too overwhelmed to fight them at that time. Our situation forced me to choose between my wife and my daughter, and my wife asked me to save our daughter, which I did without hesitation. Despite numerous difficulties, I managed to save our daughter, and I took her to hide in the Netherworld Realm for over a thousand years. At first, I didn't know the reason my demon emperor did that, but I eventually found out that he was one of Xereth's subordinates when I tried to save my wife for the first time."
"Oh? So, why does Xereth want your daughter?"

"You've gone senile, Old Kui." Tian Kui looked at Serpentera with his eyebrows raised. "The ancient sun wolf race should have been wiped out thousands of years ago, and you should know the reason behind their extinction."
"Those four evil beasts."

"That's right." Serpentera nodded in response. "Even though they are not as strong as our two races, the ancient sun wolves are still powerful, and they have hidden potential within them. The primordial nihility beast ordered those four to wipe them out, but since they could not descend to the three mortal realms, they ordered Xereth to hunt down those who live here."
Tian Kui nodded in understanding. "Then, why didn't Xereth kill this wolf's wife?"

"Isn't that obvious?" Serpentra asked back, shaking his head. "If Xereth killed his wife, this wolf would never return there, and he would have a hard time finding their daughter. Therefore, he kept his wife alive to lure him back, and he wanted to eliminate all three of them at once, but I don't understand how his wife could have survived the massacre."

"According to my wife's story, a mysterious person saved her and several members of her race, and that person sent them to random places." Alder's answer made Serpentera and Tian Kui exchange surprised glances, and they wondered about the identity of the mysterious person. "She does not know the identity of that person, especially since that person has never appeared in person."

Serpentera nodded in understanding. "As I said before, you should ask Zhang Fei for help to settle this matter. He will definitely help you for your daughter and himself, especially since he can't wait to raise his demon rank to emperor rank soon."
"All right, I will talk to Zhang Fei after he comes out."
Meanwhile, Xereth had just arrived in the previous realm; he was furious when he couldn't find Alder there. In the end, he killed his subordinate, who was still unconscious.
Xereth tried to detect the aura of Serpentera and Tian Kui, but the two ancient beasts were simply too powerful and experienced for him, making him unable to find anything there.

"Could it be that those two powerful beasts saved that wolf? Tch! If he was in their hands, I couldn't catch him now." Xereth then looked into the distance. "The Abyssal Realm should not be far from this realm, but I can't break their barrier with my full strength, so I won't be able to destroy it with my strength not fully recovered. The only thing I can do now is go to the planet in the lower realm or the Wasteland Realm, but the Abyssal Demon Heart still hasn't appeared, so there's no point in me going to that realm."

Xereth then left the realm at full speed, and his destination was none other than the Diyu Realm, especially since the ten demon lord seeds were supposed to be there. Unfortunately, he did not know that the ten seeds already had their masters, who were Zhang Fei and several of his women.
After he spent time with his official and unofficial women for two days, Zhang Fei decided to stop dual cultivating with them and left them to rest.

When Zhang Fei came out of the room, he saw Ming Yanyu, Wang Zhuxian, and Ning Zhuan'er chatting happily in the garden. Despite their familiarity with the pavilion's inhabitants, the three of them did not adopt their naked lifestyle.

Not far from the three young women, Zhang Fei saw Jiang Tingxi was painting the Zhou imperial palace, so he did not disturb them and let her vent her longing. As usual, Tantai Lingyan locked herself in her room, and she had hardly stopped cultivating since he brought her to the pavilion the first time.

Zhang Fei then went to Xian Changyue's room, but he found her sleeping soundly on her bed. In the past year, based on the flow of time in the pavilion, he had repeatedly tried to convince her to become his woman, but she remained firm in her determination not to marry.
Xian Xianqin repeatedly urged Zhang Fei to use his demon abilities on Xian Changyue, but he never did, and he wanted her to accept him of her own free will.
Zhang Fei did not wake Xian Changyue, left her room again, and entered the Sealed World Pearl.

Zhang Fei stood in front of the barrier of one of the five sealed areas, and he could hear the sound of the beasts more clearly from within. Unfortunately, despite his cultivation having reached the Quasi Divine Realm, the barrier remained closed, which left him feeling confused.
[Master, I think the barrier will only open after you break through to the Seven Divine Realms.]

"Yeah." Zhang Fei gave a light nod before sitting cross-legged, and he tried the time acceleration feature using all his soul power. To his surprise, he sensed a significant change within the pearl, and his soul power was not drained as quickly as before. "Hmm? How much time did I manage to speed up, Mei?"
[The time flow is two times faster than the outside world, and your soul power remains at 90%, Master.]

Zhang Fei was surprised again, especially since it made the flow of time in the pearl equivalent to that in the training space. He then tried to increase the speed again, continuing until his soul power became depleted, which made him feel dizzy.
[Four times faster than the outside world in total, Master.]

"Four times faster, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered with a delighted smile. "The difference between Heavenly Soul and Ancestral Soul is too stark, Mei. Back then, I could only speed it up by a few hours, but I was already able to speed it up that much. If I reach the perfection stage, I might be able to speed it up even further. Unfortunately, achieving it is not easy, so I need to put in more effort."

[Rather than thinking about that, I think you should go hunt demons and absorb their demon essence, Master. You only need about 180 million more demon essence, and you will evolve into a transcendent lust demon.]
Zhang Fei nodded at her, and he immediately left the Sealed World Pearl before leaving the training space.
[Daily Quest: Killing 5000 beasts or demon beasts at the Quasi Divine Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 500,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 500 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 500,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 500 purple jewels.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei was surprised when he arrived at the Starry Sky Realm, especially when he saw Serpentera helping Alder recover from his injuries. He immediately approached them. "What happened to him?"

"Six months ago, he tried to save his family, but he was ganged up on by demons from the Blackthorn Abyss Realm and one of Xereth's subordinates." Zhang Fei frowned after Tian Kui said that. "That demon almost managed to capture him before, but we saved him and brought him here. By the way, that demon is on his way to the middle realms, but we don't know his destination yet."

Zhang Fei's expression turned serious after hearing that. "I'm sure Xereth's destination is either the Wasteland Realm or my home realm, but I'm sure he won't go to the Wasteland Realm because the Abyssal Demon Heart hasn't appeared yet, so I'm sure he'll target my home realm first."
"Are you going to stop him?"

"I must take action to prevent Xereth from destroying my home realm, as it will significantly impact my future." Zhang Fei glanced at Serpentera and Alder before asking Tian Kui. "Can you help me stop him? With my current strength, I am definitely not his opponent, so I need your help."
"Help him, Old Kui." Serpentera spoke as he pulled his Qi back from Alder's body. "Kid, help this wolf to save his family, and you can use those demons to increase your demon rank."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "I have no problem with that, but I would rather not waste too much time. Therefore, I hope you can take us there, and I will deal with them as soon as possible."
"Let's go then." Serpentera immediately stood up, grabbed Zhang Fei and Alder by the shoulders, and led the two of them to leave the Starry Sky Realm.
On the other hand, Tian Kui went after Xereth.
[Ding.]
[The system has already recorded the Blackthorn Abyss Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Blackthorn Abyss Realm.]
"You two can sort them out yourselves." Serpentera instantly disappeared from their sight.
Zhang Fei then asked Alder. "Do you know where your family is imprisoned?"

"Over there." Alder pointed toward the black tower, located far to the north of them. "The demon emperor of this realm and his subordinates live there, and they imprison my family in the lowest dungeon of that tower."
"The lowest dungeon?"
Alder nodded at him. "There are a total of ten dungeons below, and the bottom one is a special dungeon to lock up powerful demons, including the former demon emperor."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei turned to Alder with surprise. "What actually happened? Why did the current demon emperor imprison his predecessor?"

"The predecessor was too evil, and he was a tyrant who did not hesitate to sacrifice anyone for his ambition." Alder's answer did not surprise Zhang Fei, especially since he had met many of those with similar characters, such as Zhou Xiaochuan. "Back then, the current demon emperor was his confidant, but he and the others rebelled and overthrew him, especially after he killed several of their families."
"Tell me about the tower."

"The current demon emperor lives on the top floor, and all his confidants live on each floor below him. However, we cannot enter the tower directly because there is a strong barrier there, so we have to find another way to get in there." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding to Alder. "There used to be a secret passage, but they destroyed it after they found me sneaking in through it."
"Is there a city in the tower area?"
"The Blackthorn Imperial City."
Zhang Fei transformed into his lust demon lord form, grabbed Alder's shoulder, and used his body modification ability on him, preventing the demons from recognizing him. "Let's go there."

Meanwhile, Xereth had just arrived in the previous realm; he was furious when he couldn't find Alder there.
In the end, he killed his subordinate, who was still unconscious.
Xereth tried to detect the aura of Serpentera and Tian Kui, but the two ancient beasts were simply too powerful and experienced for him, making him unable to find anything there.
"Could it be that those two powerful beasts saved that wolf?
Tch!
If he was in their hands, I couldn't catch him now." Xereth then looked into the distance.
"The Abyssal Realm should not be far from this realm, but I can't break their barrier with my full strength, so I won't be able to destroy it with my strength not fully recovered.
The only thing I can do now is go to the planet in the lower realm or the Wasteland Realm, but the Abyssal Demon Heart still hasn't appeared, so there's no point in me going to that realm."
Xereth then left the realm at full speed, and his destination was none other than the Diyu Realm, especially since the ten demon lord seeds were supposed to be there.
Unfortunately, he did not know that the ten seeds already had their masters, who were Zhang Fei and several of his women.
After he spent time with his official and unofficial women for two days, Zhang Fei decided to stop dual cultivating with them and left them to rest.
When Zhang Fei came out of the room, he saw Ming Yanyu, Wang Zhuxian, and Ning Zhuan'er chatting happily in the garden.
Despite their familiarity with the pavilion's inhabitants, the three of them did not adopt their naked lifestyle.
Not far from the three young women, Zhang Fei saw Jiang Tingxi was painting the Zhou imperial palace, so he did not disturb them and let her vent her longing.
As usual, Tantai Lingyan locked herself in her room, and she had hardly stopped cultivating since he brought her to the pavilion the first time.
Zhang Fei then went to Xian Changyue's room, but he found her sleeping soundly on her bed.
In the past year, based on the flow of time in the pavilion, he had repeatedly tried to convince her to become his woman, but she remained firm in her determination not to marry.
Xian Xianqin repeatedly urged Zhang Fei to use his demon abilities on Xian Changyue, but he never did, and he wanted her to accept him of her own free will.
Zhang Fei did not wake Xian Changyue, left her room again, and entered the Sealed World Pearl.
Zhang Fei stood in front of the barrier of one of the five sealed areas, and he could hear the sound of the beasts more clearly from within.
Unfortunately, despite his cultivation having reached the Quasi Divine Realm, the barrier remained closed, which left him feeling confused.
[Master, I think the barrier will only open after you break through to the Seven Divine Realms.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei gave a light nod before sitting cross-legged, and he tried the time acceleration feature using all his soul power.
To his surprise, he sensed a significant change within the pearl, and his soul power was not drained as quickly as before.
"Hmm?
How much time did I manage to speed up, Mei?"
[The time flow is two times faster than the outside world, and your soul power remains at 90%, Master.]
Zhang Fei was surprised again, especially since it made the flow of time in the pearl equivalent to that in the training space.
He then tried to increase the speed again, continuing until his soul power became depleted, which made him feel dizzy.
[Four times faster than the outside world in total, Master.]
"Four times faster, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered with a delighted smile.
"The difference between Heavenly Soul and Ancestral Soul is too stark, Mei.
Back then, I could only speed it up by a few hours, but I was already able to speed it up that much.
If I reach the perfection stage, I might be able to speed it up even further.
Unfortunately, achieving it is not easy, so I need to put in more effort."
[Rather than thinking about that, I think you should go hunt demons and absorb their demon essence, Master.
You only need about 180 million more demon essence, and you will evolve into a transcendent lust demon.]
Zhang Fei nodded at her, and he immediately left the Sealed World Pearl before leaving the training space.
[Daily Quest: Killing 5000 beasts or demon beasts at the Quasi Divine Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 500,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 500 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 500,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 500 purple jewels.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei was surprised when he arrived at the Starry Sky Realm, especially when he saw Serpentera helping Alder recover from his injuries.
He immediately approached them.
"What happened to him?"
"Six months ago, he tried to save his family, but he was ganged up on by demons from the Blackthorn Abyss Realm and one of Xereth's subordinates." Zhang Fei frowned after Tian Kui said that.
"That demon almost managed to capture him before, but we saved him and brought him here.
By the way, that demon is on his way to the middle realms, but we don't know his destination yet."
Zhang Fei's expression turned serious after hearing that.

"I'm sure Xereth's destination is either the Wasteland Realm or my home realm, but I'm sure he won't go to the Wasteland Realm because the Abyssal Demon Heart hasn't appeared yet, so I'm sure he'll target my home realm first."
"Are you going to stop him?"
"I must take action to prevent Xereth from destroying my home realm, as it will significantly impact my future." Zhang Fei glanced at Serpentera and Alder before asking Tian Kui.
"Can you help me stop him?
With my current strength, I am definitely not his opponent, so I need your help."
"Help him, Old Kui." Serpentera spoke as he pulled his Qi back from Alder's body.
"Kid, help this wolf to save his family, and you can use those demons to increase your demon rank."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement.
"I have no problem with that, but I would rather not waste too much time.
Therefore, I hope you can take us there, and I will deal with them as soon as possible."
"Let's go then." Serpentera immediately stood up, grabbed Zhang Fei and Alder by the shoulders, and led the two of them to leave the Starry Sky Realm.
On the other hand, Tian Kui went after Xereth.
[Ding.]
[The system has already recorded the Blackthorn Abyss Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Blackthorn Abyss Realm.]
"You two can sort them out yourselves." Serpentera instantly disappeared from their sight.
Zhang Fei then asked Alder.
"Do you know where your family is imprisoned?"
"Over there." Alder pointed toward the black tower, located far to the north of them.
"The demon emperor of this realm and his subordinates live there, and they imprison my family in the lowest dungeon of that tower."
"The lowest dungeon?"
Alder nodded at him.
"There are a total of ten dungeons below, and the bottom one is a special dungeon to lock up powerful demons, including the former demon emperor."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei turned to Alder with surprise.
"What actually happened?
Why did the current demon emperor imprison his predecessor?"

"The predecessor was too evil, and he was a tyrant who did not hesitate to sacrifice anyone for his ambition." Alder's answer did not surprise Zhang Fei, especially since he had met many of those with similar characters, such as Zhou Xiaochuan.
"Back then, the current demon emperor was his confidant, but he and the others rebelled and overthrew him, especially after he killed several of their families."
"Tell me about the tower."
"The current demon emperor lives on the top floor, and all his confidants live on each floor below him.
However, we cannot enter the tower directly because there is a strong barrier there, so we have to find another way to get in there." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding to Alder.
"There used to be a secret passage, but they destroyed it after they found me sneaking in through it."
"Is there a city in the tower area?"
"The Blackthorn Imperial City."
Zhang Fei transformed into his lust demon lord form, grabbed Alder's shoulder, and used his body modification ability on him, preventing the demons from recognizing him.
"Let's go there."

chapters.title: Chapter 937: Emperor Rank
paragraphs: Zhang Fei and Alder had already entered the Blackthorn Imperial City, but the city was much more gloomy than Lust City in the Netherworld Realm, and the lighting was sparse.

Alder was really surprised because Zhang Fei could transform him into another demon, and his usual aura could not be sensed by anyone, making the city gate guards unaware of his arrival. "Do all lust demons have abilities like yours?"

"I don't think so." Zhang Fei answered as he watched the demons passing by in the dim streets of the city. "Actually, I still have many other demon abilities, and many of them belong to other demons, such as my demon mimicry ability. Ordinary lust demons do not have the ability to mimic the abilities of other demons, and I am the only one who can do it."
"How did you turn me into another demon?"

Zhang Fei turned to Alder. "In fact, lust demons are genderless demons, and we can modify our bodies as we please. The use of our abilities is not limited to ourselves, and we can use it on others, just like I did to you."
"Oh." Alder nodded slightly. "Are we going straight into the tower?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei looked at the tower in the middle of the city. "My demon rank has almost reached the emperor rank, so I don't want to waste time, and we will attack them straight away."
"All right."
"Unfortunately, the demon emperor and several other demons aren't there right now, so we can't take care of them all at once."

Soon, they arrived in front of the tower, but several demon guards immediately stopped them. Since Zhang Fei had already made up his mind, he quickly attacked them and crippled their cultivation before using his demon-absorbing and devourer abilities on them, killing them by absorbing their demon essence.
Zhang Fei's actions caused a big commotion in the city, and hundreds of demon guards quickly surrounded him and Alder. He immediately activated the soul link, causing his aura to explode.

Wasting no time, Zhang Fei crippled and absorbed the demon essence of the demon guards. Their painful screams made the situation in the city even more chaotic as the demons living there fled in droves.
Alder took a deep breath watching Zhang Fei's abomination, especially since he didn't care whether the demon guards were innocent or not.
Three powerful auras suddenly shot towards them, and Alder immediately told Zhang Fei the identities of the three.
"Who the hell are you? Why did you suddenly attack us?" One of them possesses a physique akin to an ox, filled with muscles, and carries a large club.
The other demon with a panther-like body warned his friend. 'Don't rush to attack him, Niu! This guy is much stronger than anyone, including our emperor.'
On the other hand, the third demon with a bone body immediately contacted their friend and demon emperor, who was in another city, informing them about Zhang Fei.

After they received the message, the demon emperor and his other subordinates hurriedly returned to the Blackthorn Imperial City. Zhang Fei's actions shocked them, especially since no other demon had ever dared to attack them before, except for Xereth and his subordinates.
"Have you contacted your emperor and the others?" The bone demon looked at Zhang Fei with a frown. "You did the right thing, so I don't have to wait for them too long."
"Gahhh!" The three demons groaned in pain before falling to the ground, and their cultivation quickly disappeared.

Zhang Fei, who was already standing behind them, immediately touched them with his three tails. He wasted no time in absorbing their demon essence, causing them to scream in agony, frightening the remaining demons in the city and the tower.
In just a few minutes, only the skin and skeleton of the three demons remained, and Zhang Fei obtained sixty million demon essences from them
"Let's go in." Zhang Fei immediately walked towards the tower.
Alder was completely speechless by Zhang Fei's actions. He looked at the remains of the three demons and those demon guards, sighed heavily, and followed him.
When they arrived inside the tower, Zhang Fei and Alder did not see any other demons on the floor because the deaths of the three previous demons frightened them, and they chose to hide from them.

Zhang Fei casually walked towards the stairs leading down to the first dungeon, and Alder followed behind him. In that area, they saw many demons imprisoned there, but they were only weak demons, so they didn't pay attention to them.
Without the slightest hesitation, Zhang Fei killed all the demon guards blocking their way, and he hurriedly led Alder down to the lowest floor.
Sometime later, they arrived at the bottom floor, and Alder hurriedly went to one of the prisons, where his wife was being held.

Zhang Fei followed behind Alder while checking the demon prisoners there, but his attention was more focused on one male demon whose hands and feet were nailed to the wall, and even his body was chained by large chains.
Zhang Fei could immediately guess that the male demon was the former demon emperor of the Blackthorn Abyss Realm, and his cultivation had been crippled by the current demon emperor.
*Bam*
Alder destroyed the prison door, and he rushed inside to check on the female demon with white hair, who was none other than his wife, Lang Taiyin. "Wife! Wake up! It's me, Alder."
However, Lang Taiyin did not give any response to Alder, making the wolf king worried and panicked.
"Let's free her first."
*Clang... Clang...*
Zhang Fei's attack immediately destroyed the chains binding Lang Taiyin, and he opened a portal to the training space. "Bring her in, and Tasha will meet you there."
"Thank you." Alder immediately picked up his wife and took her to enter the portal.
After he closed the portal, Zhang Fei went to the previous demon emperor's prison and destroyed the door, waking him up. "Who are you?"
"My identity is not relevant."
"Hmm?" The previous demon emperor looked at the demon extermination sword in Zhang Fei's hand. "Please kill me."
"Are you sure?"
"Yeah."
Zhang Fei immediately pressed his palm on the male demon's chest. "I'm not a good person, and I can't give you an easy death."
"Haha." The previous demon emperor laughed weakly. "I've been locked up in this place for tens of thousands of years, and my successor has repeatedly tortured me, so pain is my good friend."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and began to absorb the previous demon emperor's demon essence, and his groans of pain echoed in the area.
In less than half an hour, the previous demon emperor's groan had stopped sounding, and his body had dried up completely.
[You gained 35,000,000 demon essences from Vagas.]
[Eighty-five million more demon essences, and you will reach the emperor rank, Master.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly and left the room, causing the imprisoned demons to tremble in fear at the thought that he would do the same to them. However, he ignored them and hurried back up.
When he came out of the underground, Zhang Fei still had not seen the current demon emperor and his subordinates, and he went straight to the top floor of the tower.
There, Zhang Fei found many valuable demon resources, and he immediately robbed them all. After he cleaned up the place, he summoned Feng Yichen out to accompany him.
"You have changed."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow at Feng Yichen. "What do you mean?"
Feng Yichen pointed to his chest. "Your cursed demon heart is affecting you more and more, or else you wouldn't kill those demons so easily."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly, as he had already realized it himself. He would usually never kill those who had no problems with him, but he killed those demon guards without the slightest hesitation. "Escaping from Xereth made me realize many things, and I was still too weak to face people of his caliber, let alone those who were much stronger than him. I sometimes felt that my humanity was holding me back, but I also didn't dare throw it away. If I discarded my humanity, I would become pure evil because of the influence of my cursed demon heart, which would cause others to suffer."
"Yeah." Feng Yichen then looked out the window. "Do you want me to take care of them? They're almost here."
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Cripple them and bring them to me."
"All right." Feng Yichen disappeared instantly.
With her peak strength, it was too easy for Feng Yichen to capture the current demon emperor and his subordinates, and she crippled their cultivation according to Zhang Fei's orders.
Feng Yichen then brought them to the tower and threw them to the floor. "You can do it now."
The current demon emperor and his subordinates displayed ashen faces. They never thought a woman would cause their demise, but they knew Feng Yichen was stronger than all of them.

"Honestly, I don't have a problem with you guys, but you have a problem with Alder." They were shocked to hear that name from Zhang Fei's mouth. "Back then, I had no relationship with him, but his daughter had lived with me for several years. Since you locked up her mother for hundreds of years, I had to help her take revenge on you guys."
Zhang Fei immediately moved next to them, coiled his tails around their bodies, and absorbed their demon essence directly.
"Arghh!"
"Gahh!"

Feng Yichen, who witnessed that, could only sigh in his heart. Even though she herself was considered evil, Zhang Fei was much more evil than her, and she felt that he would become even more evil in the future, which was because of his cursed demon heart. 'Is he really going to be the peacemaker? Or will he become the destroyer of this universe?'
[You gained 150,000,000 demon essences.]
[Congratulations! The host's demon rank has been upgraded to the Emperor Rank.]

As soon as the second notification appeared, Zhang Fei's body was immediately enveloped by an unusual aura. During his transformation into the lust demon lord, his body was enveloped by a jet-black aura, but now, a bloody red aura quickly enveloped his body. He immediately released the corpses of the demons and brought Feng Yichen back into the pavilion, where he and his clones began the process of transforming into the transcendent lust demon.

Serpentera, who witnessed all of Zhang Fei's previous actions, was truly satisfied with that. "I hope he can continue like that, and if necessary, he should act even more viciously than that. If he is weak, he will become prey for the powerful hunters in the Paradise Realm, and he will not be able to do anything to protect the people around him."

Inside the pavilion, Zhang Fei and his five clones were already wrapped in a bloody red cocoon, and their aura slowly became more and more terrifying. Even though Liu Qingyu and the others knew that their husband would never harm them, his aura still frightened the women living in it.
Liu Hua immediately asked those who felt oppressed by the aura of Zhang Fei and his clones to leave the pavilion, such as Ming Yanyu, Wu Lianzhi, Wang Zhuxian, Ning Zhuan'er, and several other women.
"I'll check on Tasha's mother first." Liu Qingyu said this as she walked away, but Ru Xue, Hu Yue, and Hu Lili immediately followed her.
Zhang Yue stood pensively beside Zhang Fei's bloody red cocoon, thinking about the changes in her little brother once he transformed into a transcendent lust demon.
"What are you thinking, Yue'er?" Qing Yi asked her first daughter.

Zhang Yue shook her head slightly. "I'm just worried about Fei'er's changes, Mom. He became too lustful after he evolved into a lust demon lord, and he will evolve into a transcendent lust demon soon, which makes me think that he will become even more lustful."

"You're not wrong about that." Zhang Yue and the others turned to Orith and Ilsath, who immediately pressed their palms against the cocoon. "The transcendent lust demon is the most lustful of all lust demons, but not all lust demons can evolve into one. Even Ilsath and I can't necessarily become one, but we can only find out after we reach the emperor rank."
"How many transcendent lust demons were in the Netherworld Realm back then?" Ye Lian asked.

"One." Ilsath's answer surprised all of them. "As Orith said just now, not all lust demons can become transcendent. According to history, there is only one lust demon that has ever evolved into a transcendent one in the Netherworld Realm, and it happened hundreds of thousands of years ago. Since then, there have been no more lust demons that have successfully evolved into one, including our ancestors."
"What about lust demons in other demon realms?"

The two succubi shook their heads at Zhong Yan. "As you know, we were not demon cultivators in the past, and we have never left our territory, so we have no information about the lust demons from other territories. Some may have evolved into transcendent ones, but I doubt there are many."
"As for Zhang Fei's change, we don't need to guess, and we just need to wait for the process to complete." They agreed with Ilsath and waited for the outcome together.

In one of the rooms in the portable mansion, Liu Qingyu and the others checked on Lang Taiyin's condition to find out the reason behind his unconsciousness. Unfortunately, they couldn't find anything strange in his body, including the elf, Elmyra.
"What about my mother?" Tasha asked with her hands clasped together.

Elmyra turned and shook her head at Tasha. "We couldn't find anything strange about your mother, so we don't have a solution to wake her up. Zhang Fei should have a way to wake her up, but she is in the process of evolving into a transcendent lust demon; thus, we can only wait for him to finish first."
"Yes." Tasha then asked her father. "Why don't you bring the others back with you, Father?"

Alder released a heavy sigh and grabbed her shoulder. "They killed the others a long time ago, and they left your mother alive just to lure us back. I know you're sad about their deaths, but they've gotten their revenge now because Zhang Fei has killed those demons."

"Yeah." Tasha then walked to the side of the bed, lay down there, and hugged her mother. Tears quickly flowed from his golden eyes. "I missed you so much, Mother. I was just a little girl when my father took me away from our home realm, but I'm over a thousand years old now."
Elmyra, Liu Qingyu, and the other women immediately left the room, leaving Tasha to vent her longing for Lang Taiyin.

Alder immediately approached them, sat down beside his daughter, and stroked Tasha and Lang Taiyin's heads. "I know you miss your mother, and the two of you will meet again after Zhang Fei wakes her up."
"Yes, Father."

In a distant area, Xereth, who was flying towards the middle realms, was forced to stop when he felt something suddenly envelop him. He frowned when he felt his power being rapidly absorbed; he immediately took out his black scythe and launched several attacks in several directions, but his attacks were instantly absorbed by it. "What the hell is this? Where did this come from?"
Just as Xereth was thinking that, hundreds of small beasts appeared and surrounded him, and they immediately attacked him.

"Fuck!" Xereth launched an immediate attack on them, but they swiftly absorbed his Qi attacks, compelling him to resort to physical attacks. However, his strength continued to decline on its own, and those small beasts also absorbed it, leaving him quickly overwhelmed. "Shit! I can't go on like this, or my strength will disappear completely."

Xereth was shocked by the sudden appearance of a giant mouth, and he tried to run away from it, but it was faster and swallowed him instantly. The mouth disappeared immediately, as did the small beasts, and Tian Kui appeared there. "Hehe! I only need to absorb all his power, and I will send him to another realm after he is completely weakened."

Alder smiled in relief seeing both of them, and he lay down beside his wife, hugging her and listening to their daughter tell her story.
At their place of seclusion, Long Jiuxiao and the others had already fully recovered from the injuries that Zhang Fei had given them a year and a half ago.
"What about your golden fox clan?"

Huli Jinhu shook his head at Wang Yitao. "I don't know what that little bastard did in my realm, but many of my loyal followers have switched their support to my wife, and many of them were captured by her loyal followers, making my influence in my clan at least now."
"What about your clan in the Sky Dragon Realm?"

Huli Jinju released a heavy sigh at Dai Yishu's question. "Shouldn't you already know the answer? That little bastard has taken over that realm completely, and your three clans in that realm are his subordinates now."

"Yes." Dai Yishu nodded gloomily. "Dai Hubai's disappearance made my main clan quite chaotic, but there was still Dai Yanxu and the others to calm the situation. However, Dai Baihu had already cut ties with my main clan, and the main cause was that little bastard."

"The situation in my Black Tortoise clan was the same." Wang Yitao sighed heavily. "After that little bastard defeated us and Wang Wugui, he took over my branch clan in that realm and forced Wang Guzhe to sever ties with my main clan. I had ordered Wang Xiaoling and the others to take care of them, but they did not move at all and let our branch clan fall into his hands."

They then turned to Long Jiuxiao, who shook his head at them. "My main dragon clan hasn't made a move yet, but they will move after I come out. Since we've recovered, and Xereth hasn't shown any movement either, I think it's time for us to take care of that little bastard first. Back then, he was able to defeat our avatars because we couldn't use our full power, but we can use it now, so I'm confident in destroying him."
"I agree!" Dai Yishu immediately stood up. "So, where should we look for that bastard? Should we go to the Sky Dragon Island?"

"I think so." Wang Yitao also stood up from his seat. "That little bastard hasn't returned to this realm since Xereth summoned Taotie's avatar in the Starry Sky Realm, but he has repeatedly shown activity in that realm, so we have to go there now."

"Wait a minute." Long Jiuxiao and the other two turned to Huli Jinhu. "The Hong, Yan, and Wang Clans are that little bastard's accomplices. Besides them, there are several others with Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji now, so I think it would be better if we captured them first. The Nameless One is powerful, but he won't be able to fight all of us at once, especially since his contract beast isn't with him now. However, we should call our people to come to this realm, and we will move once they arrive."
Long Jiuxiao, Wang Yitao, and Dai Yishu exchanged glances for a moment before agreeing to Huli Jinhu's idea. "Let's contact our people, and we'll capture all his accomplices as soon as they arrive."
"Yeah." They immediately contacted their clan members from the Dragon, Black Tortoise, White Tiger, and Golden Fox clans.

Since Huli Zhishen has sided with Zhang Fei, Huli Jinhu can only summon the remaining members of his clan. Meanwhile, Long Jiuxiao, Wang Yitao, and Dai Yishu asked the members of their clans and the remaining ancestors to come to that realm as soon as possible.

"I will use these devices to connect the planets in the middle and upper realms to this realm, and I will connect the planets in the lower realms to the Nine Stars Realm so I can more easily take care of everything."
Feng Xishui immediately accepted the storage ring.
"Are you going with me?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him.
"My soul and body cultivations are still far from breaking through; my alchemy and blacksmithing are good now.

"Hmm?
It has been two years since I last saw you, and your cultivation has now reached the Quasi Divine Realm.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that.
"There have been many things I have gone through in the past two years, and I have spent almost all of my time in seclusion.
Therefore, you don't need to be surprised that my cultivation has reached this stage."
Feng Jinqiu nodded in understanding.
"However, it is impossible for you to reach this stage through ordinary means, and you must have used outside help to assist you."
"You're right." Zhang Fei [5] showed one true foundation pill to Feng Jinqiu.

By the way, this realm is completely safe now, so it's time for you to return to the Phoenix Realm.
However, you should not go back there immediately, and I will send you to my private training ground."
"Hmm?" Feng Jinqiu momentarily raised an eyebrow before nodding in agreement.
"You are the leader of our Phoenix Clan now, so I will follow your orders."

You should go back to the sect and take care of some things first, and I will send you there afterward.

chapters.title: Chapter 941: Mythical Deer Bloodline
paragraphs: A month passed quickly in the training space, which was equivalent to two weeks in the outside world.

In the Xianjin Realm, Zhe Wuming opened his eyes as soon as he sensed many auras entering it. He raised an eyebrow once he discovered the people from the Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Golden Fox Clans. "Why did they summon their men to this realm? Are they thinking of doing something against Zhang Fei's people in this realm? Those arrogant beasts are truly morons, and they want to commit suicide by doing that. They already know Zhang Fei's abilities, and their descendants have already fallen into his hands, but they would rather not realize their mistake and force themselves to fight him."

After he found the location of Zhang Fei's people, Zhe Wuming immediately slashed the air a few times, leaving several holes. He then sucked all those people into him through those holes before closing them, shocking all of them.
"Did you bring us here because of those people?" Wang Zhemin immediately asked.
"That's right." Zhe Wuming nodded in response. "Those beast clans are obviously targeting all of you because you are Zhang Fei's closest people, so I brought you all here."
Yan Lebao released a heavy sigh. "Why do those beasts place so much importance on their pride? Zhang Fei obviously didn't want to have trouble with them, but they repeatedly sought trouble with him."
"Actually, you didn't need to bring us here, especially since they would never be able to capture us." Yan Dashan said confidently.

Hong Chong nodded in agreement with his brother-in-law. "We have trained really hard in Zhang Fei's training space, and we have perfectly adapted to our training and exceeded our old limits. If they want to do something to us, we will fight them back."

"You two are too confident." Yan Dashan and Hong Chong turned to Hong Quan. "We have indeed surpassed our old limits, but we are not Zhang Fei. We are ordinary humans, and we lack the advantages that he had over the beasts, making it impossible for us to fight Huli Jinhu and the other ancestors of those mythical beasts."
"My husband is right." Cai Yinzhi spoke with a nod. "Our speed may have surpassed theirs, but they are still stronger than us. If we fight them head-on, we will be the losers."

Yan Yizhen, Gong Yulei, Duan Zhao, and the others nodded in agreement with Cai Yinzhi. They knew Zhang Fei was weaker than those mythical beasts, but he did not rely solely on his speed to fight those stronger than him, and he had too many advantages that no one else had.
"So what should we do now?" Ji Changlan asked the Nameless One.
Gong Ren then spoke. "They will realize that you brought us here, and they will attack us soon."
"Why would you think that?" Cheng Gaoji asked his friend. "Even if they attack here, they still won't be able to enter this place, so their coming here will be in vain."
Tap... Tap...
They turned to Tian Shuixiang and You Shen, who had just arrived with a few others.
"I expected you to bring them here directly." The Poison God, You Shen, spoke before observing Duan Zhao and his three disciples.

Tian Shuixiang then asked. "Are we going to fight them? Xereth continues to pose a threat, making this situation unfavorable for us. If that kid knows they attacked his people, he will most likely kill them."

"No." Zhe Wuming denied the Alchemy God while shaking his head. "Zhang Fei is not stupid, so I believe he would not kill them. Otherwise, he would have killed Long Qiang and the others, but he did not, and he only enslaved them."
"Where is Zhang Fei now? I haven't seen him since we arrived in this realm." Du Yuanjia asked.
Duan Zhao answered him directly. "Zhang Fei is still in seclusion, and we don't know when he will come out. He—"
"I'm here." They turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just walked out of the portal. Feng Yichen, Hong Xinxin, and Huli Zhizhen followed behind him.

"Hong Xinxin?" Zhe Wuming, Tian Shuixiang, You Shen, Gong Ren, Ji Changlan, and Du Yuanjia were shocked after they detected her cultivation. "How could your cultivation possibly reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm so quickly?"

"Hehe." Hong Xinxin giggled and patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "We discovered something interesting in the Raging Thunder Realm, and my husband helped me to fuse with it, allowing my cultivation to reach this stage straight away."
"What did you find there?" Du Yuanjia asked with curiosity.

Hong Xinxin answered them by transforming into her half-beast form, shocking them further. "Currently, I am no longer an ordinary human, but I am a mythical beast, the Azure Emperor Roc. We found the beast's corpse intact, and we also met its soul. My husband turned me into the beast, and its soul passed on all its powers to me."
Hearing that, they all turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] with silly and shocked looks, especially since there had never been a human turned into a beast before.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled casually at them and asked Hong Xinxin to return to her human form. "Naturally, I have my own way of doing it, and I've done it to several of my other women."
"Do you know the situation in this realm?" Zhe Wuming asked him.

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked into the distance with a smirk. "I have two acquaintances who are much stronger than Xereth. They helped me monitor the movements of all my enemies while I was in seclusion, and they told me about them two weeks ago, so I came here now."
"Are you going to kill them?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Tian Shuixiang. "I want to kill them, but Xereth is in the three mortal realms now. Since we still need them as sacrifices, I won't kill them today, and I will enslave them like their descendants."
Tian Shuixiang nodded in understanding and glanced at Huli Zhishen, and he immediately noticed that she had become Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s woman.
"Most of my Golden Fox Clan members have joined Zhang Fei, and only a few of them still side with Huli Jinhu." They only nodded at Huli Zhishen.

Soon, several people entered the room. They were a group from the Vermilion, Nu, and Fu clans. They were not surprised to see Feng Yichen and Huli Zhishen behind Zhang Xiaolong [3], but they were surprised by Hong Xinxin's presence, especially her cultivation, which had already surpassed them. 'This guy! He has three powerful beasts by his side now.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] glanced at them before moving in front of Fu Xin, the matriarch of the mythical white deer, startling her and almost causing her to fall backwards.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed Fu Xin's hand. "Forgive me for startling you, but I have a proposition for you."

Zhe Wuming and the others facepalmed as they thought that Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted Fu Xin as his woman, especially since he already had numerous women. Even a woman of Huli Zhishen's caliber had also fallen for him.
Fu Xin raised her eyebrows as she had heard a lot about Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she pulled her hand back before asking him. "What kind of proposition do you have for me?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out two beauty pills, showed them to Fu Xin, and informed her. "Not even Senior Shuixiang and Senior Jingxia can match these pills, and they will change your appearance completely. You will regain your youth, and you will never age again afterward. Usually, I wouldn't give them to outsiders, but I need something important from you, and I think these two pills are the perfect price for that."
"Do the effects of the two pills really work as you say?" Zhu Hong asked in disbelief.

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled. "If you don't believe me, you can ask Feng Yichen, Hong Xinxin, and Huli Zhishen. The three of them have swallowed both of them, as have all my other women, including Zhu Lingyao."

Zhu Lingyao and the others immediately looked at the three women. They had never met Feng Yichen before, so they couldn't distinguish her beauty. However, they had met Hong Xinxin and Huli Zhishen several times, so they could distinguish their beauty.
"What do you want from me?" Fu Xin asked as she was tempted by the effects of the two pills.

"Ten drops of your mythical deer origin bloodline." Fu Xin frowned in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he immediately showed his light element to her. "I need a beast bloodline with a light element, and I think your bloodline is my best choice. So, I'll give you both pills for ten drops of your bloodline, and it shouldn't be a loss for you, right? If you're unsure of their effects, swallow them first; I guarantee you won't regret it."
"Is that okay?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered by placing the two pills in Fu Xin's hands, and she hurriedly swallowed them because Zhu Hong and the others were staring at them intensely.
In the past, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not dare to take out the two pills carelessly, but he was no longer afraid because he had become stronger, and there were many strong people by his side.

After a while, Fu Xin finished her transformation and removed the black liquid from her body, leaving both men and women stunned. She immediately took a mirror to see her new appearance, stunning her.
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled at her expression. "The effects of my two pills are worth ten drops of your bloodline origin, right?"

Fu Xin stretched out her palm forward, and a wisp of blood came out from her index finger. Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took the bottle and put her blood into it, making him smile happily. "Thank you for your origin bloodline, Senior."

"No need." Fu Xin replied with a shake of her head. "Your two pills are extraordinary, and their effects will last a lifetime. My origin bloodline is indeed precious, but it will recover on its own, so I think we are even."

"Is that okay?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered by placing the two pills in Fu Xin's hands, and she hurriedly swallowed them because Zhu Hong and the others were staring at them intensely.
In the past, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not dare to take out the two pills carelessly, but he was no longer afraid because he had become stronger, and there were many strong people by his side.
After a while, Fu Xin finished her transformation and removed the black liquid from her body, leaving both men and women stunned.
She immediately took a mirror to see her new appearance, stunning her.
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled at her expression.
"The effects of my two pills are worth ten drops of your bloodline origin, right?"
Fu Xin stretched out her palm forward, and a wisp of blood came out from her index finger.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took the bottle and put her blood into it, making him smile happily.
"Thank you for your origin bloodline, Senior."
"No need." Fu Xin replied with a shake of her head.
"Your two pills are extraordinary, and their effects will last a lifetime.
My origin bloodline is indeed precious, but it will recover on its own, so I think we are even."

chapters.title: Chapter 942: Battle Of Xianjin I
paragraphs: "Hey! Please give us your pills too, Zhang Fei."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Zhu Hong. "My pills are not for sale or given away for free, and you must exchange them for something appropriate for both. As for your vermilion origin bloodline, I have already obtained it from Zhu Lingyao, so I don't need it anymore."

Zhu Hong fell into deep thought, thinking about what she could give to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in return for the two pills. She sighed heavily because she could not think of anything appropriate to exchange for the two pills, but then Hong Xinxin suddenly spoke to her. "Matriarch Hong, be his woman, and you will get both pills."
"No." Zhu Hong immediately rejected Hong Xinxin's idea. "I would rather not get both pills than become his woman."
"Haha." Hong Xinxin laughed at that, but she didn't say anything more.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] only smiled at Zhu Hong's answer, but he was a transcendent lust demon, and he wanted her. Despite this, he didn't immediately do anything about her, but instead, he opened the map and observed those mythical beasts. "They've already left their place, and I'm sure they'll be here soon."
"Are you going to move now, brother?" Du Yuanjia asked him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to him. "I'm not going to waste my time on this matter, so I'll take care of them now and go back into seclusion again."

"Hey! You crazy kid! How is it possible that your cultivation has reached the Quasi Divine Realm?" Ji Changlan's question made the others aware of the situation, prompting them to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3] seriously.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shrugged and took out the true foundation pill. "I had a lot of this pill before, and I have dozens of women with me, so it's normal for my cultivation to be this fast, right?"
"What pill is that?" Gong Ren asked Tian Shuixiang.

"The true foundation pill, and it can stabilize his foundation directly. Therefore, he doesn't need to waste time on it, and he can directly break through to the next stage." Tian Shuixiang paused for a few moments. "However, concocting the pill took six months, so I don't know how he could have so many of them."
"Kid, you—"
"Let's stop our conversation; they've already started moving." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately turned to leave, followed by Feng Yichen, Hong Xinxin, and Huli Zhishen.
Zhe Wuming and the others wasted no time, and they hurriedly followed Zhang Xiaolong [3], except for Duan Zhao and his three disciples.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others were already standing in the sky above Zhe Wuming's residence, but they did not immediately move; instead, they observed the mythical beasts scattering toward Gong Ren's residence, the Wang Clan, and several other locations.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at that. "They are mythical beasts, but their behavior is truly disgraceful and in stark contrast to their arrogance. Their enemy is me, but they want to involve the people closest to me."
"Let me make a move now, Master."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] dismissed Feng Yichen with a shake of his head. "Let them gather first, and we'll deal with them all at once."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Zhu Hong and the other mythical beasts involuntarily flew backward as Serpentera and Tian Kui appeared in front of them. 'These two beasts are far stronger than all of our strengths combined.'
Although they were not mythical beasts, Gong Ren and the others also realized that Serpentera and Tian Kui's strength was far beyond their level.
Ji Changlan, who had met Xereth about a year and a half ago, could feel that the two beasts were much stronger than the demon. 'These two are probably as strong as Taotie.'

Since they came from the Paradise Realm, Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye immediately guessed that Serpentera and Tian Kui also came from that realm. 'Why do two ancient beasts like them live in the three mortal realms?'
"Hmm?" Tian Kui looked at Tian Shuixiang. "I see, you're hiding your true form on purpose, huh?"

Tian Shuixiang froze after hearing that, and he stole a glance at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who shook his head at him. Zhe Wuming and the others looked at the alchemy god, and his reaction made them suspicious of him.

"Old Kui, you should not stick your nose in someone else's business, and this kid must have a reason for hiding his true identity." Serpentera then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Are you sure you can face those mythical beasts?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded. "They are strong, and there are many of them, but I am no longer weak. Moreover, my real body and three other clones are not here yet, so I am confident that I can face them."
"In that case, Old Kui and I will watch your battle with them from afar." Serpentera and Tian Kui instantly disappeared from their sight.
"Who are those two beasts?" Zhu Hong asked Zhang Fei.

"Serpentera is the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast, and Tian Kui is the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer made them look anxious. "Hey! They are not evil beasts, and they live in the three mortal realms for a certain reason. In fact, they have the same enemy as us, which is Taotie."
"So, they fled to the three mortal realms because of Taotie?"

"Not really." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Tian Shuixiang. "In the Paradise Realm, Taotie is no different from Xereth, and he is the subordinate of one of the most powerful beasts in this universe."
"Two most powerful beasts?"

"The Primordial Genesis Beast, and the other one is the Primordial Nihility Beast." Zhu Hong and the mythical beasts gasped in shock after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned the two beasts. "Taotie is one of the latter's subordinates, and that beast is targeting Serpentera and Tian Kui. They are the last of their race, so they fled here to hide."
"Master, they have gathered." Feng Yichen spoke, gesturing toward Huli Jinhu and others, who were walking toward the tower with frustrated looks, followed by many of their subordinates.
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the portal to the training space.

Zhang Fei and his three other clones immediately came out from inside, and they then activated the soul link, borrowing all the power from all the beasts inside the beast space. Although Feng Yichen was not inside, the number of beasts inside and their accumulated power were enough to make their cultivation surpass the 5-Divine Ascension Realm.
'This kid's strength is already on par with or even surpasses Xereth!' Zhe Wuming, Gong Ren, and Ji Changlan screamed in their hearts.

'No wonder he is confident to face Huli Jinhu and the others.' Fu Xin, Nu Shen, Zhu Hong, and the others were shocked by the power of Zhang Fei and his four clones. They also felt relieved, especially since they didn't do anything stupid to become his enemies.
"Hehe." Hong Xinxin chuckled. "Husband, I know you are capable of dealing with them all by yourself, but I still want to fight them to test my current abilities."

"They are not your opponents either, but you can have fun with them if you like." Zhang Fei then spoke to Zhe Wuming. "I need you to use your void element to secure this realm, or our fight will cause great damage."
Zhe Wuming nodded at him. "All right, I will do that, and I want to witness your true strength in facing them."
"Sure." Zhang Fei and his four clones immediately looked at Long Jiuxiao and the others. "Black Tortoise and White Tiger, I must obtain their bloodline origin."
Feng Yichen then spoke. "Master, I will help you capture one member from each of the two beast clans, and you can use them to transform two of your wives into beasts according to their races."

"I agree with Yichen, husband." Hong Xinxin spoke with a nod. "Some of the white tigers have metal elements, and you have Shi Xi, who also has that element. The Black Tortoise has a high affinity for water and earth elements, so you can use the beast for one of them."
'These two are as evil as their husband and master!'

Zhang Fei himself had thought about it. "All right, Yichen, you can capture one member from each of the two clans. Don't kill the strongest among them, especially since I still need them as sacrifices to fight Xereth."
"Yes, Master." Feng Yichen immediately disappeared.
"I'll make my move now, husband." Hong Xinxin made several signs using her hands before releasing her lightning Qi.

Zhe Wuming and the others looked up at the higher sky, which was rapidly darkening with countless purple lightning flashes there. 'Is this her beast ability? Why do we feel that it is similar to lightning tribulation?'
Zhang Fei smiled as Hong Xinxin used the technique. "Bringing you into my last lightning tribulation was the right decision, and now you can use this technique."

"Hehe." Hong Xinxin chuckled. "Let's wait for a while, and I will show them the terrifying power of the Ninth Heaven: Eternal Thunder Judgment. By the way, I will take care of their subordinates, and you can take care of their leaders."

"Use your void element now, Senior. Otherwise, Xinxin's attacks will destroy most areas of this realm." After he said that, Zhang Fei and his four clones disappeared from their sight, and Zhe Wuming moved according to his instructions.
The mythical beasts stopped moving as they looked up at the darkening sky. "What the hell is with the sky? Is someone making a breakthrough in this realm?"
"Ahh." They were startled by the screams of two of their men, and they saw Feng Yichen flying away carrying one member each of the White Tiger and Black Tortoise Clans.
"The Dark Phoenix!" Long Jiuxiao and the others shouted in shock. "Get ready! That little bastard is in this realm."

"Hahaha." All of them turned to Zhang Fei and his four clones, who were standing in the air not far from them. "Honestly, I still want to let you all live for some more time, but you guys have made a fatal mistake by targeting the people closest to me. As mythical beasts, your actions are truly a disgrace, and I will teach you all a harsh lesson this time."
