chapters.title: Chapter 943: Battle Of Xianjin II
paragraphs: "You little bastard, I will kill you today!" Dai Yishu furiously shouted.
Zhang Fei smirked at them, but he and his four clones quickly scattered away in five different directions.
"Chase after them!" Dai Yishu immediately flew after Zhang Fei, as did Wang Yitao and Huli Jinhu, who were chasing two of his clones.

"Tianzhu! I'll chase one of the remaining two, and you chase the last one with the others!" After he ordered the female dragon, Long Tianzhu, Long Jiuxiao immediately chased after one of Zhang Fei's clones.

The people from the Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Golden Fox Clans wanted to follow their respective leaders. However, many purple lightnings suddenly descended from the sky and struck some of them, causing them to scream in pain.

They didn't die, especially since Hong Xinxin's technique wasn't perfect yet. Despite this, the group sustained severe injuries and became unable to move, prompting the others to raise their guard and activate their defensive artifacts.

Long Tianzhu and the other two women, who wanted to chase one of Zhang Fei's clones, were shocked when they saw that attack. "This attack is not a lightning tribulation resulting from a breakthrough; rather, it is a technique used by someone. But who is capable of using such a technique?"
"Who do you think is the owner of this technique, Tianzhu?"
"I don't know, Dai Yanxu." Long Tianzhu replied to the female ancestor of the White Tiger Clan with a shake of her head.
The female ancestor of the Black Tortoise Clan spoke immediately. "Whoever owns this technique, his or her strength is on par or even higher than ours."

"You are right, Wang Qingyi. That person deliberately attacked some of our men to warn us." The two women turned to Long Tianzhu, who pointed to the sky. "The technique is still not perfect, and its owner is still brewing a stronger attack. If the technique is complete, our subordinates will die from the attack."

"If I were you guys, I wouldn't move, and I would leave this realm directly." Long Tianzhu and the other two women turned to Huli Zhishen, who had suddenly appeared along with Zhu Danqing and the two female ancestors of the Nian and Fu Clans, Nuan Ying and Fu Yin.
"I didn't expect you to betray your husband, Zhishen." Long Tianzhu spoke in a condescending tone.

Huli Zhishen casually raised both hands. "Whether I betray him or not, I will still leave him. I have warned him not to find trouble with Zhang Fei because it will only harm our race, but he insisted on attacking him because of his arrogance."

"As Zhishen said just now, the three of you should not do anything and leave this realm immediately." Long Tianzhu and the other two frowned at Zhu Danqing, but they knew that the Vermilion Clan was on Zhang Fei's side from the start.
Wang Qingyi then asked the other two. "Did you two also choose to side with that kid, Nuan Ying and Fu Yin?"
"No." Nuan Ying replied with a shake of her head.

Fu Yin then answered her. "My mythical deer clan will not side with anyone, and we only want to seek peace. Moreover, Xereth is still out there, and he could attack us at any time, so I want to stop the fighting between you."
"Why—"

"Choose: live or die." Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu looked at Feng Yichen. She couldn't care less about them and released her full strength directly, pressing all the members of the four clans to the ground. "Our cultivation may be equal, but I am still superior to the three of you. If you choose to fight my master, I will make you suffer."
"Guys, don't—" Zhu Danqing had not finished her words, but Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu had already moved to attack Feng Yichen, causing her and the others to sigh heavily.
"Heh." Feng Yichen snorted slightly and led the three female beasts into the air, where they fought three on one.
"Are we going to stop them?" Nuan Ying asked.

"Too late." Huli Zhishen shook her head in response. "Once the three of them decided to attack Feng Yichen, Zhang Fei already considered them enemies. Even if we stop them now, he still won't spare them, so there's no need for us to waste our energy."

"Hmm?" Fu Yin looked at the four female beasts in the air, and she could clearly see that Feng Yichen had the upper hand, even though Long Tianzhu and the others were ganging up on her. "Can you move as fast as that woman, Zhishen?"

"Yes." Huli Zhishen gave a light nod of approval. "Everyone on Zhang Fei's side has equal speed, especially since we train using the same method. However, some of them can be faster, especially those with wind or lightning elements."

Zhu Danqing, Nuan Ying, and Fu Yin exchanged glances for a moment before letting out soft sighs and watching the four women's fight again. "Feng Yichen can defeat them easily, but she is deliberately toying with them."

"Yeah." Huli Zhishen nodded in agreement before turning his head towards the distance, where Huli Jinhu, who was already using his half-beast form, was fighting with Zhang Fei [1]. 'I have warned you not to fight him, but you are too stubborn and arrogant. Therefore, do not blame others for your stupidity and suffering; you will have to endure the pain of your mistakes for the rest of your life.'
*Bam*
Zhang Fei [1] caught Huli Jinhu's right claw. "Is this the extent of your strength?"
"Bastard!" Huli Jinhu attacked him with his other claw, but Zhang Fei [1] effortlessly grabbed it and broke both of them instantly.
*Crack... Crack...*
"Argh!" Huli Jinhu groaned in pain, but Zhang Fei [1] didn't stop there and quickly kicked both of his knees, breaking them at once.
*Crack... Crack...*
"Argh!" Zhang Fei [1] directly punched Huli Jinhu's chest, sending him rolling in the air several times. "Gah!"
Huli Jinhu immediately stabilized himself by enduring the pain in both his hands and feet, but he still arrogantly stared at Zhang Fei [1], even though he was clearly not his opponent.

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head with a smirk. "If I were still the same as before, I would definitely not be your opponent. However, I have changed significantly over the past two years, and you are no longer my opponent. By the way, I thoroughly enjoyed my time with your wife, and she couldn't stop moaning when she was beneath me."

"You bastard! I will kill you!" Huli Jinhu immediately returned to his complete beast form, a golden fox with nine tails behind him. He then released his full strength and shot a golden Qi from his mouth while exclaiming, "Die!"

"Hahaha!" Huli Jinhu was shocked to hear Zhang Fei [1]'s laughter from above him because he was clearly still in front of him. "Honestly, I want to kill you, but I will do it after I get rid of Xereth."
Huli Jinhu wanted to escape, but Zhang Fei [1] quickly created a black sword Qi and cut off his nine golden tails, causing his blood to gush out and rain down on the ground beneath them. "Arghhhh!"
Zhang Fei [1] then stabbed his sword Qi into Huli Jinhu's back before kicking him extremely hard, causing the male golden fox to hurtle toward the ground before being slammed there with a heavy blow.
*Bam*
*Splurt*
"Gah." Huli Jinhu vomited quite a bit of blood as he looked up into the sky, but Zhang Fei [1] quickly landed above him and stabbed his sword Qi into his chest. "Arghhh!"
Since he had no intention of killing Huli Jinhu, Zhang Fei [1] did not attack his vital organs. "Do you enjoy your pain?"
"You— Argh!" Huli Jinyu screamed in pain again as Zhang Fei [1] broke his fox's snout.

Zhe Wuming and the others, who witnessed Zhang Fei [1]'s cruelty toward Huli Jinhu, felt sympathy for the golden fox. They didn't stop him, especially since they knew they couldn't. They turned their gazes toward Feng Yichen, who continued to toy with Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu, who were already in terrible shape.
Huli Zhishen suddenly appeared beside Zhang Fei [1] and Huli Jinhu; she felt sorry for her husband, who was in such a condition. "Please stop torturing him and do what you have planned before."

Zhang Fei [1] didn't say anything, but he could understand Huli Zhishen's feelings. After all, she had spent hundreds of thousands of years together with Huli Jinhu as his wife, so it was natural that she couldn't bear to see him torture her husband.

Zhang Fei [1] crouched on top of Huli Jinju and forcefully pulled his soul out of his body, but he immediately put it back after he replicated it and merged it with his. Thereafter, he instilled his demon slave mark into his soul, forced him to swallow a few healing pills, and sent him to the beast space for faster healing.
Huli Zhishen exhaled with a sense of relief. "Thank you."
"I don't want your thanks, and you must repay me with something else." Huli Zhishen blushed and nodded to Zhang Fei [1], who immediately teleported to Feng Yichen's side.
Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu, who were already overwhelmed in dealing with Feng Yizhen, became even more overwhelmed with the addition of Zhang Fei [1].

Zhang Fei [1] directly paralyzed and sealed the cultivation of the three female ancestors of the Dragon, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger clans. Just like the others, he also replicated their souls and merged them with his, especially since their soul power was high enough to increase his.

However, Zhang Fei [1] did not enslave Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu. He then sent the three female beasts to the beast space, where their presence significantly increased the soul link effect and further boosted his strength.

Seeing Huli Jinhu and the three female ancestors fall into Zhang Fei [1]'s hands, the people from the four mythical beast clans panicked and tried to escape. However, Hong Xinxin launched an immediate attack, electrocuting and burning them all. Despite this, none of them died, but they would need quite some time to recover.
Zhang Fei [1] then went to the location of Zhang Fei [4], who was fighting with Wang Yitao, and Feng Yichen went to the side of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was fighting with Dai Yishu.

sentences.text: "You little bastard, I will kill you today!" Dai Yishu furiously shouted.
Zhang Fei smirked at them, but he and his four clones quickly scattered away in five different directions.
"Chase after them!" Dai Yishu immediately flew after Zhang Fei, as did Wang Yitao and Huli Jinhu, who were chasing two of his clones.
"Tianzhu!
I'll chase one of the remaining two, and you chase the last one with the others!" After he ordered the female dragon, Long Tianzhu, Long Jiuxiao immediately chased after one of Zhang Fei's clones.
The people from the Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Golden Fox Clans wanted to follow their respective leaders.
However, many purple lightnings suddenly descended from the sky and struck some of them, causing them to scream in pain.
They didn't die, especially since Hong Xinxin's technique wasn't perfect yet.
Despite this, the group sustained severe injuries and became unable to move, prompting the others to raise their guard and activate their defensive artifacts.
Long Tianzhu and the other two women, who wanted to chase one of Zhang Fei's clones, were shocked when they saw that attack.
"This attack is not a lightning tribulation resulting from a breakthrough; rather, it is a technique used by someone.
But who is capable of using such a technique?"
"Who do you think is the owner of this technique, Tianzhu?"
"I don't know, Dai Yanxu." Long Tianzhu replied to the female ancestor of the White Tiger Clan with a shake of her head.
The female ancestor of the Black Tortoise Clan spoke immediately.
"Whoever owns this technique, his or her strength is on par or even higher than ours."
"You are right, Wang Qingyi.
That person deliberately attacked some of our men to warn us." The two women turned to Long Tianzhu, who pointed to the sky.
"The technique is still not perfect, and its owner is still brewing a stronger attack.
If the technique is complete, our subordinates will die from the attack."

"If I were you guys, I wouldn't move, and I would leave this realm directly." Long Tianzhu and the other two women turned to Huli Zhishen, who had suddenly appeared along with Zhu Danqing and the two female ancestors of the Nian and Fu Clans, Nuan Ying and Fu Yin.
"I didn't expect you to betray your husband, Zhishen." Long Tianzhu spoke in a condescending tone.
Huli Zhishen casually raised both hands.
"Whether I betray him or not, I will still leave him.
I have warned him not to find trouble with Zhang Fei because it will only harm our race, but he insisted on attacking him because of his arrogance."

"As Zhishen said just now, the three of you should not do anything and leave this realm immediately." Long Tianzhu and the other two frowned at Zhu Danqing, but they knew that the Vermilion Clan was on Zhang Fei's side from the start.
Wang Qingyi then asked the other two.
"Did you two also choose to side with that kid, Nuan Ying and Fu Yin?"
"No." Nuan Ying replied with a shake of her head.
Fu Yin then answered her.
"My mythical deer clan will not side with anyone, and we only want to seek peace.
Moreover, Xereth is still out there, and he could attack us at any time, so I want to stop the fighting between you."
"Why—"
"Choose: live or die." Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu looked at Feng Yichen.
She couldn't care less about them and released her full strength directly, pressing all the members of the four clans to the ground.
"Our cultivation may be equal, but I am still superior to the three of you.
If you choose to fight my master, I will make you suffer."
"Guys, don't—" Zhu Danqing had not finished her words, but Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu had already moved to attack Feng Yichen, causing her and the others to sigh heavily.
"Heh." Feng Yichen snorted slightly and led the three female beasts into the air, where they fought three on one.
"Are we going to stop them?" Nuan Ying asked.
"Too late." Huli Zhishen shook her head in response.
"Once the three of them decided to attack Feng Yichen, Zhang Fei already considered them enemies.
Even if we stop them now, he still won't spare them, so there's no need for us to waste our energy."
"Hmm?" Fu Yin looked at the four female beasts in the air, and she could clearly see that Feng Yichen had the upper hand, even though Long Tianzhu and the others were ganging up on her.
"Can you move as fast as that woman, Zhishen?"
"Yes." Huli Zhishen gave a light nod of approval.
"Everyone on Zhang Fei's side has equal speed, especially since we train using the same method.
However, some of them can be faster, especially those with wind or lightning elements."
Zhu Danqing, Nuan Ying, and Fu Yin exchanged glances for a moment before letting out soft sighs and watching the four women's fight again.
"Feng Yichen can defeat them easily, but she is deliberately toying with them."

"Yeah." Huli Zhishen nodded in agreement before turning his head towards the distance, where Huli Jinhu, who was already using his half-beast form, was fighting with Zhang Fei [1]. 'I have warned you not to fight him, but you are too stubborn and arrogant.
Therefore, do not blame others for your stupidity and suffering; you will have to endure the pain of your mistakes for the rest of your life.'
*Bam*
Zhang Fei [1] caught Huli Jinhu's right claw.
"Is this the extent of your strength?"
"Bastard!" Huli Jinhu attacked him with his other claw, but Zhang Fei [1] effortlessly grabbed it and broke both of them instantly.
*Crack...
Crack...*
"Argh!" Huli Jinhu groaned in pain, but Zhang Fei [1] didn't stop there and quickly kicked both of his knees, breaking them at once.
*Crack...
Crack...*
"Argh!" Zhang Fei [1] directly punched Huli Jinhu's chest, sending him rolling in the air several times.
"Gah!"
Huli Jinhu immediately stabilized himself by enduring the pain in both his hands and feet, but he still arrogantly stared at Zhang Fei [1], even though he was clearly not his opponent.
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head with a smirk.
"If I were still the same as before, I would definitely not be your opponent.
However, I have changed significantly over the past two years, and you are no longer my opponent.
By the way, I thoroughly enjoyed my time with your wife, and she couldn't stop moaning when she was beneath me."
"You bastard!
I will kill you!" Huli Jinhu immediately returned to his complete beast form, a golden fox with nine tails behind him.
He then released his full strength and shot a golden Qi from his mouth while exclaiming, "Die!"
"Hahaha!" Huli Jinhu was shocked to hear Zhang Fei [1]'s laughter from above him because he was clearly still in front of him.
"Honestly, I want to kill you, but I will do it after I get rid of Xereth."
Huli Jinhu wanted to escape, but Zhang Fei [1] quickly created a black sword Qi and cut off his nine golden tails, causing his blood to gush out and rain down on the ground beneath them.
"Arghhhh!"
Zhang Fei [1] then stabbed his sword Qi into Huli Jinhu's back before kicking him extremely hard, causing the male golden fox to hurtle toward the ground before being slammed there with a heavy blow.
*Bam*
*Splurt*
"Gah." Huli Jinhu vomited quite a bit of blood as he looked up into the sky, but Zhang Fei [1] quickly landed above him and stabbed his sword Qi into his chest.
"Arghhh!"
Since he had no intention of killing Huli Jinhu, Zhang Fei [1] did not attack his vital organs.
"Do you enjoy your pain?"
"You— Argh!" Huli Jinyu screamed in pain again as Zhang Fei [1] broke his fox's snout.
Zhe Wuming and the others, who witnessed Zhang Fei [1]'s cruelty toward Huli Jinhu, felt sympathy for the golden fox.
They didn't stop him, especially since they knew they couldn't.
They turned their gazes toward Feng Yichen, who continued to toy with Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu, who were already in terrible shape.
Huli Zhishen suddenly appeared beside Zhang Fei [1] and Huli Jinhu; she felt sorry for her husband, who was in such a condition.
"Please stop torturing him and do what you have planned before."
Zhang Fei [1] didn't say anything, but he could understand Huli Zhishen's feelings.
After all, she had spent hundreds of thousands of years together with Huli Jinhu as his wife, so it was natural that she couldn't bear to see him torture her husband.
Zhang Fei [1] crouched on top of Huli Jinju and forcefully pulled his soul out of his body, but he immediately put it back after he replicated it and merged it with his.
Thereafter, he instilled his demon slave mark into his soul, forced him to swallow a few healing pills, and sent him to the beast space for faster healing.
Huli Zhishen exhaled with a sense of relief.
"Thank you."
"I don't want your thanks, and you must repay me with something else." Huli Zhishen blushed and nodded to Zhang Fei [1], who immediately teleported to Feng Yichen's side.
Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu, who were already overwhelmed in dealing with Feng Yizhen, became even more overwhelmed with the addition of Zhang Fei [1].
Zhang Fei [1] directly paralyzed and sealed the cultivation of the three female ancestors of the Dragon, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger clans.
Just like the others, he also replicated their souls and merged them with his, especially since their soul power was high enough to increase his.
However, Zhang Fei [1] did not enslave Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu.
He then sent the three female beasts to the beast space, where their presence significantly increased the soul link effect and further boosted his strength.
Seeing Huli Jinhu and the three female ancestors fall into Zhang Fei [1]'s hands, the people from the four mythical beast clans panicked and tried to escape.
However, Hong Xinxin launched an immediate attack, electrocuting and burning them all.
Despite this, none of them died, but they would need quite some time to recover.
Zhang Fei [1] then went to the location of Zhang Fei [4], who was fighting with Wang Yitao, and Feng Yichen went to the side of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was fighting with Dai Yishu.

chapters.title: Chapter 944: Battle Of Xianjin III
paragraphs: "Shit." Wang Yitao cursed as soon as Zhang Fei [1] joined his fight with Zhang Fei [4], especially since he was already overwhelmed facing one, but he had to face two of them now. He transformed into his black tortoise form and created several runes around him, which served as additional defense for him.

Wang Yitao's snake tail immediately sprayed poison at the two, but they did not dodge it, making him feel victorious. However, his expression turned to shock when he saw that his poison was ineffective against Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [4].

"Unfortunately, you don't know me well, and I am immune to all poisons." Wang Yitao's face darkened as he simultaneously fired a water ball and poison, but Zhang Fei [4] instantly froze both of them. "I'm disappointed because your abilities are only limited to this, and they can't support your arrogance. I've wasted a lot of time with you, so it's time for me to end our fight."
Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [4] instantly moved at the same time, and they attacked Wang Yitao's defensive runes with all their strength, causing them to crack rapidly before shattering into pieces.
Wang Yitao used his other abilities and trapped them in a water prison, but Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [4] quickly froze his water prison, forcing him to flee at full speed.
*Boom*

Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [4] immediately pursued Wang Yitao after his water prison collapsed. They chopped off his snake tail, causing him to scream loudly as blood poured from it. They didn't give him a chance to breathe, and both of them hit his black shell with full force, making it dent in several places, which was very painful for him. "Argh! Stop it! Stop beating me!"
"Can't do it!" Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [4] mercilessly kept beating Wang Yitao until his black shell broke in several places, leaving his entire body covered in blood.

Once they had sufficiently battered Wang Yitao, Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [4] immediately halted their assault, realizing that the male black tortoise was on the verge of death and would perish if they continued.

Zhang Fei [1] then treated Wang Yitao in the same manner as he had previously treated Huli Jinhu. Once he finished, he sent the male black tortoise into the beast space; he and Zhang Fei [4] immediately went to the other location.

Meanwhile, Dai Yishu was lying on the ground with his body covered in blood and burns, and both his arms and legs were also broken. 'This bastard! How could he be this strong? My metal element is completely useless against his fire element.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] stepped on Dai Yishu's head with a bit of force, burying it in the ground beneath him. "Didn't you want to kill me before? Why are you helpless under my feet now? If only you weren't arrogant and wanted to attack the people closest to me, you wouldn't have experienced today's incident, so you can blame yourself."

'My master is acting like a cruel villain.' Feng Yichen muttered inwardly. "Master, deal with this weak tiger now, and we can return to our seclusion again. This way, you can break through to the Seven Divine Realms faster."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Feng Yichen. "Are you impatient to do the true dual cultivation with me, Yichen?"
"Aren't you looking forward to doing it with me and the others?" Feng Yichen responded by shaking her head.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded with a smile. "I have been married to Xian Xianqin for more than two years, but we have not had a proper wedding night, and neither have Zhou Zhenxin and Bai Tian'er. Therefore, I can't wait to break through to the Seven Divine Realms, and I will eat all of you at that time."
"Then what are you waiting for?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately replicated Dai Yishu's soul and merged it with his. He then enslaved him, gave him a few pills, and sent him to the beast space like the others. "Let's go to my real body."
*Bam... Bam...*
Zhang Fei's four clones and Feng Yichen gathered at the location of his real body, but they remained still and observed his fight with Long Jiuxiao.

Up in the sky, Zhang Fei and Long Jiuxiao continued to exchange attacks, but the dragon ancestor realized that he was not in an advantageous situation, and his entire body avoided all of his attacks. 'Fuck! How could his body and raw strength be this strong? I'm a dragon, but he keeps pushing me like this! Moreover, his aura increased significantly after he captured them, and his strength has far surpassed me now.'

"Give up and surrender yourself to me, or you will suffer more from this." Long Jiuxiao flew away from Zhang Fei and frowned. "Your wife and the others have already fallen into my hands, and their power is mine now, so you will never win against me."

'What does that mean? How can their power be his?' Long Jiuxiao clenched his jaw tightly. "Do you think I will surrender to a snotty brat like you? Even if it means destroying this realm to kill you, I am determined to do so, and I will eradicate you from this universe today!"
Zhang Fei just shook his head and let Long Jiuxiao return to his dragon form, which was much larger compared to when he and the others attacked him using his avatar on the Sky Dragon Island.
*Roar*
A powerful wave of wind swept toward Zhang Fei as soon as Long Jiuxiao used his dragon roar to intimidate him, but he casually stood in the air, unfazed by his actions.

In contrast to Zhang Fei, many residents of the Xianjin Realm fell unconscious due to Long Jiuxiao's actions; however, they were fortunate that Zhe Wuming and the others quickly moved to protect them.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as Long Jiuxiao's body grew bigger and bigger, and his body size became twice as big as before, making his shadow cover a large area of the Xianjin Realm.
*Roar*
Long Jiuxiao once released a deafening dragon roar. "Kneel in fear before me, you little bastard."

"What an arrogant yet senile old man!" Zhang Fei, his four clones, and Feng Yichen immediately surrounded Long Jiuxiao. "Do you think we will be afraid of your gigantic body? Instead, you are an easy target for us, and we will beat you up right now."
Long Jiuxiao was furious, and he shot a few dragon flames toward them. "Die!"

"Really?" Zhang Fei and his four clones immediately countered Long Jiuxiao's dragon flames with their flames, and the clash of their attacks caused several huge explosions that shook the entire realm.

Zhe Wuming quickly moved by opening several void holes, and he sent the impact of their attacks into the void; otherwise, his realm would be thrown into chaos. 'These guys are truly insane! Do they want to destroy this realm?'
*Swoosh*

Long Jiuxiao tried to rely on his physical strength, and he used his gigantic dragon tail to attack them. However, they easily avoided his slow tail movement, and Feng Yichen immediately spat her dark flame at it, which instantly burned it. "Gah!"
*Roar*
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Long Jiuxiao once again shot out several dragon flames, but Zhe Wuming decided to interfere in their fight, and he sent his dragon flames into the void. "Zhang Fei! Don't waste any more time and defeat him!"
"All right." Zhang Fei and his four clones immediately used different elements and techniques to attack Long Jiuxiao.
Zhang Fei [1] used the Annihilation Flame, Zhang Fei [4] used the Hellflame Frost Lotus, Feltia [2] summoned a giant ice sword, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] summoned a wind vortex.
Zhang Fei's lightning element had already covered his body, prompting him to make several gestures with both hands. "Eighth Heaven: Wrath of Sky Lightning Pillar."

In that instant, a huge lightning pillar descended from the sky. Simultaneously, each of his four clones launched their individual techniques at Long Jiuxiao. Feng Yichen did not remain silent, and she threw a dark fireball towards him.

Long Jiuxiao's biggest mistake was to enlarge his body to that size, and in just a matter of seconds, their attacks directly struck his gigantic dragon body, causing his entire body to suffer various kinds of injuries. "Argh!"
Thereafter, Zhang Fei moved above Long Jiuxiao, took a sword stance, and slashed his sword. "Seventh Heaven: Heaven-Severing Lightning Slash!"
*Swoosh*
A huge crescent-shaped lightning sword Qi shot towards Long Jiuxiao, instantly cutting off his tail and causing his blood to gush out.
*Splurt*
"Argh!" Long Jiuxiao groaned in pain as his body shrank rapidly, but Zhang Fei swung his sword again and used the same technique to cut off his dragon wings. "Gahh!"
*Splurt*

Due to his heavy injuries, Long Jiuxiao's consciousness slowly disappeared, but another pain immediately coursed through his body as soon as Zhang Fei's two clones moved above his head and broke his dragon horns.
*Crack... Crack...*

"Gahh!" Long Jiuxiao's body shot towards the ground at high speed, and he eventually slammed into the area below him. Soon, he reverted to his human form, lying on the ground in a miserable state. His vision was too blurred, and his consciousness was on the verge of collapse. 'Damn it! I am the mighty dragon! How could I lose to this little bastard?'
Zhang Fei immediately floated down, landed beside Long Jiuxiao, and squatted there. He did not waste any more time and enslaved the dragon ancestor, especially after he replicated his soul.

Zhang Fei forced Long Jiuxiao, who had fallen unconscious, to swallow healing pills before sending him to the beast space. He then looked at Zhe Wuming, who landed in front of him. "They are still alive now, and I sent them to my beast space so that they can recover faster, or we will be in trouble if Xereth suddenly attacks us."
"Have you tried asking for help from those two senior beasts to fight Xereth?" Zhe Wuming asked.

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head. "They've endangered themselves by repeatedly helping me by hindering Xereth, and we'll be in danger if they kill him, especially since Taotie will definitely find out about it. If he descends to the three mortal realms, then not only will we die, but everyone who lives here."
"I see." Zhe Wuming nodded in understanding. "Now that we've resolved our business with them, you can continue your seclusion, and I'll handle everything here."
"All right."

chapters.title: Chapter 945: Replace Three Prisoners
paragraphs: Zhang Fei did not return to the pavilion immediately, but he found Serpentera and Tian Kui, who were watching from a distance.

"Hahaha!" Tian Kui laughed loudly as he patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "I like you more and more, kid! The way you deal with your enemies is so cruel and straightforward, but you should talk less with them. You must remember that every second always matters in battle; you must not give them a chance to attack you, and you must defeat them faster, especially since a single technique can decide the outcome of a battle. In the Paradise Realm, those powerful cultivators don't talk much, and their enemies are already dead even before they realize it. If you talk to your enemies too often, you will lose and die in their hands."

"Old Kui is right, kid." Serpentera spoke with a nod. "Your speed is indeed incredibly quick in the three mortal realms, but you are no different from a snail in the Paradise Realm. The only reason you could avoid Old Kui's attack back then was because he refrained from using his strength; otherwise, he would have decapitated you."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, especially since he himself had long been aware that Serpentera and Tian Kui's strength and speed had already surpassed all cultivators in the three mortal realms; not even Xereth could defeat them without the help of Taotie's avatar.

Serpentera then continued. "Just like you, we also often acted arrogantly in the past, especially when we had the upper hand over our enemies. Such things are unavoidable because we are born with emotions, but we continue to learn to improve ourselves and control our emotions. As we grow older, we realize that emotions are not good for us, so we learn to suppress our emotions, especially our arrogance."

"You're still too young now, and young people are always like that." Zhang Fei smiled upon hearing that from Tian Kui. "Remember, you have many people with you, and they will suffer if you die. Therefore, you must continue to improve yourself and control your emotions; you must be more efficient in fighting and talk less in battle."
"Thank you for your advice." Zhang Fei then asked them. "Do you two have a way to pass on someone else's power to someone?"
Serpentera and Tian Kui exchanged a brief glance. "Are you thinking about passing on the power of the two beasts that Feng Yichen captured before to your two wives?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "Back then, Hong Xinxin gained the power of the Azure Emperor Roc, and he told her that his late master sealed his past strength in his soul."

Serpentera answered him directly. "We can do that, but you must not pass on their power to those with weak physiques; otherwise, their bodies will not be able to contain their power, and they will die."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "You two remember that I can turn my two wives into beasts, right? I plan to use the two beasts as sacrifices to turn my other two wives into beasts according to their races, and their bodies should be able to accommodate their powers if they become the same beasts as them. Unfortunately, I don't have a method to pass on the powers of the two beasts to my two wives, so I came to you two."

Both beasts nodded in understanding. "If you want to do that, we will help you transfer the powers of the two beasts to your two wives. Before that, you must perform a specific action on the cores and souls of the two beasts, ensuring that they remain intact; otherwise, we will be unable to use them. After you turn your two wives into the two beasts, you can bring them to us in the Starry Sky Realm."

"All right, I will go back now and turn my two wives into two beasts, and I will bring them to meet you two after." After saying this, Zhang Fei immediately took his four clones, Hong Xinxin, Huli Zhishen, Feng Yichen, and the two beasts into the pavilion.
Naturally, Zhang Fei didn't forget to bring the two beasts from the White Tiger and Black Tortoise clans, which were captured by the dark phoenix before.
Serpentera and Tian Kui also left the Xianjin Realm, and they waited for Zhang Fei in the Starry Sky Realm.

Inside the pavilion, Zhang Fei immediately took out the science capsule. He called Shi Xi to meet him because she had the metal element, and the white tiger beast suited her. As for the black tortoise beast, he was confused about choosing one among his several wives, especially since those with the water element were mostly beasts, such as Zhang Lin, Shen Huang, Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu, and Boitata.

However, Shen Yu had already become a mythical beast after he inherited the rain dragon bloodline, and Zhang Lin had already become a mythical beast after she transformed into the Abyssal Leviathan Dragon, so she didn't need that. Meanwhile, Boitata was a divine beast with a high chance of evolving into the mythical beast.
Shen Huang and Shen Xueyi immediately told Zhang Fei that they did not want to transform into a black tortoise beast, and they wanted to evolve into mythical sea serpent beasts.

In the end, Zhang Fei chose Angela, especially since she was a fish demon beast and the last water element owner among his women. He carefully stored the two beasts' souls and cores after using certain techniques to preserve them per Serpentera's instructions. "Yichen, you can extract everything we need from the two beasts, and I will immediately begin their transformation process."
"Yes, Master." Feng Yichen immediately started with the white tiger beast.
After Feng Yichen extracted everything, and Shi Xi was already lying in the capsule, Zhang Fei immediately began the process. "Let's wait for the process to complete."
"Why don't you choose one from the dragon clan?" Huli Haohao asked Zhang Fei.

Zhu Lingyao also spoke to him. 'After this, you will have the vermilion bird, the white tiger, and the black tortoise by your side. However, there is one of the four mythical virtue beasts remaining, which is the Azure Dragon.'

"According to legend, if the four mythical virtue beasts combine their powers, they can summon something extraordinary from the heavens." Zhang Fei turned to Feng Qingmeng, especially since he had never heard such a thing before. "I'm not sure about the truth of the legend, especially since the four races have never united before. However, I think it's okay if you try, and you can turn Shi Wu, Janette, or Lillea into the Azure Dragon."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin as he thought about that, and his gaze kept switching between Shi Wu, Janette, and Lillea.
"Husband, I don't want to turn into a beast." Janette spoke to him.
Lillea nodded in agreement with her daughter. "We dryads are creatures of nature, and our existence is quite special, so you can turn Shi Wu into the Azure Dragon."

"Moreover, Shi Wu and Shi Xi are siblings, and her sister will become the white tiger beast soon." After Janette said that, Zhang Fei looked at Shi Wu, who seemed to be looking forward to it. "She is the most suitable choice to become the Azure Dragon, and her wood element will experience a significant increase to help us take care of the herbs in the Sealed World Pearl."

After he thought about it, Zhang Fei went to the Xianjin Realm again, and he returned a few minutes later carrying an azure dragon beast, which was in a state of heavy injury after being hit by Hong Xinxin earlier.

Shi Wu was overjoyed after seeing the azure dragon beast. After all, her strength would increase significantly if she transformed into a mythical beast, so she would not lag behind her sister, and she could help Zhang Fei collect the beast essence.
Zhang Fei smiled at Shi Wu's expression, but he immediately left them and went into the beast space to check on his prisoners.

When he arrived there, Zhang Fei saw people from the Dragon, Black Tortoise, White Tiger, and Golden Fox clans gathered around their ancestors. They felt sorry for their male ancestors, especially since their condition was quite miserable after he and his clones beat them up.
In contrast to them, the conditions of Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu were much better because Feng Yichen had only been toying with them before, and she had not seriously injured them.
Those people did not say anything to Zhang Fei once he arrived at the location, and they immediately dispersed to return to their cultivation.

Huli Jinhu, Long Jiuxian, Wang Yitao, and Dai Yishu were unconscious. Meanwhile, Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu were huddled together, but their bodies were shaking quite intensely as they looked at Zhang Fei, thinking about his next plans for them.
"What will you do to them, Husband?" Boitata asked him.
Yan Jinwu also asked him. "Do you want to take these three women as your partners?"

"No." Zhang Fei's answer surprised Yan Jinwu and Boitata. "They are strong and beautiful, but they don't interest me. Instead, I will use the three of them to replace my three prisoners, especially since some of them are too weak. If I lock them up there, I will be able to gain Qi faster, and the Seven Divine Realms will not be far from my reach."
"Which three of them will you replace with these women?"
"Zhou Meiling, Qu Qiuxue, and Ma Mingxin."
"Eh?" Boitata was surprised to hear the last name. "Isn't Ma Mingxin stronger than Ruo Yanxi? Why do you want to let her go?"
"Ma Mingxin is indeed stronger than Ruo Yanxi, but I need her to control the Blossom Heaven Realm."

"Oh." Boitata immediately understood and teased him. "Are you thinking of dual cultivating with all the women in the realm? Most of the inhabitants of that realm are women, and all the men there are their slaves, right?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "I don't have that kind of thought for them, and I only want the cultivation resources of that realm. Since those men are their slaves, I don't need to work hard to get those resources, and Ma Mingxin will control everything for me."
After that, Zhang Fei brought Long Tianzhu, Wang Qingyi, and Dai Yanxu into the Yin-Yang Space, and he locked them there to replace Zhou Meiling, Qu Qiuxue, and Ma Mingxin.

After he modified their memories, Zhang Fei sent Zhou Meiling back to the Zhou Kingdom in the Nine Stars Realm to help Zhou Tong take care of the kingdom. He sent Qu Qiuxue to the Alchemy Union, and he appointed her as the head guard.

Zhang Fei enslaved Ma Mingxin before giving her a teleportation device and sending her to the Nine Stars Realm. He ordered her to return to the Blossom Heaven Realm, and he also gave her the task of collecting as many resources as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 946 946: Tian Shuixiang's Revelation
paragraphs: In the Xianjin Realm, Zhe Wuming and the others discussed their situation after the battle between Zhang Fei and the four mythical beast clans. He asked Tian Yishen and the doctors from their realm to treat the people from the four clans, especially since most of them were seriously injured by Hong Xinxin's technique.
"Have you guys ever seen such a technique before?" Nian Ying asked the others.
Tian Shuixiang nodded at her. "The Azure Emperor Roc rules the sky, and its main power is heavenly lightning, which is similar to the lightning tribulation."
"Why have I never heard of the Azure Emperor Roc?" Fu Yin asked in confusion.

"There is only one Azure Emperor Roc in the three mortal realms, and that beast is the mount of one of the founding fathers of the Sovereign Heaven Realm." Tian Shuixiang and the others turned to Hong Quan directly. "That realm is the oldest among the three mortal realms, and Tian Kongquan lived several million years ago in the distant past. When the beast was about to run out of its lifespan, he brought it to the Raging Thunder Realm. He kept the beast's corpse and preserved it in the Thunderfall Gorge to find its heir, and my granddaughter succeeded in becoming its successor because of Zhang Fei."
"Does that mean the Azure Emperor Roc still exists in the Paradise Realm?" This time Zhu Danqing asked.

"There are thousands or even tens of thousands of Azure Emperor Rocs in the Paradise Realm." Upon hearing that, they looked at Tian Shuixiang with suspicion, particularly after recalling Tian Kui's earlier remarks about him.

Tian Shuixiang sighed softly and returned to his demon form, shocking almost all of them except for those close to Zhang Fei. Their shock didn't stop there, especially since Ye Zhiye immediately emerged from Tian Shuixiang's body in her demon form.

If they didn't know the alchemy god, they would have immediately attacked Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, but they knew that he was different from the other demons, and he had helped many people in the Void Heaven Realm. Therefore, they held themselves back and waited for his explanation.

Tian Shuixiang hugged Ye Zhiye's waist and explained it to them. "My true name is Shang Xiuluo, and I am the Asura Demon. My wife is Ye Zhiye, and she is the Eternal Night Demon. We are both demons from the Paradise Realm, and we fled to the three mortal realms to avoid being hunted by members of her demon race, which happened because of our relationship."
"Your relationship?"

"Yes." Tian Shuixiang nodded at them. "My Asura Demon Race is the second strongest of the ten demon races, and her Eternal Demon Race is the seventh strongest. Our two races have always hated each other because of past events, but that incident was more painful for her race, and they hunted us down to kill me. Luckily, someone I knew from the Faceless Demon Race helped us escape here, and he helped us disguise our demon forms and auras. You should already know the rest of the story, especially after I lived as Tian Shuixiang."

They nodded to Tian Shuixiang, especially since they had known him for tens of thousands of years. Zhu Hong suddenly spoke. "Hey, Shuixiang, people always thought you were gay, but I didn't expect you to already have a wife, and you guys have such a terrible love story."
"Haha." Tian Shuixiang laughed bitterly in response. He and Ye Zhiye then returned to their human forms. "Zhiye is everything to me, and I will never betray her for another woman."
Ye Zhiye put on a proud smile as she hugged Tian Shuixiang's waist. "I know you are all surprised by our identities, but we have no ill intentions at all, and we just want to live a peaceful life."

With their long-standing relationship, they did not really mind Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye's true identities. They also knew that not all demons were evil, and they had to rely on a demon like Zhang Fei to deal with threats like Xereth.
"Speaking of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, have any of you ever been to that realm?" You Shen suddenly asked.

"Me." All of them turned to Xia Tian, who immediately explained quite a lot about the Sovereign Heaven Realm, including the tests they had to pass to enter it. "Do you remember when I disappeared back then? I spent ten years passing those tests, and then I dedicated the next hundred years to studying extensively in that realm, including the connection between the Paradise Realm and the three mortal realms. However, I didn't expect that Zhang Fei had more knowledge about all of that than me, and he got it all from the soul of a powerful cultivator from that realm."
"The soul of a powerful cultivator from the Paradise Realm?"

"Yes." Xia Tian nodded at them. "His name is Ma Kuangyu, and Zhang Fei met him at the Star Tower. According to him, all the towers were once built as prisons, but the Paradise Realm was experiencing a talent crisis, so the leaders of that realm sent those towers to the three mortal realms, specifically to the middle realms, as a challenge to find new talents. No one has ever reached their peak, but that kid might change that.

"I agree with you, Old Xia." Gong Ren said with a nod. "Zhang Fei did get a lot of help from powerful cultivators, but he himself had excellent talent and mindset; otherwise, he would never have been able to reach his current level just by relying on their help. If he lacked both talent and mindset, the people in the Star Tower would not have helped him to that extent, nor would they have asked their friends in the Sun Tower to inform us of recent matters at his request."
All of them agreed with Gong Ren because they had witnessed with their own eyes Zhang Fei's ability in dealing with Long Jiuxiao and the others, and he had also helped them a lot in some other ways.
"Do you all have plans to try going to the Sovereign Heaven Realm?"
"Yes." Zhe Wuming immediately answered Guan Chenhong. "After we solve the problem regarding Xereth, I will go to that realm directly."
"Don't you want to go to the Star Tower to challenge it?" Wang Zhemin asked him.

"Naturally, I am interested in challenging the Star Tower, but I realize that my abilities are still not enough for me to venture into the Paradise Realm." Zhe Wuming's reply made them sigh heavily. "Rather than thinking about that realm, I am more interested in trying the test in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. I believe those tests can help me improve my abilities, and I will cultivate there for a few hundred years before I think about challenging the tower again."
Since they had all challenged the tower before, they also realized that their abilities were still limited, and they would not be able to face the powerful cultivators in the Paradise Realm.

Tian Shuixiang immediately spoke to them. "Honestly, your thoughts about the Paradise Realm are wrong, especially since that place is no different from the three mortal realms. Not all cultivators there are that strong, and there are still many cultivators below the Seven Divine Realms there. They do not cultivate using normal or divine Qi; instead, they use celestial Qi, which allows them to cultivate much faster than the cultivators in this realm. Not to mention, the flow of time there is much faster—about fifty times faster—so the difference in cultivation between the two realms is striking."
"What? Fifty times faster?" All of them exclaimed in shock.

"Yeah." Tian Shuixiang then explained to them about the situation in the Paradise Realm, especially about the ninety-nine domains. "Among them, there are only eleven demon domains, and two of them are mine and my wife's domain, the Slaughter Blood Domain and the Eternal Night Domain. The ten demon gods do not live in their respective realms, but they live in the Ten Hell Monarch Domain."
"Ten demon gods?"

"Yes." Tian Shuixiang nodded. "We all know about the demon ranks in the three mortal realms, starting from the lesser to the emperor rank. However, the demon ranks do not stop at the emperor rank, and there are still several advanced ranks: Demon Monarch, Demon Overlord, Demon Venerable, Demon Saint, Half-Step Demon God, Demon God, and Primordial Demon."
Tian Shuixiang's revelation once again shocked them, but then Yan Leibao asked him. "Why do you only mention the ten demon gods? What about the Primordial Demon?"

"The only demon that ever held the title of the Primordial Demon was the first demon born in this universe, and no demon has ever managed to reach that stage after him." All of them fell silent after Tian Shuixian said that. "I don't know why, but I believe Zhang Fei has a chance to achieve it."
"Zhang Fei?"

Tian Shuixiang nodded. "Zhang Fei is the only living being with three identities, and you beasts know that he is the leading candidate to become the heir of the ten-tailed fox. Moreover, the writings of the old ten-tailed fox clearly indicate that he will be the peacemaker for all races, so I believe he will succeed in becoming a primordial demon. That way, he can control the demon races, and he can prevent them from creating chaos."
"You're right." Zhu Danqing replied with a nod. "All beasts and natural races are always looking forward to the return of the ten-tailed fox, and his writing is indeed about Zhang Fei."
Zhe Wuming then spoke to them. "I think we've talked enough, and you guys should continue your seclusion. If Xereth suddenly attacks us, we won't be ready, and we will all perish at his hands."

Their expressions turned gloomy because they were clearly not Xereth's opponents, but none of them refuted Zhe Wuming, and they immediately returned to their temporary place to continue their seclusion.

Zhe Wuming also left his private residence and went to the hospital, checking the conditions of the members of the four beast clans. However, he did not stay there for too long, especially since Tian Yishen and the other doctors had already taken excellent care of them. Thereafter, he continued his cultivation, but he felt conflicted, especially when recalling all the stories of Tian Shuixiang from before.
- To Be Continued -

"Haha." Tian Shuixiang laughed bitterly in response.

"Zhiye is everything to me, and I will never betray her for another woman."
Ye Zhiye put on a proud smile as she hugged Tian Shuixiang's waist.
"I know you are all surprised by our identities, but we have no ill intentions at all, and we just want to live a peaceful life."
With their long-standing relationship, they did not really mind Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye's true identities.
They also knew that not all demons were evil, and they had to rely on a demon like Zhang Fei to deal with threats like Xereth.
"Speaking of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, have any of you ever been to that realm?" You Shen suddenly asked.
"Me." All of them turned to Xia Tian, who immediately explained quite a lot about the Sovereign Heaven Realm, including the tests they had to pass to enter it.
"Do you remember when I disappeared back then?

I spent ten years passing those tests, and then I dedicated the next hundred years to studying extensively in that realm, including the connection between the Paradise Realm and the three mortal realms.
However, I didn't expect that Zhang Fei had more knowledge about all of that than me, and he got it all from the soul of a powerful cultivator from that realm."
"The soul of a powerful cultivator from the Paradise Realm?"
"Yes." Xia Tian nodded at them.
"His name is Ma Kuangyu, and Zhang Fei met him at the Star Tower.

According to him, all the towers were once built as prisons, but the Paradise Realm was experiencing a talent crisis, so the leaders of that realm sent those towers to the three mortal realms, specifically to the middle realms, as a challenge to find new talents.
No one has ever reached their peak, but that kid might change that.

I believe those tests can help me improve my abilities, and I will cultivate there for a few hundred years before I think about challenging the tower again."

Tian Shuixiang immediately spoke to them.
"Honestly, your thoughts about the Paradise Realm are wrong, especially since that place is no different from the three mortal realms.

They do not cultivate using normal or divine Qi; instead, they use celestial Qi, which allows them to cultivate much faster than the cultivators in this realm.
Not to mention, the flow of time there is much faster—about fifty times faster—so the difference in cultivation between the two realms is striking."

Fifty times faster?" All of them exclaimed in shock.

"Ten demon gods?"
"Yes." Tian Shuixiang nodded.
"We all know about the demon ranks in the three mortal realms, starting from the lesser to the emperor rank.

However, the demon ranks do not stop at the emperor rank, and there are still several advanced ranks: Demon Monarch, Demon Overlord, Demon Venerable, Demon Saint, Half-Step Demon God, Demon God, and Primordial Demon."
Tian Shuixiang's revelation once again shocked them, but then Yan Leibao asked him.
"Why do you only mention the ten demon gods?
What about the Primordial Demon?"

"The only demon that ever held the title of the Primordial Demon was the first demon born in this universe, and no demon has ever managed to reach that stage after him." All of them fell silent after Tian Shuixian said that.
"I don't know why, but I believe Zhang Fei has a chance to achieve it."
"Zhang Fei?"
Tian Shuixiang nodded.
"Zhang Fei is the only living being with three identities, and you beasts know that he is the leading candidate to become the heir of the ten-tailed fox.
Moreover, the writings of the old ten-tailed fox clearly indicate that he will be the peacemaker for all races, so I believe he will succeed in becoming a primordial demon.
That way, he can control the demon races, and he can prevent them from creating chaos."
"You're right." Zhu Danqing replied with a nod.
"All beasts and natural races are always looking forward to the return of the ten-tailed fox, and his writing is indeed about Zhang Fei."
Zhe Wuming then spoke to them.
"I think we've talked enough, and you guys should continue your seclusion.
If Xereth suddenly attacks us, we won't be ready, and we will all perish at his hands."

Their expressions turned gloomy because they were clearly not Xereth's opponents, but none of them refuted Zhe Wuming, and they immediately returned to their temporary place to continue their seclusion.
Zhe Wuming also left his private residence and went to the hospital, checking the conditions of the members of the four beast clans.
However, he did not stay there for too long, especially since Tian Yishen and the other doctors had already taken excellent care of them.
Thereafter, he continued his cultivation, but he felt conflicted, especially when recalling all the stories of Tian Shuixiang from before.
